title: Senior Product Manager, Fraud Risk Platforms
jd_text: At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together. The Crown Is Yours As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll shape how DraftKings resolves risk cases while building smarter ways to prevent them from happening in the first place. You’ll lead the strategy and roadmap for risk case resolution, using automation, artificial intelligence, and customer self-service to scale our approach as we enter new markets and expand our offerings. Working across Risk Operations, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Controls & Compliance, you’ll turn complex operational challenges into scalable systems that drive faster, more effective decisions. Your work will help trusted customers get resolved quickly while stopping bad actors with decisions we can confidently explain and defend. What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager Own and drive an outcome-based roadmap for risk case decisioning across AI-assisted review, case automation, self-service, and case management, aligning priorities to measurable operational and business goals. Partner closely with Risk Operations to understand how cases are worked, identify where agent time is spent, and use case volume, handle time, and other operational data to prioritize opportunities with the greatest impact. Define the right resolution path for different case types, determining where cases can be automated, supported by AI, resolved through customer self-service, or require human review. Shape the end-to-end case lifecycle, including case types, states, routing, prioritization, queues, resolution actions, closure criteria, and the evidence agents need to make informed decisions. Lead discovery and execution with Engineering, Data Science, Controls & Compliance, and cross-functional partners, translating complex needs into clear requirements, testable acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. Define success metrics for every initiative and use data to evaluate automation rates, workload reduction, self-service containment, AI review quality, decision quality, and operational cost. Represent the case resolution experience in upstream decisions, making the operational impact of changes to orchestration, tooling, and risk models visible before those changes reach agent queues. Build auditability into automated and AI-assisted case decisions, partnering with Controls & Compliance to make sure decision rationale and supporting evidence meet applicable standards for areas such as anti-money laundering and Responsible Gaming. What you’ll bring A Bachelor’s Degree or any suitable combination of education, experience, and training, along with at least 7 years of experience in Product Management. Experience in fraud, risk, trust & safety, or large-scale operations automation. Proven experience defining strategy, building roadmaps, and leading complex initiatives from discovery through delivery and iteration in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to prioritization, with experience defining success metrics, evaluating performance, and using insights to guide investment decisions. Experience working across Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Operations, and other business teams to translate complex problems into clear requirements and scalable solutions. The ability to navigate ambiguity, balance long-term strategy with near-term operational impact, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across competing priorities. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and align cross-functional teams around decisions, priorities, and measurable outcomes. A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a focus on understanding users firsthand and turning operational challenges into intuitive, effective experiences. Familiarity with internal tools, customer-facing platforms, artificial intelligence, automation, risk operations, or foundational technology platforms is a plus. Experience in a regulated industry such as gaming, fintech, payments, or insurance is a plus. Join Our Team We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role. The US base salary range for this full-time position is 136,000.00 USD - 170,000.00 USD, plus bonus, equity, and benefits as applicable. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. title: Site Logistics Operations Performance Leader
jd_text: At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet. Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place. About You and This Role Dow has an exciting opportunity for a Site Logistics Operations Performance Leader at our Texas Operations site in Freeport, Texas. In this role, you will provide leadership within a chemical manufacturing environment and support logistics operations responsible for the safe loading, unloading, storage, transfer, and movement of multiple chemical products. The successful candidate will possess a strong manufacturing operations background and a demonstrated ability to lead people, develop capability, and improve performance in a process-driven operating environment. You will partner closely with Production facilities, Maintenance, Engineering, and Technical resources to drive safe, reliable, and efficient site logistics operations. This role plays a critical part in ensuring operational excellence across process safety, environmental performance, productivity, reliability, and cost. The successful candidate will be a visible leader in the field, actively engaging with frontline personnel and coaching teams to strengthen operational discipline, improve management systems, reduce unplanned events, and deliver sustainable business results. Responsibilities Lead frontline operations performance across site logistics activities, including chemical loading, unloading, storage, transfer, and transportation support activities. Develop and maintain a strong safety culture through visible leadership, coaching, mentoring, and active engagement with operations personnel. Drive operational discipline and compliance with process safety, environmental, regulatory, and operating requirements. Partner with production facilities to safely and reliably execute logistics activities that support manufacturing operations. Lead and develop operators, shift leaders, and technical personnel to achieve safe, reliable, and efficient daily operations. Strengthen team capability through coaching, mentoring, performance feedback, and knowledge sharing. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve safety, reliability, productivity, and cost performance. Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks associated with hazardous chemical handling and facility operations. Improve management systems, work processes, operating procedures, and operational standards to drive sustainable performance. Prioritize team resources and improvement efforts to maximize value creation and eliminate non-value-added work. Ensure effective corrective actions are implemented from self-assessments, audits, Root Cause Investigations (RCIs), KPI performance gaps, and operational learning events. Champion operational excellence through robust use of data, metrics, problem-solving tools, and risk-based decision making. Serve as, or develop the capability to serve as, the Facility Work Group Leader delegate. Partner with engineering, maintenance, production, and EH&S personnel to continuously improve operational performance. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Industrial Technology, or a related technical discipline, OR relevant military experience at or above a U.S. E-5 or Canadian Petty Officer 2nd Class/Sergeant ranking. A minimum of 5 years of manufacturing/operations experience in a chemical, petrochemical, refining, energy, industrial manufacturing, or similarly high-hazard operating environment. Understanding of process safety, operational discipline, risk management, and continuous improvement principles. Experience working in environments involving hazardous materials, hazardous energy sources, or complex industrial processes. A minimum requirement for this U.S.-based position is the ability to work legally in the United States. No visa sponsorship/support is available for this position, including for any type of U.S. permanent residency (green card) process. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Experience within chemical manufacturing, petrochemical manufacturing, refining, industrial gases, terminals, marine operations, bulk liquid handling, or industrial logistics operations. Experience leading shift teams, work groups, production units, logistics operations teams, or manufacturing organizations. Knowledge of Process Safety Management (PSM), Management of Change (MOC), Safe Work Processes, Root Cause Investigation (RCI), and risk assessment methodologies. Experience with production operations, maintenance, reliability, or operational excellence programs. Experience leading cultural transformation, capability-building, or operational improvement initiatives. Skills Operations Leadership: Builds highly engaged teams and consistently delivers safe, reliable, and productive operational performance through effective leadership and coaching. Process Safety and Risk Management: Understands and actively manages the risks associated with hazardous chemical operations, ensuring adherence to process safety and operational discipline requirements. Manufacturing Excellence: Applies operational management systems, performance metrics, and continuous improvement principles to drive sustainable operational results. Coaching and Development: Develops frontline personnel, operations leaders, and technical resources through mentoring, feedback, and capability building. Problem Solving: Effectively identifies root causes, addresses performance gaps, and implements sustainable corrective actions using data-driven decision making. Collaboration and Influence: Effectively influences and collaborates across multiple functions and organizational levels, building alignment among operations, engineering, maintenance, supply chain, and business teams to achieve common goals. Additional Information This position does not offer relocation assista nce. Benefits – What Dow offers you We invest in you. Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing. Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee: Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals. Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location). Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only). Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match. Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations. Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. Competitive yearly vacation allowance. Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents). Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured. Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey. On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location). Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more. Additionally, some of our locations might offer: Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location) Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location) Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location) Join our team, we can make a difference together. About Dow Dow (NYSE: DOW) is one of the world’s leading materials science companies, serving customers in high-growth markets such as packaging, infrastructure, mobility and consumer applications. Our global breadth, asset integration and scale, focused innovation, leading business positions and commitment to sustainability enable us to achieve profitable growth and help deliver a sustainable future. We operate manufacturing sites in 30 countries and employ approximately 36,000 people. Dow delivered sales of approximately $43 billion in 2024. title: Inventory Specialist | Day & Night Shift | $30.00hr
jd_text: Power your Thirst for More at DrinkPAK, where we revolutionize beverage manufacturing, driven by automation and sustainability. Together, through grit and innovation, we break new ground in record time by acquiring the most advanced technology and attracting the brightest talent. Our explosive growth and journey through uncharted territories offers unique career opportunities enabling passionate individuals to reach their full potential. To support our teams, we offer enriching lifestyle accounts, comprehensive benefits, formal development programs, and an energizing environment. Drive your success at DrinkPAK, where we refresh, hydrate and nourish the world and our employees alike. Base Hourly: $30hr ($2hr Shift Differential on Night Shift) SHIFT: Must be willing to work night shift; 12 hours per day, 2/2/3 Schedule POSITION DESCRIPTION : This position is responsible for maintaining the accuracy, integrity, and visibility of inventory within the facility. This role supports daily warehouse and production operations by verifying inbound and outbound materials, reconciling physical counts with system records, and identifying and resolving inventory discrepancies. The position requires strong attention to detail, knowledge of inventory systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally with warehouse, Kitting, Batching, production, and quality teams. ​ BENEFITS: The well-being of our team members is critically important to us. As part of this commitment, we offer: 100% PPO medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees, 50% for their dependents, paid by the Company A cell phone stipend 401(k) match program, pet insurance, life insurance, and more LOCATION: The position is based at DrinkPAK’s Texas Beverage Manufacturing Facility in Fort Worth, Texas. RESPONSIBILITIES Inspect and verify quality of all inbounds received by warehouse team, and report discrepancies. Manage real-time inventory transactions in our system. Execute daily, monthly, and quarterly inventory audits and cycle counts. Navigate company systems to track and confirm all inbound/outbound inventory. Process recycling and destruction loads systematically. Verify Proof of Delivery (POD) to ensure accurate inventory records. Maintain stock of finished goods, raw materials, and components per guidelines. Coordinate with receiving, production, and supply chain teams to ensure accuracy. Perform systematic material movements (Receiving → Inventory/WIP/Non-Conforming). Work with cross every department to ensure that we provide the inventory support needed. Closing FG jobs. Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, report findings. Identify expired or slow-moving inventory (SLOB) for disposition. Maintain proper product rotation (FIFO/FEFO compliance). Support special inventory projects as assigned. Ensure compliance with GMPs, safety standards, and company policies. Establishes and maintains high standards for quality, housekeeping and productivity Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of the job Interacts and maintains positive relationships with all levels of leadership Accomplishes special Inventory projects and other assignments/duties as required by management. Compliant to all safety rules and regulations, GMP’s and all Drink Pak’s policies and procedures. Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without prior notice. ​ QUALIFICATIONS High School Diploma or equivalent; Associate degree preferred. Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in Field or similar manufacturing / warehouse environment; 4+ years preferred; strong Inventory background and warehouse environment preferred. Forklift Certification preferred Bilingual (English & Spanish) preferred Strong project management, time management, organization, and communication skills Detail oriented and ability to problem solve and cross check documentation ABOUT DRINKPAK DrinkPAK is the premiere manufacturer of canned beverages in North America. As producers of the largest and fastest-growing alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in the world, DrinkPAK provides full-service support for procurement, batching, processing, filling, packaging, warehousing, and distribution. Founded in 2020, DrinkPAK has revolutionized canned beverage manufacturing by offering extreme capacity and format flexibility through cutting-edge technology and a commitment to the best talent in the industry. For more information, visit www.drinkpak.com. OUR VALUES Our company’s culture is guided by our shared values of Speed, Intensity, and Purpose. These values are demonstrated in the following ways among our Managers and above: Speed: Promptly identify and address potential issues or opportunities and be proactive in seeking solutions. Quickly consider the available information and weigh the risks and benefits to avoid unnecessary delays. Intensity: Embrace a growth mindset and recover from failures quickly, using them as opportunities to learn and improve. Focus on achieving measurable results and delivering value to the organization. Purpose: Set a positive example by demonstrating a strong work ethic, professionalism, and a commitment to our values. Create an environment where teamwork and collaboration are valued by encouraging cross-functional collaboration and knowledge sharing among team members. WORKING CONDITIONS The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee is frequently required to sit, stand walk, talk, hear, see, reach, bend, reach with arms and hands, stoop, squat, work onsite, be in-person daily and via video conferencing (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, etc.), and telephonically. The employee is frequently required to lift up to 50lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

jd_text: Job Description: Cyber Security Analyst (Technical Solutions Delivery) - Austin Realtor Role Overview The Cyber Security Analyst supports enterprise cybersecurity operations, focusing on vulnerability management, cloud security, DevSecOps, and cyber project delivery. The role partners with Cyber, Engineering, and IT teams to identify and prioritize security risks, coordinate remediation, support security tooling and automated controls, and develop metrics and dashboards that track risk reduction and program effectiveness. The role reports to the GRC Manager. The role requires a strong understanding of cloud technologies, technical cybersecurity frameworks, and DevSecOps processes. Key Functions of this role include: 1. Vulnerability Management & Remediation Track technical remediation to completion by working directly with engineering, Cyber, and IT teams on patching, risk reduction and mitigation strategies. Support routine vulnerability scanning across AWS cloud environments, microservices, endpoints, and internal infrastructure. Coordinate the remediation of technical findings against standards like AWS CIS Benchmarks and cloud configuration baselines. 2. Junior Solutions Architecture & DevSecOps Coordinate security architecture reviews, vendor risk remediation and enterprise security solutions deployment (including EDR, IAM, Data Security, and Cloud Security). Assist in integrating automated security controls and scanning into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and DevSecOps pipelines. Help maintain security baselines and guide developers with technical configurations for IaC and EKS and ECS deployments. 3. Cyber Project Delivery & Operations Coordinate and track the execution of key cybersecurity projects (e.g., IAM, Vulnerability and Issue remediation, expanding logging and monitoring, third-party risk remediation). Utilize Jira and project tracking tools to automate workflows, maintain clear project schedules, and ensure cross-functional alignment. Build simple, meaningful dashboards and metrics to track risk reduction, patch status, and project delivery milestones. Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of secure software development lifecycle. Foundational knowledge of cloud infrastructure (specifically AWS), microservice architectures, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts. Experience with cloud security posture management (Wiz), endpoint security, and integrating cyber tools in the CI/CD pipelines. Application Development background is a nice-to-have (Java, Python, or other related development experience is a strong plus). Delivery & Execution: Strong project tracking and organization skills, with hands-on experience using Jira or similar tools for automation and task management. Ability to translate complex technical risks into clear, actionable tasks for IT and developer teams. Education and Certification Requirements: Bachelor's or Associate degree in computer science, cybersecurity, Management Information Systems, or a related field of study. 1–3 years of experience in Cybersecurity, IT Engineering, or DevSecOps. CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or Network+, or CCSP AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (good to have). The ideal candidate will have foundational knowledge of SAP modules, including MM, SD, FI/CO, and PP, as well as hands-on programming experience and an interest in learning ABAP and other AI systems . This role includes gathering requirements, supporting implementations, and helping ensure the SAP environment supports business objectives. In addition this role will also be focused on managing the interfaces between our SAP ERP (PP/MM) , Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) , and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). You will maintain seamless communication between the digital warehouse floor and shop floor machines, resolving daily operational issues and conducting critical system testing. This position offers an excellent path to develop deeply technical skills in smart factory automation and integrated supply chains. ​BENEFITS: The well-being of our team members and their families is critically important to us. As part of this commitment, we offer: PPO medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees AND their dependents, 100% paid by the Company A cell phone stipend Annual discretionary bonus 401(k) match program, pet insurance, life insurance, and more RESPONSIBILITIES Triage Shop Floor Issues: Troubleshoot day-to-day transactional, network, and data flow failures between the MES layer and SAP PP/EWM. Interface Monitoring: Actively monitor IDocs, queue errors (qRFC), and API message brokers that sync warehouse staging with MES production lines. Device Troubleshooting: Resolve data entry errors coming from RF mobile scanners, plant floor terminals, and automated labeling systems. SLA Compliance: Document, track, and close entry-level support incidents using service management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow) within required deadlines. Test Case Development: Write clear, step-by-step test scripts for minor SAP/MES system enhancements, bug fixes, and patch releases. Testing Execution: Conduct Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and Regression Testing to verify that warehouse movements successfully trigger MES events. UAT Support: Coordinate with shop floor power-users to facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and log configuration defects. Master Data Validation: Review and update fundamental master data setups, including SAP storage bins, production versions, BOMs, and MES routing configurations. Write SOPs: Document testing results and build standard operating procedures (SOPs) to help production operators avoid recurring system errors. Exposure to SAP Solution Manager, SAP BTP, or cloud-based SAP services. Prior experience using test tracking tools is highly preferred. Basic understanding of data communication interfaces (IDocs, XML, or RFC queues) Soft Skills: Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills. jd_text: Join us in creating a better way! At eHealth, our mission is to expertly guide consumers through their health insurance and related options when, where, and how they prefer. Move your career forward while connecting countless people to the life- changing, quality care they deserve. The Sr. Analytics & Insights Analyst will serve as a key strategic partner to cross-functional business leaders, translating complex data into meaningful business intelligence that drives critical decision-making. This role is responsible for leading high-impact analytical initiatives, optimizing business performance across Sales, Marketing, and Operations, and mentoring junior analysts. The ideal candidate combines deep analytical expertise with business acumen, thrives in a dynamic environment, and demonstrates the ability to distill data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for senior executives. What you'll do: • Lead analytical initiatives that support enterprise-level strategic priorities, including sales performance optimization, customer acquisition and retention strategy, and channel attribution modeling. • Partner closely with business stakeholders to define analytical goals and requirements, and translate ambiguous business questions into structured, data driven analysis. • Design and develop advanced analytical models using statistical and predictive techniques (e.g., regression, clustering, classification, time series forecasting) to evaluate performance and inform business strategies. • Create and manage KPI dashboards and reporting tools that provide real-time visibility into the performance of marketing campaigns, sales channels, and customer cohorts. • Mentor junior analysts, reviewing their work for analytical rigor, clarity, and business relevance. • Transform large, complex datasets into actionable insights, clearly communicating findings through storytelling and visualizations using BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Excel). • Collaborate with data engineering teams to define data architecture and pipelines that align with analytical and reporting needs. • Conduct deep-dive analyses on customer behaviors, product performance, and retention activity effectiveness to uncover trends and provide recommendations. What you'll bring: • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or technical field (e.g., Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science). jd_text: What’s Under the Hood DriveTime Family of Brands includes in-house financing and servicing through Bridgecrest, which is one of the country’s leading financial servicing providers. Bridgecrest services roughly $25+ billion in finance receivables for DriveTime and other third parties. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for hire at this time. In short, as a Senior Analyst, Strategic Analytics you will own the end-to-end analytics across the full lifecycle of your project. You will apply analytical and strategic skills as you initiate, build, and develop the business case for major initiatives. Every insight you generate has a direct, measurable impact. This isn't just a reporting role, it's also a strategy role. In long, our analysts are responsible for: Formulating, developing and instituting business strategies to drive company profit. Identifying, tracking, and forecasting main drivers and transactions of the organization. Partnering with product, tech, data science, and operations to implement data driven strategies and decision engines Bringing the strategy to life: our analysts are responsible for analyzing and developing the full life cycle of a project including implementation/execution Driving large analytical initiatives to reveal step-change improvements in operational and transaction profitability of the business. Effectively communicate with concise insights and/or visualizations utilizing software such as Tableau, Sigma, or Streamlit while partnering collaboratively with colleagues and senior leaders in the organization. Leveraging emerging technologies and critical thinking skills to continually innovate and automate existing methodologies, processes, and reporting. Design, develop, test, and implement new products and solutions. So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking for? Intellectual curiosity. Why? What? How? Do you find yourself always wanting to learn more and broaden your knowledge base? If so, this could be the role for you. Passionate and goal-oriented. We are looking for someone that is enthusiastic about their work and is passionate about not only meeting their goals but exceeding them. Killer analytical and reporting abilities. You’ll need the capability to analyze data and in return, prepare timely reports on your findings. Master multi-tasker. We are looking for someone that is not only good at multi-tasking but thrives in it. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. The ability to talk and write with confidence, charisma and competence for a wide variety of audiences including management. A mind for the details. Okay we know “detail-oriented” is on about every job description – but we really mean it! The Specifics. Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as economics, engineering, finance, statistics, mathematics, or hard science. 3+ years’ experience in analytics, engineering, consulting, or marketing Advanced SQL and Excel skills Experience with data visualization tools Nice to Haves. Python Auto finance experience Familiarity with CRM platforms (i.e. Pega) So What About the Perks? This position has an on-site expectation of a minimum of three days a week. Medical, dental, and vision, oh my! DriveTime Family of Brands covers a sizable amount of insurance premiums to ensure our employees receive top-tier healthcare coverage. But Wait, There’s More. 401(K), Company paid life insurance policy, short and long-term disability coverage to name a few. Growth Opportunities. You grow, I grow, we all grow! But seriously, DriveTime Family of Brands is committed to providing its employees with every opportunity to grow professionally with roughly over 1,000 employees promoted year over year. For our Part-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available - the more you work, the more you earn! Anything Else? Absolutely. DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. approval process Ensure approved plan changes are accurately documented and communicated Sales Processes and Technology Identify opportunities to simplify sales workflows and reduce administrative effort Gather business requirements for Salesforce enhancements, reporting, and automation Maintain process documentation and support consistent adoption across sales teams Coordinate deal approval workflows with Sales, Finance, and Legal Support accurate handoffs from Sales to implementation and Client Service Enablement and Collaboration Partner with Sales Enablement on training related to sales processes, reporting, and CRM use Support new-hire onboarding through territory information, reporting access, and operational guidance Provide data and operational support for sales kickoffs and other planning activities Build effective relationships across regional sales teams and supporting functions Manage competing requests transparently and prioritize work according to business needs teams or working in supply chain technology, enterprise integration, manufacturing, or logistics is very highly preferred Hands-on experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, reporting, title: Regional Director
jd_text: Job Description The Regional Director, Store Operations is responsible for leading a high-performing team of District Managers to drive operational excellence, profitable sales growth, talent development, and exceptional customer experiences across an assigned region. This role provides leadership and accountability for the financial, operational, merchandising, and people performance of all stores within the region. Reporting directly to the Zone Vice President, the Regional Director serves as the senior operational leader for the region, translating zone strategy into execution through a team of District Managers. This role partners closely with Human Resources, Asset Protection, Real Estate, Store Support Center teams, and other cross-functional partners to drive operational consistency, profitable growth, and talent development while ensuring Dollar Tree standards are consistently executed across the region. Principal Duties & Responsibilities Operational Leadership & Execution Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of District Managers responsible for achieving sales, profitability, operational, and customer service objectives. Execute zone priorities and strategic initiatives while ensuring consistent execution across all stores within the region. Drive consistent execution of company programs, operational initiatives, merchandising standards, and store processes. Conduct regular business reviews to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and implement action plans to improve results. Ensure stores maintain high standards of presentation, merchandising, inventory management, signage, and operational excellence. Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement throughout the region. Provide regular updates and business insights to the Zone Vice President regarding sales performance, operational opportunities, talent needs, and market conditions. Financial Management & Business Performance Maintain full P&L accountability for the assigned region, including sales, payroll, expenses, shrink, and profitability. Analyze key business metrics and company reporting to identify trends, opportunities, and performance gaps. Develop and execute strategies to drive profitable sales growth while effectively managing expenses and operating costs. Ensure District Managers effectively utilize reporting and analytics to identify business outliers and improve store performance. Build financial acumen within the field leadership team through coaching, business reviews, and performance management. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership Recruit, develop, and retain top talent at all levels within the region. Create succession plans and leadership development strategies to build a strong pipeline of future District Managers and Store Managers. Coach and mentor District Managers to strengthen leadership capabilities, operational expertise, and business acumen. Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, and organizational development initiatives. Facilitate leadership meetings, town halls, onboarding programs, and development sessions as needed to support business objectives. Merchandising & Customer Experience Partner with the Zone Vice President and Zone Operations Director to ensure effective execution of merchandising initiatives and sales-driving programs. Drive operational and merchandising consistency across all stores while maintaining Dollar Tree’s value, convenience, and discovery shopping experience. Ensure stores deliver a high level of customer service through strong leadership presence, associate engagement, and operational execution. Identify and communicate field opportunities that support sales growth, operational efficiencies, and customer satisfaction. Asset Protection, Compliance & Inventory Integrity Foster a strong shrink-awareness culture and ensure effective execution of asset protection programs across the region. Partner with Asset Protection and Risk Management teams to reduce loss, improve compliance, and protect company assets. Maintain accountability for inventory integrity, inventory controls, and operational compliance standards. Ensure stores operate in compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements. Strategic Growth & Cross-Functional Partnership Support the Zone Vice President in executing strategic growth plans, market expansion initiatives, organizational development efforts, and operational priorities across the region. Partner with Real Estate teams to identify opportunities for new stores, relocations, expansions, and market growth. Collaborate with Store Support Center partners to ensure effective communication, issue resolution, and execution of company priorities. Serve as a key voice of the field by providing insights and recommendations that support continuous business improvement. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience. 5+ years of progressive multi-unit retail leadership experience in a high-volume, fast-paced environment. Proven track record of driving sales growth, operational excellence, and profitability across multiple locations. Demonstrated success leading, developing, and coaching field leadership teams. Strong financial acumen with experience managing P&L performance and business analytics. Experience leading through change and executing large-scale operational initiatives. Strong communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and other business systems and reporting tools. Ability to travel extensively throughout the assigned region. Preferred Qualifications Discount retail, grocery, convenience, big box, or specialty retail experience preferred. Experience managing large geographic territories and complex multi-unit operations. Proven ability to build high-performing teams and develop future leaders. Strong understanding of merchandising, inventory management, asset protection, and workforce planning. Start Rate = $135,000-$160,000 based on experience plus bonus and equity. The company offers Health, Dental, & Vision, a flexible spending account, life and disability insurance benefits, a 401k plan, PTO, paid holidays annually, and an employee stock purchase plan. title: Senior Data Analyst - Dow Jones Energy Product Management
jd_text: Job Description: About the Team: Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition. Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets. About the Role: This is an exciting time to join our small but growing Commercial Product Management team where you will be supporting a number of key sectors including: Energy & Feedstocks, Coal, Metals and Mining, Renewables & Clean Energy and Chemicals. We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to support business performance, revenue management, customer analytics, sales operations, product strategy, and executive decision-making. The position requires a combination of advanced Excel, SQL, Python, business intelligence, financial analysis, data visualization, and strong business judgment. You will work across large and complex datasets to develop reporting, dashboards, analytical models, and actionable insights for product and leadership teams. You are comfortable working independently on ambiguous analytical problems, reconciling data from multiple sources, automating recurring processes, and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also serve as a key analytical partner to the Product, Sales, Finance, Customer Care, Consulting, and leadership teams. You will report to the Vice President - Product Management. You Will: Commercial & Revenue Optimization: Own end-to-end reporting for the Book of Business (ACV, renewals, new business, win/loss), building bottoms-up financial models, scenario analyses, and churn diagnostics to drive pricing, budgeting, and revenue retention strategies Advanced Data Engineering & SQL: Query, transform, and aggregate complex datasets across multiple source systems using optimized SQL to resolve data discrepancies and ensure unified, cross-system reporting integrity Data Quality & Governance: Establish rigorous validation processes, data cleansing protocols, and repeatable quality assurance checks to maintain accuracy and reliability across all core business metrics Business Intelligence & Dashboards: Design and maintain scalable, user-friendly Power BI/Looker Studio dashboards that deliver actionable visibility into product performance, sales activity, customer health, and financial KPIs for non-technical stakeholders Process Automation & AI Integration: Streamline recurring workflows using SQL, Python, Excel/VBA, and Power Query, while exploring AI/BigQuery solutions to scale self-service analytics and reduce manual reporting dependencies Customer & Usage Behavioral Analytics: Synthesize product adoption, API/web activity, and usage data into customer health scores and engagement metrics that empower Sales and Account Management teams to mitigate churn Risk Product Portfolio Strategy: Conduct product performance and entitlement analyses to evaluate pricing packages, support new product launches, and inform portfolio optimization or sunsetting initiatives Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as a strategic analytics partner across Sales, Finance, Product, and executive leadership, effectively communicating complex methodologies and managing ad-hoc analytical priorities to guide business decisions You Have: 3+ years’ professional experience in data analytics, commercial analytics, financial analysis, market research, or a related analytical role Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; including complex formulas, PivotTables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, nested logic, and data manipulation, VBA, Excel Macros, or Power Query Experience with some or all of the following technologies: Python (particularly Pandas and data analysis/automation) BigQuery, Snowflake, SQL Server, Athena, or other cloud/data warehouse platforms Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar BI platforms Experience with B2B data/information, industry analysis, and/or applied software products (highly desirable) Domain knowledge in chemicals/energy or other related industry areas An interest to pursue a career in product management and want to leverage your existing analytical skill set title: NPI Supplier Engineer III
jd_text: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: $96,000.00 - $132,000.00 Location: Austin,TX You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . Key Responsibilities Work with New Product Development teams to ensure the integrity and clarity of engineering drawing requirements and that all expectations are communicated effectively to supporting suppliers. Participation with New Product Introduction teams to ensure suppliers are involved in the development and review of specifications to promote design for manufacturability. Continuous involvement in the Supplier Selection Process to develop a supply base that provides competitive advantage in quality, value/cost, delivery and technology. Performing the supplier technical audit process and evaluating supplier performance and capability, drive continuous improvement opportunities at supplier. Performing quality problem resolutions and incident management, drive root cause and correction action. Evaluates technical requirements of new and existing products. Applies knowledge of qualified sources and products to recommend materials to Design Engineering, which would result in savings, lead time reductions, system improvements, increased life and/or mitigated risk. Assist in cost planning by monitoring key cost drivers, supply markets, to ensure a competitive advantage. Support product development and improvement teams by sourcing new technologies from qualified suppliers. title: Engineering Manager, Sustaining- Enabling Technologies
jd_text: Who We Are ABOUT ENOVIS™ Enovis Corporation (NYSE: ENOV) is an innovation-driven medical technology growth company dedicated to developing clinically differentiated solutions that generate measurably better patient outcomes and transform workflows. Powered by a culture of continuous improvement, global talent and innovation, the Company’s extensive range of products, services and integrated technologies fuels active lifestyles in orthopedics and beyond. For more information about Enovis, please visit www.enovis.com . What You'll Do Job Description: At Enovis™ we sweat the little things. We embrace collaboration with our partners and patients, and we glory in the grind of scientific excellence — with the goal of transforming medical technology as we know it. Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. As a key member of the Enabling Technologies Team, you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward through transforming patient care and creating better patient outcomes. Job Title: Engineering Manager, Sustaining- Enabling Technologies Reports To: Director, R&D Product Development Location: Austin, TX Business Unit Description: Enabling Technologies Job Title/High Level Position Summary: The Manager, Base Business directs the sustaining engineering activities for the Enabling Technologies business unit. In addition to managing product development resources, the Manager individually contributes to development efforts. This includes but is not limited to creating prototypes, testing, and documenting test results; scheduling, coordinating, and managing multiple projects; and communicating with vendors to ensure proper design transfer. The Manager will be responsible for products including mechanical surgical instrumentation, electronic hardware, and software used by electronic hardware. Key Responsibilities: Manage project prioritization and resource allocation Mentor direct reports by providing technical guidance, coaching, performance management, and professional development opportunities Participate in product development including concept, generation, decision matrices, prototype, manufacture, and associated metrics Provide expert product leadership for the development projects assigned; this includes an unrelenting attention to minimizing project delays and resource overages Creates product designs and documentation used to substantiate those devices (i.e. risk assessments, verification/validation activities, design review documentation, etc.) Develops detailed engineering drawings using 3-D Modeling to document designs and design changes (SolidWorks) Confers with cross-functional team to identify tasks and requirements (Product Development, Manufacturing Engineers, Quality Engineers, Marketing, Purchasing and Regulatory Affairs) Maintains all documentation necessary for a Design History File (DHF), including Design Input Documents, Design Validation Plans/Reports, Test Protocols/Reports, and Design Input/Output Matrix. Assist in the regulatory submission process(FDA 510k, EU MDR, TGA, PMDA) by providing official information for regulatory review Minimum Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline 8+ years of professional experience (6+ years with a Masters degree)in a regulated industry Experience in medical device product development Experience with enabling technology (pre operative planning, navigation, robotics) preferred. Familiarity with software development processes Prior experience applying mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis. Prior experience defining problems, collecting data, establishing facts, and drawing valid conclusions. Prior experience interpreting an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and dealing with several abstract and concrete variables. Must be experienced in MS Word, Excel and Project. Experience with 3D CAD packages (SolidWorks preferred) Working knowledge and requirements of ISO 13485 and 21CFR820. Travel Requirements: <5% of travel required Desired Characteristics: Previous experience managing engineers Previous experience developing orthopedic medical devices(either implant development or enabling technology used with orthopedic implants) Previous experience leading projects of moderate to large scope and complexity Work Environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to the manufacturing environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to the office environment. Employee is expected to work in varying environments, including office setting, mechanical testing lab, and cadaver lab. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to sit and use hands to operate computer keyboard, and telephone. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. This position works in a typical office/manufacturing/warehouse environment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Perform job duties for 8 or more hours a day. “Creating better together”. It’s the Enovis purpose, and it’s what drives us and empowers us every day on a global scale. We know that the power to create better – for our customers, our team members, and our shareholders – begins with having the best team, pursuing common goals, operating at the highest levels, and delivering extraordinary outcomes. Watch this short video and discover what creating better together means to us at Enovis: Our Enovis Purpose, Values and Behaviors on Vimeo We offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes: Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Spending and Savings Accounts 401(k) Plan Vacation, Sick Leave, and Holidays Income Protection Plans Discounted Insurance Rates Legal Services EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Enovis provides equal employment opportunities based on merit, experience, and other work-related criteria without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, sex, age, pregnancy, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We also strive to provide reasonable accommodation to employees’ beliefs and practices that do not conflict with Enovis policies and applicable law. We value the unique contributions that every employee brings to their role with Enovis.

title: Blackstone Program Director for Educational Operations
jd_text: <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Make a difference with us! At Alliance Defending Freedom, we believe God has brought you here for His purpose—to stand for truth and defend the God-given right to live and speak it. Together, we protect religious freedom, free speech, the sanctity of life, marriage and family, and parental rights. Review our <a href="https://adflegal.org/about-us/careers/statement-of-faith/" target="_blank">Statement of Faith</a> to ensure we’re a fit for you.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif; color: rgb(35, 111, 161);"><strong><span style="color: rgb(0, 48, 87);">Locations:</span>&nbsp;</strong><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Lansdowne, VA / Dallas, TX</span></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif; color: rgb(0, 48, 87);"><strong>Team Overview</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">The Blackstone Program Director for Educational Operations is a dynamic leader responsible for helping the VP of Philosophy and Education plan and run the Blackstone Legal Fellowship’s flagship educational event, the summer program, as well as its alumni educational offerings. The role is integral to planning and executing on our educational events, and to ensuring that each interaction with the summer program and alumni educational offerings—whether for interns, Blackstone Fellows, ministry friends, faculty, or special guests—is impactful, memorable, and aligned with our mission.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif; jd_text: Job Title: Lead Technical Program Manager, ADM (Burnet, TX) Job Description: The Role Entegris is currently seeking a Lead, Technical Program Manager to join our Advanced Depositions Materials team, at our Burnet, TX Facility. The Technical Program Manager (TPM) is responsible for driving Advanced Deposition Materials (ADM) New Product Introductions (NPIs) from concept through release to high volume manufacturing. This role serves as the technical execution owner, ensuring alignment across Business Development, R&D, Engineering, Operations, and Manufacturing to deliver ADM products that meet customer requirements for performance, quality, and scalability. This is a hybrid opportunity, and the hired individual will be required to have regular on-site presence at our Burnet, TX Facility. What You’ll Do Drive New Product Introduction’ from concept/feasibility through release to High Volume Manufacturing (HVM) ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business priorities. Define, track, manage, and report New Product Introduction PI milestones (sampling, development, HVM) Identify and mitigate technical and executions risks across development and execution phases. Coordinate cross functional execution to meet customer requirements, quality, and scale Drive standardization of product development processes, tools, and best practices. Identify process gaps and implement improvements to increase efficiency, quality, and scalability. Promote data‑driven decision‑making and structured problem‑solving. Aid in crafting customer communications to balance customer requirements, effective marketing of products, and strategic protection of information to maintain competitive advantage Manage complex, high-impact programs that are critical to the business or customer What We Seek A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in chemistry, Engineering, Materials Science, or related degree/discipline is required 8+ years of direct experience with technical projects and strong understanding of engineering workflows, development of lifecycles, or manufacturing processes. Preferred experience with advanced deposition technologies and/or new product development within semiconductor fabrication or related high-technology manufacturing environments. Strong project management skills, including but not limited to, risk assessment and mitigation, conflict management, meeting management, task management, stakeholder management & project closure Strong written & verbal communication skills Strong stakeholder management skills and experience coordinating cross-functional teams. Ability to translate technical ambiguity into clear execution plans. Why Work at Entegris Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. title: EMS Systems Analyst Sr
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career. ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future. Performs systems maintenance and improvement activities to support the effectiveness of the Grid and Market Solutions (GMS) suite of systems and applications. The suite includes ICCP/SCADA, Energy Management System (EMS), Voltage and Transient Stability (VSAT/TSAT) systems, PMU System, Itron Load Forecasting System, Operator Training Simulator (OTS), Data Historian (PI), Network Model Management System (NMMS), Market Management System (MMS), Outage Scheduler (OS), Congestion Revenue Rights (CRR) System, Grid Planning systems, Resource Integration system and Control Room Situational Awareness tools. This role plans and executes system software upgrades, configurations, application software release installations, and performs non-functional testing of GMS systems and applications. This position maximizes system uptime and mitigates GMS system failures. This role will analyze user requirements, procedures, and problems to automate or improve systems. Reviews computer system capabilities, workflows, and scheduling limitations. Design systems solutions to help the organization operate more efficiently and effectively. Provides 24x7 technical support for GMS systems on a rotational basis. Responsible for the integration of GMS systems and applications, monitoring, and regular maintenance of the GMS systems’ environments and derived systems. Responsible for planning, deploying, and managing containerized GMS applications utilizing CI/CD integration tools. JOB DUTIES Understands and apply principles, theories and concepts related to the profession and ERCOT's culture. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Impact is generally limited to specific assignments or projects. May respond to inquiries and/or provide assistance and/or guidance to lower-level workers. ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES Routinely monitors GMS systems and applications, as well as regular maintenance activities Coordinates and performs database updates and upgrades in the GMS environments Assists Operations Engineering, Market Operations, and other business units during acceptance testing of new and/or enhanced applications Supports effective use and administration of GMS systems and applications by preparing and reviewing technical documentation Performs patch implementations and migrations in the GMS systems Performs system setup and testing with Market Participants as appropriate Responds to system failures and operator questions on a 24/7 on-call rotation Works with market participants to resolve problems and implement changes Performs emergency recovery and troubleshooting of GMS systems and applications Develops and maintains strong computer skills including in common business applications such as Excel, Word, and Access Works on all aspects of GMS applications, including implementing new technologies and participating in the development of standards and processes to ensure effective administration and maintenance Maintains real-time data collection to support GMS systems and applications Maintains, troubleshooting, and repairs the GMS systems, applications, and interfaces Troubleshoots GMS system issue utilizing system data metrics such as CPU, memory, and NFS storage consumption Proactively identifies design problems and drives resolution Participates in GMS Disaster Recovery Drills Tests, certifies, and implements changes to the Production and Test environments Level 3 – Above + Interfaces with ERCOT QSEs on a regular basis to perform communication tests and support Analyzes system performance and recommends business enhancements Represents GMS Production Department at interdepartmental meetings Works with vendors to clarify GMS systems capabilities and requirements; understands the vendor's needs, and resolves issues that may arise as the vendors work to make changes and improvements Senior – Above + Performs systems maintenance and improvement activities to support the effectiveness of the GMS Participates in planning and evaluating the impact of system modifications and maintenance activities Plans, deploys, and supports containerized GMS applications utilizing CI/CD integration tools (Ansible, Jenkins, Jfrog and Github etc.). Enhance GMS systems and application monitoring utilizing various monitoring tools to improve GMS systems’ reliability Trains and supports users on all aspects of the GMS and related applications Participate in industry meetings and discussions related to GMS technologies to maintain and expand knowledge that is applied on the job May provide training or oversee the work of less experienced systems analyst May act as mentor and advisor to less experienced engineers/analysts Works independently on assignments and projects Participate in multifunctional teams to obtain input, address comments, and perform studies Assists in developing tools, processes, and procedures that enhance system reliability and departmental/organizational efficiencies Participates with other ERCOT departments to select and implement system changes as needed All Levels - Preferred Work Experience Experience with one of the vendors (GE, Siemens, Hitachi Energy/ABB, Resource Innovations, OSI Inc) Energy Management System (EMS) or Market Management System (MMS) or Outage Management Systems and applications preferred AVEVA Pi Historian Applications and Web Tools Power industry experience in grid and market arena preferably with software vendors or ISO/utilities Experience with XML, Java, CSS/HTML, JSON and Web Technologies Experience with Oracle PL/SQL Experience with Azure/AWS cloud technologies Experience with developing integration layers using Messaging Services: Tibco JMS, AMQ Experience with programming languages such as FORTRAN, C, C++, Java, Perl, and Python All Levels - Preferred Skills Requirement Programming Languages/Packages/Scripting: C, C++, Java, Perl, Python, PL/SQL, Shell Scripting Operating System: Windows, Linux Database: Oracle, SQL Server Source Code Control Tools: Git, GitHub CI/CD Tools (Github, Jenkins, Ansible, Jfrog etc.) Change Management and Defect Tracking Tools – Jira, qTest etc. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Level 2 Analyst: Requires minimum 1 year job-related work experience in excess of degree requirements. Requires minimum 1 year related work experience in one of the following areas: Energy Management System (EMS)/ICCP/SCADA, Market Management System (MMS), Outage Management Systems, Linux OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, OSI soft PI, or creating dashboards on Linux/Windows Platforms Level 3 Analyst: Requires minimum 3 years’ job-related work experience in excess of degree requirements. Requires minimum 3 years related work experience in one of the following areas: Energy Management System (EMS)/ICCP/SCADA, Market Management System (MMS), Outage Management Systems, Linux OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, OSI soft PI, or creating dashboards on Linux/Windows Platforms Senior Level Analyst: Requires a minimum of 5 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements. Requires minimum 5 years related work experience in one of the following areas: Energy Management System (EMS)/ICCP/SCADA, Market Management System (MMS), Outage Management Systems, Linux OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, OSI soft PI, or creating dashboards on Linux/Windows Platforms Salary and level will be based on overall experience as determined by ERCOT. EDUCATION Bachelor's Degree: Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field (Required) Master's Degree: Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field (Preferred) or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge to a major in such fields is required WORK LOCATION – Taylor, TX: Employees will be required to be on-site in Taylor, TX at a minimum of 2 days per week, or more, as needed based on the business needs as determined by management Remote work is required to be performed from your Texas residence. title: Sr Workday Systems Analyst
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career. ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future. Works on a small Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) team that is responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ERCOT’s ERP product suite, which includes Workday Human Capital Management (HCM), Workday Financial Management, Workday Adaptive Planning, Workday Prism Analytics, Cornerstone OnDemand Learning Management System (LMS), and other applications (Contract Lifecycle Management, Exiger, Blackline, SuccessFactors, DocuSign). Works on broad cross-module and cross-platform functional areas. At the P3 level, this role serves as the primary technical authority and architectural lead across the ERP product suite, drives complex cross-module and cross-platform initiatives end-to-end, owns the design integrity and operational stability of the platform, and mentors P1 and P2 analysts on the team. Responsible for partnering with business stakeholders to pursue opportunities for greater efficacy and efficiency as well as to identify and resolve system issues. Provides consultation and support to SMEs and end-users of the ERP products through analysis, development, configuration, testing, promotion through environments, and change management. JOB DUTIES Understands and applies principles, theories and concepts related to the profession and ERCOT’s culture. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Impact extends across the ERP product suite and to multiple business functions; technical decisions made in this role set direction and standards for the broader IT ERP team. Provides day-to-day technical guidance, design review, and mentoring to P1 and P2 analysts on the team; coaches lower-level analysts through complex configuration, reporting, integration, and security work. ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES Architecture and design leadership: Define and shape the overall functional and business process architecture across the ERP product suite ensuring efficient and accurate design and configuration of the delivered solution. Serve as the primary technical authority on cross-module and cross-platform design decisions, combining expert-level proficiency in Workday and senior-level proficiency in Cornerstone OnDemand with deep understanding of HR, Finance, and Learning process architecture; translate broad and ambiguous requirements into deliverables and partner with HR and Finance functional analysts to align process design across departments. Release, delivery, and change management: Lead Workday release checklist process and complex issue resolution and post-release stabilization. Partner with HR and Finance business owners on Kainos Smart Test execution; lead defect triage for cross-module and high-severity defects. Sponsor and present major and high-risk changes at Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings; review and endorse changes presented by junior analysts; serve as a primary CAB representative and ensure change management and SDLC principles are applied across the ERP product suite. Reporting and analytics: Architect and lead the design of the reporting and analytics layer across the ERP product suite, including Workday Report Writer (Advanced, Matrix, Composite, and Search reports), calculated fields, BIRT report design files (authored in Workday Studio for report layout and formatting), Workday Prism Analytics datasets and dashboards, and Cornerstone Reporting. Lead the design of complex multi-source, audit-grade, and executive-facing reports; review and approve reports built by junior analysts; prepare scheduled and ad-hoc reports; set standards for report writing, calculated field design, and data governance; provide SMEs and junior analysts with report writing guidance, instructions, and documentation. Ensure data accuracy, security, and data privacy standards are met through reviews, testing, change management, routine data audits, and validation. Workday Prism Analytics: Administer the Prism environment — dataset design, transformations, dashboards, Discovery Boards, & security to deliver advanced analytics and reporting across HR and Finance. Set standards for Prism dataset modeling, naming, and governance; review and approve Prism work performed by junior analysts; partner with HR and Finance business owners on Prism roadmap and use case prioritization. Create, maintain, and execute Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) integrations for inbound and outbound data movement across all Workday functional areas; provide expertise on EIBs built by SMEs and junior analysts. Security architecture and configuration: Define and govern the Workday and Cornerstone security model — security groups, domains, business process security policies, role-based access, and Cornerstone constraints / OU permissions — in compliance with ERCOT policies and procedures. Administer the segregation-of-duties (SoD) framework, drive SoD compliance and remediation, and approve security configuration changes at CAB; review security work performed by junior analysts. Configure and maintain Workday business processes, condition rules, and notifications across all functional areas; architect and lead complex business-process redesigns that span multiple functional areas and that touch security, integrations, and reporting. Assess and make recommendations on the feasibility of security, business process, and reporting changes and their impact on data accessibility, business processes, audit posture, and downstream systems. Audit and regulatory compliance: Ensure adherence to and provide response to audit and regulatory requirements — SOX-equivalent financial controls, NERC CIP, and internal / external audits — including SoD reviews, security audits, audit log analysis, and remediation planning. Lead Kainos Smart Audit monitoring and findings response for SoD conflicts, security group / domain permission anomalies, configuration change control, and sensitive-data access across Workday tenants; serve a primary IT-ERP audit liaison and communicate effectively with SMEs, executives and external auditors. Cornerstone LMS architecture and administration: Administer ERCOT’s Cornerstone OnDemand environment — organizational units (OUs), learning objects, curricula, certifications, dynamic learning assignments, SCORM / AICC / xAPI content loads, custom reports, and security. Serve as technical contact for Cornerstone; partner with the Learning function on roadmap and platform decisions. Production support, operations, and vendor management: Own the production support function for the ERP product suite, including triage and resolution of the most complex, cross-module, and high-severity incidents escalated from others; conduct root-cause analysis and drive corrective action. Monitor recurring processes and scheduled jobs; perform regular application, systems, and administration tasks. Own third-party vendor escalations for Workday, Cornerstone, Kainos, and other ERP products. Manage change requests, and major project tasks in Jira; review and prioritize the team’s ServiceNow ticket queue; set and maintain technical and procedural documentation standards in Confluence (runbooks, configuration notes, integration design notes, post-mortems, and architectural decision records) and govern shared files in SharePoint and OneDrive in accordance with ERCOT records-management and data-classification standards. Mentoring, standards, and cross-team engagement: Provide day-to-day thought leadership, technical mentoring, and design review for junior analysts on the team and for HR- and Finance functional analysts and testers. Establish and maintain standards, guidelines, security policies, and quality assurance procedures for the ERP product suite; contribute to technical standards review. Partner with IT (Infrastructure, Identity, Information Security, and Data) to address system, interface, data, and vendor issues; represent the ERP team in cross-IT design forums. Maintain presence in the Workday Community and Cornerstone Success Center; participate in regional user groups and conference sessions; cultivate external peer networks at other Workday customers to benchmark and share approaches. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Requires minimum 5 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements, including at least 3 years of hands-on Workday and/or Cornerstone OnDemand configuration, administration, or development experience, and at least 1 year of demonstrated leadership on complex cross-module or cross-platform ERP initiatives. Requires deep knowledge of Workday HCM and Workday Financial Management business processes, expert-level proficiency in Workday best practices, senior-level proficiency in Cornerstone OnDemand or another major LMS, and excellent technical, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Combination of training and experience in information technology and business operations to incorporate business systems analysis, process analysis, EIB integration development, BIRT report design, security architecture, audit support, vendor oversight, and technical communication skills effectively into the role to maintain a high functioning ERP system. Preferred: experience with Workday Prism Analytics, Cornerstone LMS administration, audit support in a SOX-equivalent or NERC CIP environment, mentoring of junior analysts.
