title: Principal Partner  Engineer, SAARC (Based in Bangalore)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Bengaluru, India</li> <li>India</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Principal Partner Solution Engineer (PSE) is a high-impact, strategic technical sales leader&nbsp; responsible for end-to-end technical lifecycle and enablement of the assigned partners, managing both pre-sales and post-sales engineering activities. In this role, you will act as the single technical point of contact as the trusted advisory for your assigned partners, driving technical validation during the sales cycle, architecting their delivery readiness and ensuring ongoing Partner Success.</p> <p>The role focuses heavily on driving value-based solution selling to accelerate the adoption of Cloudflare platform with focus on One (SASE/SSE) and AI Infrastructure (Workers AI / AI Gateway). By cultivating deeply technical champions within the partner organization, aligning architectures to tangible business outcomes, optimizing post-sales delivery and building joint managed services offering, you will directly expand and influence the pipeline to maximize Partner-Influenced Opportunity (PIO) revenue.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <h3>1. Pre-Sales Engineering &amp; Champion Building</h3> <ul> <li>Technical Alignment, Discovery &amp; Enablement: Own the technical relationship with Partners to align on building joint Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies. Align, build, and accelerate partner technical capabilities, enabling them to lead deep technical discovery and architectural design to independently sell scalable solutions leveraging the Cloudflare Platform with a strong focus on AI and Cloudflare One (CF1).</li> <li>Technical Account Plan Ownership: Own and drive the end-to-end Technical Account Plan (TAP) for assigned strategic partners. Act as the primary architect mapping partner business goals to technical execution milestones, ensuring continuous alignment on CF1 and AI adoption targets.</li> <li>Building Technical Champions: Identify, enable, and cultivate key technical advocates and "Champions" within the partner organization to scale Cloudflare expertise independently, generate Partner-Influenced Opportunities (PIO), and empower them to deliver high-value professional services around Zero Trust and AI application security.</li> <li>Driving PIO via Next-Gen Architectures: Collaborate with sales teams to proactively source, qualify, and expand PIO through strategic architectural alignment, focusing on migrating legacy network architectures to CF1 and integrating secure AI solutions.</li> <li>Deal Support &amp; Qualification: Enable partners' technical validation, proof-of-concept (PoC), demo, pipeline generation, and pipeline acceleration capabilities. Identify joint pursuit accounts, facilitate strategic technical account planning, and deliver cutting-edge solution architecture sessions for Named Partners</li> </ul> <h3>2. Accelerate Services Delivery</h3> <ul> <li>ASD Partner Journey Ownership: Own the ASD partner journey to ensure partners possess the advanced capabilities required to deploy, manage, and support the Cloudflare platform and AI application workloads seamlessly.</li> <li>Joint Services Offering Acceleration with strong focus on CF1 and A1: Build and co-develop joint services catalogues with key partners, accelerating the creation and launch of their own Cloudflare-focused services offerings, managed CF1 SASE practices, and AI security assessments.</li> <li>Service Monetization &amp; Performance Metrics: Enable partners to embed CF1 and Workers AI capabilities into their own managed security portfolios to shorten time-to-market, protect client AI pipelines, and maximize profitability. Develop, manage, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and improve the effectiveness of these partner service deliveries</li> <li>Technical Account Management &amp; Architectural Health: Act as the escalated technical point of contact to ensure long-term architectural health, utilizing telemetry and proactive design to move the partner relationship from reactive to strategics for Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <h3>3. Automation AI Agents &amp; Continuous Innovation</h3> <ul> <li>Leverage Autonomous AI Tools: Champion the use of Cloudflare OS and AI tools (Agent PAT and Agent Echo) to automate standard, repeatable technical tasks, optimizing operational efficiency and freeing up bandwidth for high-touch, strategic partner engagements.</li> <li>AI &amp; CF1 Product Enhancement Feedback Loop: Engage partner champions in the Partner Technical Advisory Council (PTAC) to give them early access to beta software, capture raw product feedback, and drive joint co-innovation on CF1 features and emerging AI products.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Enablement: Participate in continuous cross-training programs to maintain peak proficiency in both pre-sales scoping and post-sales service deployment across the entire Cloudflare One and AI ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of technical, partner-facing experience (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Account Manager) in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or networking.</li> <li>Strong technical depth in Cloudflare One (CF1) or equivalent SASE/SSE architectures, Zero Trust, DNS, and application security, alongside hands-on familiarity with AI deployment, AI Gateway, LLM orchestration frameworks, or vector databases.</li> <li>Proven track record of developing technical talent or building "champion" programs within partner organizations, specifically driving adoption of complex cloud networks and AI technologies.</li> <li>Enterprise Architecture &amp; Project Management: Deep understanding of enterprise IT, multi-cloud, and hybrid cloud environment while managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage the technical lifecycle of a deal from initial pre-sales discovery and CF1/AI PIO generation through post-sale service delivery.</li> <li>Strong communication skills with a track record of presenting complex CF1 architectures and AI-driven use cases to partner leadership and technical teams alike.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. title: Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Skills</p> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in Sales Compensation Design in a fast-paced tech company or as a management consultant.</li> <li>Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and AI-augmented workflows - whether through prior comp design work, analytics, or strategic projects. title: Associate Vice President, Interoperability Engineering
jd_text: Become a part of our caring community The Associate VP, Interoperability Engineering devises an effective strategy for executing and delivering on IT business initiatives. The Associate VP, Interoperability Engineering requires a in-depth understanding of how organization capabilities interrelate across segments and/or enterprise-wide. The Associate Vice President, Technology Solutions – Interoperability Engineering serves as the enterprise technology leader responsible for advancing Humana's interoperability engineering strategy, platforms, and delivery capabilities. This role partners across business, technology, architecture, security, and operations organizations to define and execute the long-term vision for interoperability as a strategic enterprise capability. The AVP, Interoperability Engineering is accountable for engineering execution, data acquisition platform modernization, reusable platform services, and enterprise interoperability transformation initiatives. This leader will evolve interoperability beyond traditional data exchange by establishing scalable enterprise platforms, API ecosystems, automation capabilities, and developer services that enable both regulatory compliance and emerging business opportunities. Working within a highly matrixed environment, the AVP drives strategic planning, operational excellence, engineering modernization, and organizational capability development while ensuring technology investments align with enterprise priorities, architecture standards, and future regulatory direction. Key Responsibilities Technology Leadership Serve as the strategic technology leader for Interoperability Engineering, establishing vision, priorities, and execution strategies that align with enterprise objectives. Lead large-scale modernization and transformation initiatives while fostering a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. Interoperability Strategy & Platform Vision Define and execute the long-term interoperability roadmap, target architecture, and enterprise platform strategy. Expand interoperability capabilities beyond data exchange into reusable enterprise services including APIs, developer platforms, automation frameworks, data acquisition capabilities, and integration services. Anticipate regulatory and market trends, ensuring Humana is prepared to rapidly respond to evolving interoperability requirements. Engineering & Delivery Excellence Establish modern engineering practices, governance models, quality standards, and performance metrics that drive predictable delivery outcomes. Accelerate adoption of AI-enabled engineering solutions, automation, and DevSecOps practices across the software development lifecycle. Drive engineering efficiency and scalability through reusable services, standardized platforms, and automation capabilities. Platform Stewardship & Operational Excellence Own the health, resiliency, scalability, security, compliance, and operational performance of interoperability platforms and services. Establish platform governance, engineering standards, service management practices, and operational accountability across APIs, integrations, developer services, and data acquisition platforms. Ensure platforms are designed to support enterprise-scale growth, evolving regulatory requirements, and increased business demand. Develop measurable service-level objectives and operational performance indicators that support continuous improvement and business confidence. Enterprise Standards & Ecosystem Leadership Define, govern, and continuously evolve enterprise interoperability standards, integration frameworks, API management practices, and reusable platform patterns. Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Product, and business stakeholders to establish and maintain enterprise-wide interoperability capabilities. Lead Humana's adoption and advancement of industry standards and best practices, including FHIR, HL7, CAQH, and emerging interoperability technologies. Financial, Workforce & Vendor Governance Develop and execute workforce, investment, and sourcing strategies that strengthen Humana's long-term interoperability engineering capabilities. Build deeper internal technical expertise in strategic capability areas. Leverage strategic partners selectively to accelerate modernization, enhance capabilities, and provide specialized expertise while ensuring critical knowledge remains institutionalized within the organization. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership Build and lead a high-performing engineering organization focused on technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and customer-focused outcomes. Develop engineering leaders and associates through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and career development opportunities. Strengthen organizational depth in platform engineering, interoperability standards, cloud technologies, APIs, automation, and emerging technologies. Create an environment that attracts, develops, and retains top engineering talent while fostering continuous learning and professional growth. Use your skills to make an impact Required Technical Qualifications Proven success as a Healthcare Interoperability Expert HL7, FHIR, X12, CDA/CCDA Payer-Provider Integration Leadership Epic, Oracle/Cerner, Athena, eCW, Availity, PointClickCare Large IDN integration experience Modern Platform Engineering Cloud-native architecture APIs, Microservices, Event Streaming Enterprise-scale reliability and observability FHIR & Regulatory Expertise Healthcare Data Architecture AI-Enabled Automation Required Experience 8+ years of management experience in a large matrixed organization Possess 10+ years of progressive experience leading continuous improvement efforts, evaluating existing systems and implementing process improvements Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Pay Range The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $189,400 - $260,500 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance. Description of Benefits Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities. About Us About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com. ​ Equal Opportunity Employer It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

Use customer feedback, product data, quality inputs, and development findings to analyze product or experience issues and communicate recommendations to stakeholders. Ability to translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, priorities, and decision criteria. Working knowledge of Agile and Scrum development practices and effective collaboration with hardware, software, user experience, and engineering teams. Strong data analysis, structured problem-solving, and judgment when evaluating alternatives and recommending solutions. Effective written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences. Project leadership, organization, and results orientation across multiple teams and stakeholders. Customer centricity, learning agility, and digital fluency. Preferred: Knowledge of Unified Communications and Collaboration, enterprise video systems, audio systems, APIs, software platforms, or related technologies. Impact & Scope Impacts multiple teams through product planning recommendations, requirements, and cross-functional coordination. May act as a project or workstream leader, providing direction to team activities and facilitating information validation and team decision-making. Works independently on assigned initiatives within established portfolio strategy, policies, and practices. Escalates or seeks guidance when business issues require decisions beyond the role’s defined scope. Complexity Responds to moderately complex product and business issues within established guidelines. Works on problems of diverse complexity and scope, applying developed subject matter knowledge to identify and select appropriate solutions. Handles most unique situations independently and may seek advice for especially complex business decisions. Balances customer, technical, schedule, cost, quality, and business considerations across cross-functional initiatives. title: TACOM (RRAD): Computer Systems Analyst II (Contingency)
jd_text: Title: TACOM (RRAD): Computer Systems Analyst II (Contingency) Program Summary The U.S. Army Tank-automotive and Armaments Command (TACOM) sustains the Army’s mission to develop, acquire, field, and sustain ground combat, tactical, and support systems throughout their lifecycle. The program focuses on ensuring operational readiness, reliability, and safety of automotive and ground support equipment critical to Army operations. Under this contract, personnel provide maintenance, repair, overhaul, and sustainment support in accordance with Army technical manuals, safety standards, and performance requirements. Job Summary The Computer Systems Analyst II analyzes, designs, and supports information systems to meet TACOM mission and operational requirements. This role evaluates system performance, identifies improvements, and ensures that hardware, software, and network solutions function effectively and securely. This position works with limited supervision, performs moderately complex system analysis tasks, and may provide guidance to junior personnel. This position is contingent upon award Roles and Responsibilities Proposes and develops automated reports using the Logistics Modernization Program’s Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Enterprise Central Component (ECC), or the Workload Planning and Reporting Module or associated systems to improve data collection, reporting, analysis, and forecasting. Uses model-based software to analyze and prepare reports for analysis. Establishes rapport with production functions to analyze, verify, and correct workload data ensuring data availability of workload factors including parts, production orders, labor hours and timekeeping, schedules, etc. Maintains products and reports between LMP and manual and automated systems which establish, implement, maintain, and evaluate (a.) operating or mission programs of the depot; (b.) pertinent administrative or support programs of the depot; (c.) integration of the programs; and (d.) their interrelationships with the related support functions of the depot. Provides advice on the development, testing, and roll out decisions to depot personnel with input from independent contractors, higher headquarters, and Army guidance. Performs a variety of duties involving various automated supply systems supporting depot organizations and tenant activities. Works independently utilizing skills, knowledge, and abilities such as interview, use of appropriate analytical and investigative management techniques, systems and procedures analyses, forms and reports analysis, work simplifications, statistical analysis, ADP systems analysis, supply systems analysis and similar techniques in the study, development, evaluation, revision, or improvement of depot programs and procedures necessary for efficient and economical accomplishment. Incumbent may be requested to perform any one or all the following functions independently. Conducts studies and audits of depot performance, compliance, and progress toward improvement of objectives and efficiency in a variety of supply management programs. Management studies/audits involve a comprehensive evaluation of managerial and ADP systems functions resulting in a wide impact on depot organizations. Studies may be assigned or conducted on initiative of analysts and require an extensive knowledge of depot mission and supply functions and a thorough knowledge of the uses and potential uses of ADP systems and automation to interface with mission and supply systems accomplishment. Makes judgmental recommendations for changes in work/supply systems, sometimes recommending significant departure from established or regulatory procedures. Detailed study in draft form is submitted to supervisor for review and in final form to concerned management officials/depot commander, with analysis available for discussion, advice, and service upon implementation. Serves as consultant to management and staff elements concerning assigned supply systems and program problems and provide recommendations of solution based on own judgment. Serves as system analyst and advisor/consultant in the installation supply, property accountability, and equipment authorization and transportation management programs, in the design, development, and maintenance of new and existing systems/programs. Analyzes system processing problems and provides technical assistance to functional personnel to alleviate these problems. As assigned, represents the depot at higher command meetings to exchange information and coordinate functional program/system objectives, clarify depot policy and directives, and resolve controversial problems. Coordinate minor and complex design changes to supply systems and functional procedures with associated directorates on depot, with headquarters, and vendors to assure continuity and to enable trouble-free transitions. Serves as depot point of contact for each current assigned program and overall functional and system coordinator for program redesign and development through interface with Directorate of Information Management programmers and external system design agencies. Plans and coordinates statistical reporting and record keeping related to installation supply accounting and management, analyzes to detect deficiencies within the directorate and in supporting divisions, and other depot activities supporting the directorate. Reports findings and develop recommendations for procedural and regulatory changes using own judgment and knowledge of the system and regulations. Develops informative material detailing relating to such factors as organization or responsibility, correlation of activities, including those at higher echelons and control points, interpretation of new or revised regulations, etc. Presents material in written or charted form for dissemination or presents as a contribution for directorate of command presentations and meetings. Analyzes methods of attaining established program objectives and reviewing supply management systems. Develop guidelines and procedures to facilitate accomplishments. Develops training programs and provides instruction. Advises management and functional personnel on system requirements and limitations to systems to assist users in defining problems and needs. This requires a broad knowledge and understanding of logistics systems flow, terminology, and interrelationships with those systems (both local unique and standard) which interface with Army Material Command Installation Supply System (AMCISS), Standard Depot Systems (SDS) and other division Systems. Performs other duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications Education/Experience: High school diploma or GED. Must be computer literate and proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Power Point. Knowledge of a broad range of supply program relationships to monitor automated programs to determine their efficiency in meeting established information requirements and recommend changes in data flow, sources of input, report formats, and calculations to satisfy supply management information needs. Knowledge of specialized methods and techniques to analyze and evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of supply integrated systems. Ability to analyze and resolve difficult issues and problems in supply data management, i.e., accept requests for system changes, conduct research to determine the validity of requests, refine the information provided, and prepare specifications for computer specialists to use in programming, testing, and implementing changes in automated supply systems in collaboration with computer specialists, they evaluate problems with new and modified systems, including the logical flow, input errors, interconnections among data fields and program elements within a flow of related programs, and recommend solutions to both supply and computer specialists. Skill in analytical reasoning and the ability to apply that skill to the identification, analysis, and resolution of budgetary and workforce utilization problems. Knowledge of analytical and evaluative techniques. Knowledge of budgeting/accounting practices, internal support programs, depot support functions, and automated systems. Skill in applying such techniques to studies concerning the efficiency and effectiveness of operating and administrative programs, including pertinent manual and automated systems. Knowledge of major issues, program goals and objectives, direct labor work processes, and major administrative operations of the depot; their integration; and their interrelationships with the related support functions of the Depot and its tenants. Ability to obtain or maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (as required) U.S. citizenship required Preferred Qualifications Previous experience supporting DoD, Army, or TACOM programs Prior government contracting experience Additional Information This position will be performed in office, data center, or operational environment that requires prolonged sitting, computer use, and occasional movement within facilities. Employees may also be required to work shifts, overtime, or weekend support based on mission needs. KBR Benefits KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development. Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together. KBR is an equal opportunity employer. title: Lead Technical Product Manager – Commerce Platform
jd_text: Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future. We are looking for an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager to help define the strategy for our global Commerce Platform. The Commerce Platform provides foundational capabilities that power Levi's digital commerce experiences across channels and markets. These capabilities span areas including product and inventory, cart and checkout, payments, promotions, identity, search, analytics, observability, and the services and integrations that connect our broader commerce ecosystem. We are undergoing a significant transformation, evolving from a legacy monolithic commerce platform to a modern architecture built on domain-driven services, APIs, event-driven integration, and reusable platform capabilities. As the Lead Technical Product Manager, you will define the strategy and roadmap for key Commerce Platform capabilities, partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, Digital Product, and business stakeholders to turn customer and commercial needs into scalable technical solutions. Beyond gathering and prioritizing requirements, you will help shape the platform's future. This includes identifying opportunities for reusable platform capabilities, addressing architectural and process constraints, prioritizing investments that unlock long-term value, and balancing short-term needs against long-term scalability and complexity. You will bring product judgment, technical fluency, and curiosity. You are comfortable operating in a changing landscape, digging into complex systems and business processes, challenging assumptions, and bringing structure and direction to problems that cross technical boundaries. About the Job Technical Product Roadmap • Build and evolve the product strategy for defined capabilities within the Commerce Platform. • Translate customer, business, and commercial needs into scalable technical products and platform capabilities. • Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape platform strategy, identifying opportunities to unlock value through new technologies and architectural capabilities while proactively addressing technical constraints, tradeoffs, and long-term risks. • Balance near-term needs with foundational platform investments, technical health, scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability. • Build toward reusable, configurable platform capabilities rather than market-, channel-, or use-case-specific implementations. • Identify opportunities to simplify the platform, reduce duplication, and establish clearer product and domain boundaries. • Define clear product outcomes and success measures and use them to guide roadmap decisions. Product Discovery, Definition & Execution • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for the platform capabilities you own, from discovery and strategy through implementation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. • Partner with teams to understand the underlying problem, desired outcome, and value rather than simply translating requests into features. • Work with engineers and architects to translate product strategy into clear technical requirements and executable work. • Manage the product backlog, including epics, user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and sequencing. • Ensure teams have business and technical context to make implementation decisions. • Make prioritization and trade-off decisions across scope, value, cost, technical complexity, risk, and time to market. • Track outcomes after launch and use insights, adoption, operational data, and partner feedback to inform future investment. Platform Architecture & Capability Development • Partner with Engineering and Architecture to evolve Commerce Platform capabilities toward modular, scalable, and reusable services. • Champion API-first, domain-driven, and event-driven approaches where they create clearer boundaries and more reusable capabilities. • Help define clear contracts and interfaces between platform capabilities and their consumers. • Ensure roadmap decisions account for technical health, performance, scalability, resiliency, security, observability, and extensibility alongside new functionality. • Help guide the transition from legacy commerce capabilities to next-generation services while balancing modernization with ongoing needs. • Evaluate technology and vendor capabilities based on their ability to support the broader platform strategy rather than individual feature requirements alone. Dependency & Ecosystem Management • Lead the dependency picture for the products and capabilities you manage. • Identify upstream and downstream systems, consumers, and teams affected by product and platform changes. • Treat incomplete dependency understanding as a product risk and uncover dependencies during discovery and planning rather than during implementation. • Partner with Engineering and Architecture to reduce dependencies structurally , favoring clear contracts, stable interfaces, reusable capabilities, and asynchronous integration. • Sequence roadmap projects realistically around dependencies that remain and work with partner teams to establish commitments and shared expectations. • Ensure changes account for the broader commerce ecosystem, including product information, inventory, order management, identity, payments, fraud, pricing and promotions, search, analytics, and customer data. • Build productive relationships with the teams and partners whose systems your products consume or promote. Cross-Functional Product Leadership • Be a trusted partner to Engineering Managers, Staff and Principal Engineers, Architects, Product Managers, and partners. • Partner with customer-facing Product teams to understand their roadmaps and identify where shared Commerce Platform capabilities can ensure experiences or use cases. • Build agreement across partners when priorities, requirements, or desired solutions differ. • Provide strategic advice on how platform capabilities can address our challenges, including when the right answer is a trade-off, an alternative solution, or not building something. • Communicate product strategy, roadmap, priorities, decisions, risks, and outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences. • Represent Commerce Platform capabilities in planning and roadmap conversations with senior leaders and partner organizations. • Build relationships with external vendors and technology partners and ensure their capabilities and roadmaps align with our platform strategy. Data, Outcomes & Continuous Improvement • Define measurable outcomes and KPIs for platform investments, including adoption, reliability, performance, operational efficiency, developer experience, and growth. • Use product, operational, and engineering data to inform prioritization and investment decisions. • Measure the adoption and value of platform capabilities rather than treating technical delivery as the definition of success. • Identify opportunities to reduce friction for teams consuming Commerce Platform capabilities. • Evaluate industry trends, new technologies, and commerce platform capabilities that could influence the roadmap. • Explore opportunities to use automation and AI to improve platform capabilities, product discovery, engineering productivity, documentation, and operational processes. • Be an agent of change, challenging existing assumptions and processes when better approaches can improve customer, business, or engineering outcomes. About You • 8+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, Product Management for technical platforms, or a related role. • Experience managing product strategy and roadmaps for complex technical products or platform capabilities. • Technical fluency and demonstrated ability to participate in architecture and system design conversations. • Experience working closely with software engineers and architects on APIs, distributed systems, integrations, and modern platform architectures. • Understand complex systems, identify upstream and downstream dependencies, and reason about how product decisions affect a broader technology ecosystem. • Experience translating ambiguous business and technical problems into clear product strategies, requirements, roadmaps, and executable backlogs. • Balance customer and value with technical health, scalability, maintainability, cost, and delivery complexity. • Experience using data to support product decisions and measure outcomes. • Influence across multiple teams and organizational boundaries. • Experience communicating complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and trade-offs to senior business and technology leaders. • Comfortable bringing clarity, structure, and momentum to complex problems. • Experience building technical products or platform capabilities within digital commerce, retail, or another large-scale transactional ecosystem. • Experience with commerce platform modernization, migration, or replatforming programs. • Familiarity with commerce technologies such as SAP Commerce (Hybris), SCAYLE, or other headless or composable commerce platforms. • Experience with domain-driven design, API-first platforms, event-driven architectures, and modern integration patterns. • Familiarity with commerce domains such as product information, inventory, cart, checkout, payments, fraud, promotions, identity, search, order management, and analytics. • Experience building platforms or services consumed by multiple products, channels, markets, or engineering teams. • Experience working in global environments with distributed engineering and product teams. • Experience managing strategic relationships with technology vendors and external partners. • Experience using AI and automation to improve product management, engineering productivity, or platform operations. What Success Is A successful Lead Technical Product Manager will: • Establish a clear roadmap for the Commerce Platform capabilities they own. • Become a trusted product partner to Engineering, Architecture, Digital Product, and business leadership. • Turn recurring business and channel needs into reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off implementations. • Improve understanding between customer-facing product roadmaps and the underlying platform investments needed to promote them. • Identify dependencies and architectural constraints early and help reduce them over time. • Make technical health, scalability, reliability, and operational readiness visible product priorities. • Create clear measures of adoption and value for platform capabilities and use those measures to inform future investment. • Help evolve Commerce Platform toward clearer domain boundaries and a more modular, scalable architecture. • Help product and engineering teams to deliver new commerce experiences faster by making the underlying platform easier to understand, consume, and extend. The expected starting salary range for this role is $170,000 - $200,000 per year. We may pay more or less than the posted range based on the location of the role. The amount a particular employee will earn within the salary range will be based on factors such as relevant education, qualifications, performance and business needs. Levi Strauss & Co. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About Crunchyroll</h2> <p>Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.</p> <p>Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>In the role of Supply Chain &amp; Manufacturing Manager, Collectibles, you will report to the Senior Manager, Global Operations.</p> <p>We are considering applicants for the location of Dallas, TX.&nbsp;</p> <p>As the Supply Chain &amp; Manufacturing Manager, Collectibles, you will be responsible for developing and leading the end-to-end global supply chain and manufacturing strategy and execution for Crunchyroll's Collectibles business. You will oversee global sourcing, supplier selection and development, manufacturing operations, production planning, inventory management, logistics, and operational readiness to ensure products are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.</p> <p>You will work cross-functionally with Product Development, Creative, Licensing, Planning, Sales, Finance, and Distribution. You will drive operational excellence through strategic supplier partnerships, scalable processes, and data-driven decision-making. By serving as the operational bridge between Product Development, Creative, Licensing, and global manufacturing partners, you will ensure innovative collectible products are successfully translated from concept into high-quality products delivered to fans worldwide. You will proactively identify operational risks, optimize cost and inventory performance, and build a resilient global supply chain that supports the continued growth of the Collectibles business.</p> <h3><strong>Core Areas of Responsibility</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Supply Chain &amp; Manufacturing Leadership</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Develop and execute global supply chain and manufacturing strategies that support product launches and long-term business growth.</li> <li>Lead end-to-end supply chain and manufacturing operations from product development through final product delivery.</li> <li>Develop production plans and manufacturing schedules aligned with product launch timelines.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve operational efficiency, scalability, and overall supply chain performance.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Global Sourcing &amp; Manufacturing</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Build and manage strategic relationships with global manufacturing partners and suppliers.</li> <li>Identify, evaluate, and onboard manufacturing partners capable of supporting Crunchyroll's quality, cost, capacity, and delivery objectives.</li> <li>Lead supplier performance reviews, issue resolution, and recovery plans.</li> <li>Partner with suppliers to optimize quality, cost, lead times, manufacturing efficiency, and scalability.</li> <li>Identify and mitigate supply chain risks while ensuring operational readiness across all product launches.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide supply chain leadership on manufacturing feasibility, inventory strategy, production schedules, and operational risk.</li> <li>Support business planning through forecasting, KPI reporting, and data-driven decision making.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Inventory &amp; Financial Performance</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Partner with Planning and Logistics teams to optimize inventory investments while maintaining product availability.</li> <li>Manage supply chain budgets and identify opportunities to improve margins, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency.</li> <li>Monitor key performance indicators, including supplier performance, inventory health, production schedules, cost performance, and on-time delivery.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About You</strong></h2> <p>We get excited about candidates, like you, because...</p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in supply chain, manufacturing, operations, sourcing, or product operations.</li> <li>Experience managing global suppliers and international manufacturing partners.</li> <li>Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Strong analytical, project management, negotiation, and communication skills.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience with ERP systems.</li> <li>Experience in consumer products, collectibles, licensed merchandise, entertainment, and accessories.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience supporting global product launches and international supply chains.</li> <li>Experience with NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar ERP platforms.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing,Operations, or related field, or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>Crunchyroll’s Global Operations team brings collectibles from concept to fans worldwide—leading global sourcing, manufacturing, production planning, inventory, logistics, and operational readiness to enable launches that meet quality, cost, and delivery goals. We coordinate demand planning and logistics, manage operational risk, and build scalable processes that help deliver exceptional fan experiences.</p> <h2>Why you will love working at Crunchyroll</h2> <p>In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:</p> <ul> <li>Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.</li> <li>Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.</li> <li>Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance</li> <li>Health Saving Account HSA program</li> <li>Health care and dependent care FSA</li> <li>401(k) plan, with employer match</li> <li>Employer paid commuter benefit</li> <li>Support program for new parents</li> <li>Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!</li> </ul> <p>#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About our Values</h3> <p>We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value</p> <ul> <li> <p>Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.</p> </li> <li> <p>Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.</p> </li> <li>Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.</li> <li> <p>Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Our commitment to diversity and inclusion</h3> <p>Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity &amp; inclusion. It's just the way we do business.</p> <p>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</p> <p>Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Questions about Crunchyroll’s hiring process? Please check out our Hiring FAQs:&nbsp;</em><em data-stringify-type="italic"><a href="https://help.crunchyroll.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040471712-Crunchyroll-Hiring-FAQs">https://help.crunchyroll.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040471712-Crunchyroll-Hiring-FAQs</a></em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Please refer to our&nbsp;Candidate Privacy Policy for more information about how we process your personal information, and your data protection rights: <a href="https://tbcdn.talentbrew.com/company/22978/v1_0/docs/spe-jobs-privacy-policy-update-for-crpa-dec-21-22.pdf">https://tbcdn.talentbrew.com/company/22978/v1_0/docs/spe-jobs-privacy-policy-update-for-crpa-dec-21-22.pdf</a></em></p> <p>Please beware of recent scams to online job seekers. Those applying to our job openings will only be contacted directly from @crunchyroll.com email account.</p></div>

jd_text: Data Architect, AI and Supply Chain Insights Description - Job Summary We are seeking a Supply Chain Data Architect who combines strong data architecture expertise with a data product mindset. jd_text: Excited to grow your career? We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply! Our people make all the difference in our success. Compensation Grade The Power Distribution Technician uses their high voltage expertise to collaborate with engineers, planners, and other field personnel to ensure the reliable and efficient distribution of electrical power. Accountability 1: Meet all SHE objectives and comply with all governmental laws and policies while executing work in the Power Distribution area: Visibly supports and promotes the INEOS 20 Principles and the Culture of Prevention. All activities performed in accordance with established company, local, state, federal, and health safety, and environmental regulations and procedures. Ensure all maintenance activities are planned and executed in compliance with site environmental compliance requirements. Safety improvements on all pre-existing processes. Provides safe work permits to contractors working on or around high voltage equipment in the plant and maintenance buildings Verifies clear understanding of work scope, carefully reviews the type of work and potential safety or process reliability hazards. Takes appropriate action to initiate proper safety reviews (e.g., temporary job plan, confined space, hot work, etc.) when reviewing the work scope. Is aware of and responds to emergency protocols during shutdowns and startups. Accountability 2: Executing maintenance activities in support of maintaining mechanical integrity of assets and protective systems Provide information such as switching orders, or distribution process changes. Prepare switching orders that isolate work areas without causing power outages, referring to drawings of power systems. Perform maintenance, repairs, and replacements of three-phase power distribution components up to 69kV and relay hardware. Maintains and reviews maintenance records on all power distribution equipment in the plant. Ensure the reliable operation of all high voltage equipment in the plant. Performs corrective and preventative maintenance tasks on all high voltage equipment in the plant. Actively looks for electrical reliability improvement opportunities. Trouble shoots failed/underperforming equipment to identify and/or eliminate root cause. Effectively communicates at a variety of levels, including the writing of reports on equipment condition and status. Inspects and maintains overhead power distribution lines. Performs visual inspections to identify system hardware issues. Accountability 3: Supports project activities associated with the high voltage systems of the plant: Provides support to engineering project teams that install, modify, or will affect any power distribution equipment in the plant. Follows the progress of the projects ensuring that the power distribution equipment is installed correctly with all parameters being properly set for the desired operation Level of Education & Knowledge: 5+ years relevant high voltage experience (greater than 480V) in a plant, Electrical Journeyman designation, NCCER Electrical Certification or NETA certification NFPA 70E – Standard for Electrical Safety in the Workplace Working knowledge of electrical standards as applied in petrochemical industry and general knowledge of various Codes (e.g. API, ASME, ANSI, NFPA, ISA, IEEE, NETA). Working knowledge of technical documentation associated with electrical design and equipment Knowledge and experience in executing preventive maintenance plans. Experience & Technical Skills: Electrical Experience: Knowledge of and experience of troubleshooting equipment with voltages up to 69kV. Knowledge of and experience of working with high voltage substations and switchgear. Trouble-shooting skills along with the ability to read and understand P&ID, Relay Drawings, Electrical One-Lines and Loop Drawings. Knowledge of testing and maintenance of VFDs, transformers, large electric motors, UPS systems, low and high voltage switchgear, and low and medium voltage motor control centers. Safe switching practices, including creating and executing switching orders. Inspection and maintenance practices for high voltage equipment (480V to 69KV) including transformers, breakers, switches, and motors. Inspection and maintenance practices for overhead power distribution lines Adapt to changing market and customer opportunities quickly to deliver results in the most effective way.

jd_text: FedRAMP Project Manager Description - Job Summary About the company: HP Inc. is a global technology leader pioneering innovative solutions that revolutionize the way people work and live. About the position : As a FedRAMP Project / Program Manager, you will support the planning, coordination, and tactical execution of HP’s FedRAMP readiness effort for WXP and related managed services capabilities. This role is focused on keeping the program organized, driving follow-through across workstreams, maintaining the integrated project plan, coordinating stakeholder inputs, gathering and documenting requirements, and ensuring progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions are visible to the right owners. This role will work closely with product, engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, legal, operations, managed services, GTM, and external partner teams to help keep the FedRAMP effort moving against defined milestones. Success in this role requires strong organization, attention to detail, clear communication, follow-up discipline, and the ability to turn cross-functional inputs into actionable plans, status updates, and decision-ready summaries. Key Responsibilities: Program coordination & execution tracking Maintain the integrated FedRAMP project plan, including milestones, owners, dependencies, action items, and status updates. Own day-to-day upkeep of the FedRAMP Smartsheet / program tracker to ensure workstreams, deliverables, risks, and next steps remain current and visible. Track progress across concurrent FedRAMP workstreams spanning product, engineering, infrastructure, security, compliance, operations, and business teams. Follow up with workstream owners to drive timely completion of actions, requirements, artifacts, and open decisions. Help identify schedule risks, blockers, dependency gaps, and execution issues that require escalation. Stakeholder coordination Serve as a central coordination point across internal HP stakeholders and external partners supporting the FedRAMP effort. Schedule and support working sessions, readiness reviews, requirements reviews, and issue-resolution forums. Capture meeting notes, decisions, owners, and follow-ups, and ensure items are reflected in the program tracker. Help coordinate delivery expectations with third-party partners, including Coalfire and Amazon, as part of the broader FedRAMP execution plan. Support clear communication across product, engineering, architecture, security, legal, operations, managed services, GTM, and leadership stakeholders. Requirements intake & documentation support Gather, organize, and document FedRAMP-related requirements from product, business, security, compliance, and technical stakeholders. Help maintain requirements inventories, decision logs, artifact trackers, and dependency lists needed to support FedRAMP readiness. Coordinate inputs for key program artifacts such as architecture documentation, control readiness materials, authorization package inputs, status reports, and executive summaries. Support requirement clarification by routing questions to the right subject matter experts and tracking unresolved items to closure. Ensure requirements and action items are documented consistently and connected to relevant milestones, owners, and execution plans. Reporting & communication Prepare regular program status updates summarizing progress, risks, dependencies, blockers, and decisions needed. Support leadership and governance updates with clear, concise, executive-ready summaries. Help translate detailed project activity into clear updates that enable faster decisions and cross-functional alignment. Maintain organized program documentation so stakeholders can quickly understand status , next steps, and open issues. Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business , Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field preferred. 5-10 years of experience in project coordination, program management, product operations, technical program support, compliance program support, or a related role. Exposure to FedRAMP, DoD IL5, cloud compliance, cybersecurity, audit readiness, or authorization programs. Experience supporting technical or compliance-driven programs in partnership with engineering, security, architecture, legal, or operations teams. Experience maintaining Smartsheet dashboards, integrated project plans, milestone trackers, risk logs, or executive reporting materials. Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining clear documentation and follow-through. Strong attention to detail and comfort working with complex stakeholder maps, evolving requirements, and shifting priorities. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create concise status updates and coordinate across technical and business stakeholders. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping bring structure, visibility, and execution discipline to a complex program. location: Spring, Texas, United States of America
jd_text: Product Operations and Portfolio Program Manager Description - HP's Personal Systems business spans PCs, displays, software, and services designed for commercial, consumer, and gaming customers worldwide. At the center of this portfolio is HP's commitment to delivering secure, manageable, and differentiated end-user experiences that scale across global enterprises, governments, and SMBs. As security threats continue to evolve, HP integrates protection across the entire Personal Systems ecosystem, from hardware and firmware to software, cloud services, and security solutions, enabling customers to confidently deploy and manage their fleets without compromising performance, usability, or resilience. HP Wolf Security is a market-leading endpoint security portfolio that combines hardware-enforced security, threat containment, endpoint management, and cloud-based services to protect customers from modern cyber threats. The portfolio spans secure PCs, firmware and BIOS protection, cloud management platforms, endpoint security solutions, and innovative security services. The Product Operations and Portfolio Program Manager provides operational leadership and business management across the HP Security GBU. This is a senior role which establishes the processes, governance, analytics, and cross-functional alignment needed to translate Security GBU strategy into measurable business and product outcomes. Operating across product management, engineering, and teams internal and external to the GBU, this role drives portfolio execution, maintains operational rigor, identifies business and delivery risks, and ensures that decisions result in clear ownership and follow-through. The role serves as a central coordination point for complex initiatives that span organizational boundaries and do not have a single functional owner. Key Responsibiliti es 1. Portfolio Governance and Roadmap Operations Establish and maintain governance processes for the Security GBU product portfolio, including roadmap reviews, prioritization, release tracking, and executive decision support. Coordinate the internal and external roadmap processes across product management, engineering, support, category, sales, and other stakeholders. Consolidate product-manager inputs into an external roadmap appropriate for broader HP audiences, facilitate periodic reviews, and route stakeholder feedback back to product owners. Identify roadmap gaps, delivery risks, missing ownership, dependencies, and items without credible release dates. Drive decisions on whether portfolio items should be completed, re-planned, escalated, removed, or moved to future planning periods. 2. Program Leadership and Operating-Model Improvement Lead complex, cross-functional programs that coordinate product management, engineering, and supporting functions. Provide direction to project leads while maintaining program-level accountability for scope, stakeholder alignment, executive communication, and results. Establish clear divisions of responsibility among program sponsors, program leadership, project managers, product managers, and functional teams. 3. Business Performance, Forecasting, and Executive Analytics Own recurring analysis of Security GBU product, revenue, shipment, attach, activation, licensing, and subscription performance. Develop and maintain consolidated operating dashboards, business-performance files, forecasts, projections, and management views. Create concise executive insights that explain performance, risks, assumptions, and recommended actions. 4. Partner, Supplier, and Contract Coordination Support operational management of strategic technology suppliers and partners when responsibilities span product, finance, legal, procurement, and business leadership. Maintain working knowledge of contractual obligations, royalty structures, licensed components, reporting requirements, and amendment needs. Coordinate the stakeholders required for supplier negotiations, contract changes, payment questions, and new partnership opportunities. 5. Go-to-Market Enablement Help Sales, WW Category, customer-success, and technical teams navigate the Security GBU portfolio, supported platforms, product configurations, and operational processes. Ensure recurring field questions and customer needs are converted into documented requirements, market requests, Jira items, roadmap decisions, or enablement content. Support customer-specific opportunities by validating product availability, configurations, dependencies, and implementation paths. Qualifications and Experience Extensive experience leading complex global programs, portfolio operations, business operations, or product operations in a matrixed technology organization. Demonstrated ability to operate across product management, engineering, finance, category, sales, supply chain, legal, and customer-success functions. Strong understanding of product-development lifecycle, portfolio governance, roadmap management, new-product introduction, and commercial operations. Advanced analytical skills, including business modeling, forecasting, trend analysis, data reconciliation, and executive insight development. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint capabilities, with experience creating management dashboards and decision-oriented presentations. Experience with Jira, SharePoint, Teams, and enterprise ordering, financial, and reporting systems. Strong program structuring, stakeholder management, risk management, written communication, negotiation, and executive-presentation skills. Ability to independently manage multiple complex workstreams with limited oversight. Technical fluency sufficient to work effectively with security-product, software, firmware, hardware, and platform-engineering teams. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; advanced business, technical, or program-management education preferred. Location & working model This position is based in Houston, Texas. Candidates should be located within a commutable distance of the Houston area. This role operates under a hybrid working arrangement, with a minimum requirement to be onsite three days per week. As a people-focused senior role, regular in-person collaboration is encouraged to support stakeholder engagement, team leadership, and business impact. The Houston site provides a collaborative workplace environment with access to meeting and conference facilities, wellness resources, fitness facilities, food services, and a range of onsite employee amenities. The location supports both in-person collaboration and hybrid working arrangements. title: Senior Product Manager
jd_text: Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible. Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here! PURPOSE OF THE JOB The purpose of the position is to partner with key stakeholders to drive the strategic direction for a portfolio of insurance product line(s) across all distribution channels and brands. This position helps define product strategy and roadmap and champions the strategy and monitors product progression throughout the full life cycle. The position is responsible for monitoring and influencing all aspects of product performance to achieve Company revenue and performance targets. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Ideates and develops business initiatives using product knowledge and results. Leads and participates in collaborations with the head of product line underwriting unit(s) to develop product strategy and action plan to achieve growth and profit objectives. Owns inputs to bi-annual premium and exposure projections supporting financial budgeting and pro-forma processes and understand projection framework. Provides expert insights regarding profitability, retention, and growth strategies through the integration of the underwriting, marketing, policyholder services, distribution, claims, actuarial, data analytics, customer, and digital experience. Collaborates with other functional departments to coordinate timelines for delivery, maximize the effectiveness of programs, direct implementation of product strategies, and drive cross-functional alignment and engagement for initiatives supporting product objectives. Develops and maintains templates to perform competitive research and deliver competitive analyses. Utilizes and trains others in the use of internal analytical tools (spanning underwriting, marketing, customer behavior, and claims). Performs and reviews data analyses concerning loss patterns, market forces, risk distributions, and agency management to evaluate the success of current strategies to either modify or create new strategies targeting production, product pricing, underwriting, contract changes, or agency changes. Assesses the impact of changes on the in-force book, new business production, and agency force. Develops and drives initiatives for strategic product development. Applies business content knowledge in identifying priorities and executing strategic product initiatives to achieve business objectives. Monitors the marketplace to identify competitor and industry changes impacting effectiveness or compliance of current and proposed programs. Partners with Actuarial team to determine and implement appropriate pricing and program structure to achieve product goals, and design and execute product rate plan and state level enhancements across jurisdictions ensuring all changes are communicated to field services, operations, underwriting, marketing, and system technology teams. Partners with Underwriting team to facilitate changes to processes or systems, or respond to questions, and ensuring communication to affected parties. Analyzes the performance of existing products; develops and leads the creation of business cases for the development of changes to existing products or development of new products. Maintains knowledge of available internal and external data sources, including accuracy and completeness, to select the proper data set(s) for evaluation. Organizes and structures product definitions to ensure efficiencies in downstream reporting processes. Directs the implementation of underwriting guideline changes. Collaborates with strategic planning groups to incorporate enterprise class system solutions supporting the future product roadmap. Acts as product leader and subject matter expert in the maintenance of current products, filed product changes, and design and delivery of new products in development. Develops internal partnerships and collaborates with Enterprise Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Underwriting, and Actuarial Departments to manage the implementation of all ratemaking bureau rules, forms and coverage changes, and company-initiated changes including coordination with the rate filing analyst. Keeps abreast of distribution channel needs through involvement in agency facing initiatives, and regular reporting on direct to market strategies available in the industry. Possesses expert knowledge of ratemaking bureau underwriting manuals and company exception rules and maintains knowledge of any changes. Documents and memorializes changes. Researches issues or concerns around underwriting rules, including historical company filings in independent ratemaking bureaus to confirm adherence and direct changes. Maintains knowledge of rules, regulations, nuances in states of operation and engage with product line underwriting unit(s) to invoke needed changes or identify training in support of a self-sustaining culture. Proactively engages with Underwriting and Legal to ensure insurance policy provisions comply with state law. Partners with Compliance Department to identify and close any gaps in rules, respond to changes in rules, and remediate across systems, processes, reporting. Participates in regulatory approval of filings, market conduct exams, and internal responses to any state filing objections to facilitate modifications. SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES This position has no supervisory responsibilities but may mentor and train junior team members. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor's degree from a college or university required with a major or emphasis in Business, Computer Science, Math, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience. MBA is a plus. Minimum 6 years of experience in insurance product management. Insurance industry knowledge and demonstrated work experience required. Exposure to industry recognized product management curriculum, or demonstrated experience required. Experience managing complex, large-scale, high risk product development projects preferred. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS Extensive knowledge of insurance industry; workers compensation or commercial lines required based on role designation. Resourcefulness to research industry topics and develop proficient knowledge of internal systems and constraints to aid in managing individual state compliance. Knowledge of actuarial practice area is a plus. Highly developed quantitative analysis, decision making, and project management skills. Demonstrated ability to solve complex business problems, consistent with a deep understanding of the strategic direction of the business. Deep knowledge of the insurance product lifecycle, financial drivers of profitability, insurance regulations and general insurance operations and business processes. Ability to synthesize analytical results to guide business decisions. Strong leadership, written and oral communication, and teamwork skills required. Strong organizational skills. Ability to hold effective meetings, including setting agendas and attendees, time management, and documentation of meeting outcomes. CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) preferred. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit or periodically stand and work on a computer for 80-90% of time. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and climb or balance. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 5 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. WORK ENVIRONMENT This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. We are currently not offering employment sponsorship for this opportunity. #LI-NT1 #LI-Remote The current range for this position is $139,874.00 - $250,377.40 This range is exclusive of fringe benefits and potential bonuses. If hired at ICW Group, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors unique to each candidate, including experience, education and the location of the role and considers employees performing substantially similar work. WHY JOIN ICW GROUP? Challenging work and the ability to make a difference You will have a voice and feel a sense of belonging We offer a competitive benefits package, with generous medical, dental, and vision plans as well as 401K retirement plans and company match Bonus potential for all positions Paid Time Off Paid holidays throughout the calendar year Want to continue learning? We’ll support you 100% ICW Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
