title: Sr. Product Manager - Clinician Workflow
jd_text: Career-defining. Life-changing. At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career About This Role: Sr. Product Manager, Digital Platform – Clinician Workflow iRhythm is looking for a Sr. Product Manager to join the digital platform product team. This role will focus on clinican-facing web portals, helping define, prioritize, and deliver workflow capabilities that support clinician-facing experiences, operational efficiency, and scalable platform growth. Over time, the role is expected to expand into broader digital platform responsibilities across clinician workflow, integrations, and adjacent platform capabilities that support iRhythm’s evolving product portfolio. You will partner closely with engineering, design, clinical, operations, commercial, regulatory, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate user needs and business priorities into high-quality software solutions that can scale across multiple products and workflows. Responsibilities include: Lead product discovery for accountable products, including voice of customer, clinician workflow research, internal stakeholder feedback, data analysis, and assessment of unmet needs and pain points. Define and maintain a prioritized roadmap, balancing clinician workflow needs, operational priorities, technical feasibility, regulatory considerations, and business impact. Translate product strategy into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release scope, and implementation plans that align business value, technical feasibility, regulatory considerations, and user experience. Partner with program/project management to lead cross-functional core teams through product development, launch readiness, change management, and post-launch adoption. Work closely with engineering, design, UX, clinical operations, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality features and intuitive workflows through iterative development. Measure, analyze, and communicate product performance, adoption, operational impact, and KPI trends to inform roadmap decisions and demonstrate outcomes. Willing to travel up to 20%. About you: You care deeply about building healthcare technology that improves workflows, supports clinicians, and enables better patient and customer outcomes. The end user is always your first priority, and you seek to understand day-to-day pain points through data, research, workflow observation, and direct stakeholder engagement. You know enough about software delivery, systems, and integrations to partner effectively with technical teams and can communicate complex ideas at the right level for executives, engineers, operators, and clinical stakeholders. You bring structure to ambiguity, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and communicate your rationale clearly so teams stay aligned and moving forward. Desired Qualifications 5+ years of product management experience, ideally with software platforms, workflow applications, or digital health products. Experience in healthcare IT, medical device, digital health, clinical workflow, or regulated software environments. Strong ability to define product scope, write clear requirements, prioritize effectively, and guide teams through ambiguity. Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills. Deep knowledge of product management best practices, including discovery, roadmap planning, agile delivery, launch readiness, and outcome measurement. Strong end-user orientation, with experience gathering feedback from both internal and external users and translating insights into product decisions. Experience using analytics, business intelligence, or product data to monitor adoption, workflow performance, and business impact. Strong systems analysis, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving skills. Demonstrates initiative as a self-starter; results oriented, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment. Experience with Atlassian tools such as Jira and Confluence, road mapping tools such as Aha!, and analytics tools such as Tableau, Pendo, Google Analytics, or SQL. BA/BS in science, engineering, business, healthcare, or a technical field. Advanced degree or MBA desired. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or improving applications that support multiple end-user personas and complex workflow handoffs. Experience with clinician-facing software, care team workflows, reporting tools, patient monitoring platforms, or healthcare operations platforms. Familiarity with EHR integrations, interoperability concepts, customer care systems, user management tools, or revenue cycle management workflows. Experience with requirements management applications such as Jama or DOORS and design control applications such as MasterControl. Technical fluency with software architecture, APIs, data flows, scripting, or object-oriented development concepts. Experience leading cross-functional teams in a remote or distributed work environment. Location: Remote - US Actual compensation may vary depending on job-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. jd_text: At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare. Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team! LifeStance Health Values Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self. Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment. Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it. One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose. Benefits As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program. ROLE OVERVIEW As a Lead, Operations Strategy - Specialty Services Implementation, you will play an integral role in developing and implementing new service lines that improve the experience of LifeStance clinicians and patients across the country and further the mission of the organization. In this role, you will be a catalyst for change, driving growth, business process improvement, and initiatives aimed at growing LifeStance’s business offerings. As a member of the Ops Strategy - Specialty Services Team, you will leverage your expertise to lead and influence stakeholders, ensuring the seamless execution of national initiatives. You will work cross-functionally with all corporate teams, including Technology, People, Finance, Clinical Leadership & Shared Services to lead teams toward solving complex problems. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to build relationships with Operations leaders across the business to understand their needs and develop initiatives that allow them to better service patients across the geographies they lead. Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description. KEY RESPONSIBILITES Drive the implementation of new service lines through a combination of direct involvement, partnership with the local operating team, and influence over internal stakeholder partners (shared services, corporate support, etc.). Execute, document and optimize on a scalable, repeatable playbook for launching new national programs at the site level. Provide subject matter expertise to all internal partners to ensure successful implementation and ongoing support of local Specialty Services programs. Collaborate with management to understand Specialty Services training needs and identify areas for improvement. Accountable for reporting standard key performance indicators, performance root causes, and action plans for improvement to management. Assess and analyze current business practices and procedures, identifying weaknesses and opportunities for enhancement. Develop comprehensive cross-functional project plans to drive changes and improvements in service line launches and performance. Lead the development of training content in various forms (live meetings, asynchronous Workday trainings, etc.) Organize and manage Specialty Services projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives. Liaise between departments to ensure effective communication related to Specialty Services initiatives. REQUIREMENTS Required Skills/Abilities: Microsoft Office experience; Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, etc.), PowerPoint presentation skills. Strong stakeholder management and influence skills, with the ability to align diverse perspectives, drive consensus, and facilitate decision-making in complex environments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to handle sensitive and confidential information. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and synthesize new information, becoming a subject matter expert to drive informed decision-making and strategic insights. Highly organized with strong attention to detail and accuracy. Familiarity with project management software and applications is a plus. Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture. Education and Experience: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience required 3+ years of healthcare experience required, with at least 1 year of healthcare leadership or management experience preferred. Experience at a high-growth company, a plus. Demonstrated experience collaborating with clinical and operational teams to design and implement programs that enhance clinical workflows and support patient care initiatives. Proven track record in managing EHR systems, billing, coding, and compliance processes to streamline operations. Key Behaviors: Behave Ethically: Understand ethical behavior and business practices and ensure own behavior and the behavior of others are consistent with these standards and align with the values of the company. Focus on Stakeholder Needs: Anticipate, understand, and respond to the needs of key stakeholders to meet or exceed their expectations within the organization’s parameters. Build Relationships: Establish and maintain positive working relationships with others both internally and externally to achieve the goals of the organization. Communicate Effectively: Speak, listen, and write in a clear, thorough, and timely manner using appropriate and effective communication tools and techniques. Foster Teamwork: Work cooperatively and effectively with across teams to set goals, resolve problems and make decisions that enhance organizational effectiveness. Make Decisions: Assess situations to determine the importance, urgency, and risks, and make clear decisions which are timely and in the best interests of the organization. Organization: Set priorities, develop a work schedule, and monitor progress towards goals, and track details, data, information, & activities. Solve Problems: Assess problem situations to identify causes, gather and process relevant information, generate possible solutions, and make recommendations and/or resolve the problem. Flexibility and Adaptability: Willingness to be flexible in responsibilities and duties and easily adapt to the needs of the company. Attention to Detail and Accuracy: Understands the need for accurate information in data analysis and communication with internal teams and stakeholders. Appreciation for Diverse Backgrounds & Thought: Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture. title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Technology
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About Crunchyroll</h2> <p>Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.</p> <p>Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!</p></div><p>As a Principal Technical Program Manager in Enterprise Technology, you will lead the delivery of our largest technology initiatives: enterprise system implementations, migrations and integration programs that cut across engineering teams, business functions and external partners. You are as comfortable in a design review as in a steering committee: you understand systems well enough to see delivery risk, and you explain it in terms the business can understand and act on.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role. As the business grows, so does the number of programs running at once, and leaders need one person who can tell them what is on track, what is at risk and where a decision is needed. You will also set the standard for how technical program management works in Enterprise Technology. AI tools are part of how we plan and communicate; you are expected to use them.</p> <p>We are considering applicants for the Dallas location (in-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays).</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li>Lead large, complex technical programs across engineering, product, business functions, and external partners, from plan to launch.</li> <li>Build and maintain integrated program plan: milestones, dependencies, and the critical path across every team and system involved.</li> <li>Keep one reliable view of program health that leaders can read at any time.</li> <li>Surface technical and cross-team risks early.</li> <li>Own the release and change calendar for Enterprise Technology systems and the cutover coordination for major launches: freeze windows, readiness criteria, go/no-go, and the rollback decision path.</li> <li>Run the program cadence: planning, dependency reviews, risk and decision tracking, retrospectives.</li> <li>Set the practices for technical program management across Enterprise Technology: what counts as a program, how plans and risks are managed, and how delivery stays visible as the portfolio grows.</li> </ul> <h2>About You</h2> <p>We get excited about candidates, like you, because...</p> <ul> <li>You have 15+ years of experience leading complex technical programs, with at least 3 at senior or principal scope.</li> <li>You have Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>You have prior experience as an engineer, systems analyst, technical lead or equivalent hands-on role before moving into program delivery.</li> <li>You have led at least one major enterprise system implementation or migration from planning through cutover, including the technical cutover.</li> <li>You can read and question technical artifacts directly: integration designs, data-migration plans, release plans, test results.</li> <li>You are an expert in program planning, critical path and dependency management, and release readiness.</li> <li>You have sound judgment on when to decide, when to consult and when to escalate.</li> <li>You can turn a complex program into a concise, decision oriented update.</li> <li>You are hands-on with AI-assisted tools in program work, and willing to implement new capabilities into planning, analysis and documentation.</li> <li>You influence senior stakeholders and engineering teams across a globally distributed organization, with planned overlap across time zones.</li> </ul> <h3>A plus if you have experience with:</h3> <ul> <li>Programs involving financial systems, business applications or digital media workflows.</li> <li>Compliance sensitive or audit controlled environments.</li> <li>Programs with external vendors or implementation partners.</li> </ul> <h2>Why you will love working at Crunchyroll</h2> <p>In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:</p> <ul> <li>Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.</li> <li>Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.</li> <li>Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance</li> <li>Health Saving Account HSA program</li> <li>Health care and dependent care FSA</li> <li>401(k) plan, with employer match</li> <li>Employer paid commuter benefit</li> <li>Support program for new parents</li> <li>Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!</li> </ul> <p>#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About our Values</h3> <p>We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone Cross-train other IT Operations team members to serve as operational alternates. Act as an operational alternate for other IT Operations team members where needed; Documentation, Reporting & Data Management Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, and platform standards; Performance Metrics & Reporting: Monitor and report on platform operational metrics monthly and quarterly to ensure platform and workload SLO’s are being met; Stable, secure, and observable Azure environments supporting business and mission needs; Consistent, standardized platform configurations aligned to organizational and industry best practices; Increased operational efficiency through automation and improved tooling; Continuing improvements in platform design and operations to meet Microsoft’s Azure Well-Architected Framework guidelines while aligning with business needs; Effective incident response resulting in reduced recurrence and improved platform resilience; and Participation in IJM’s community of spiritual formation . Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in infrastructure, cloud, or systems engineering roles; 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure experience in production environments; Demonstrated experience supporting and operating cloud platforms in an enterprise environment; Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience will be considered; Microsoft Azure certifications (Administrator, Solutions Architect, or similar) preferred; Strong experience with Microsoft Azure IaaS and PaaS services; Experience implementing or maintaining Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM, or Terraform); Scripting and automation using PowerShell and/or Azure CLI; Solid understanding of Azure identity, networking, and security fundamentals; Familiarity with Azure Policy, RBAC, and governance models; Fluency with the Azure Well-Architected Framework ; and Mature orthodox Christian faith as defined by the Apostles' Creed. Critical Qualities: Eager commitment to IJM's Core Values: Christian, Professional, and Bridge-Building; Self-starter with strong initiative and accountability; Disciplined with priorities; Strong interpersonal skills and self-awareness; Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; Flexible, collaborative, and eager to support others; Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; Ability to operate effectively in a production, service-oriented environment; Experience working in global, multicultural organizations; Effective team player who fosters a collaborative environment; and Adept at creative problem-solving. The statement can either be incorporated into the cover letter or submitted as a separate document and should include, at a minimum, a description of your spiritual disciplines (prayer, study, etc.) and your current fellowship or place of worship. title: Technology Applications Specialist
jd_text: Technology Applications Specialist Help shape the technology that supports the delivery of exceptional radiology services. About the Role IDX is seeking an experienced Technology Applications Specialist to join our team and provide specialist expertise across our clinical applications environment. Reporting to the Technology Applications – Operations Manager, you will play a key role in the administration, configuration, testing and ongoing support of our radiology applications. Working closely with radiologists, application vendors, IT teams and other internal stakeholders, you'll help ensure our systems and workflows operate effectively and continue to meet the needs of the business. This is a fast-paced, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys solving problems, building strong stakeholder relationships and using technology to improve clinical workflows. You'll bring your knowledge of PACS and radiology environments to help us optimise existing applications, support integrations and identify opportunities for continuous improvement as we continue to evolve the way radiology services are delivered. What You'll Be Doing In this role, you will: Work with stakeholders to identify, analyse and implement opportunities for improvement Provide clinical applications expertise, configuration, testing and ongoing application support Troubleshoot and resolve technical, workflow and application issues Assist with Radiologist onboarding, training sessions and demo’s for staff Deliver timely and high-quality support and resolutions for all incidents and service requests recorded in the IT Service Management (ITSM) platform. Monitor application performance and help maintain reliable clinical workflows Liaise with application vendors to resolve issues and ensure quality service delivery Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, radiologists and operational stakeholders Assist with maintaining, testing and validating radiology applications Support effective workflows and continuous improvement, with the creation of user guides and multimedia resources About You We're looking for a collaborative and solutions-focused professional who combines strong technical capability with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ideally, you'll bring: Demonstrated Radiology Applications experience and knowledge Previous experience working within a radiology environment , either in the private or public sector A strong understanding of radiology workflows and the interaction between RIS, PACS and HL7 Experience supporting, maintaining, monitoring, testing and validating clinical or radiology applications Experience working with Microsoft technologies and products Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills Experience in customer relationship management, project management and/or quality assurance Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment Proven experience providing high-quality support to end users across different levels of an organisation The ability to communicate confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders, vendors and clinical teams Why Join IDX? You'll work with a diverse group of clinical, operational and technology professionals, have exposure to business-critical applications and contribute to improvements in the technology and workflows that underpin the delivery of radiology services. If you're an experienced PACS professional who enjoys solving complex problems, improving clinical workflows and working closely with stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join IDX and help us continue to transform the way radiology is delivered. Integral Diagnostics (IDX Group) supports a multicultural and diversity workplace. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians with relevant skills and experience to apply. Building a healthier world, by delivering the best health outcomes one patient at a time.

This position will play a key role in the preparation and coordination of the Company’s SEC filings (Forms 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, etc.) and will support technical accounting matters and various business process improvement initiatives to drive value within the organization Job Description: Prepare and coordinate key aspects of the Company’s SEC reporting function, including the timely preparation of financial statements, footnote disclosures, MD&A, disclosure checklists, supporting workpapers and tie-outs. Also includes researching and assisting with drafting footnote disclosures. Collaborate and coordinate with the various groups and stakeholders to obtain the necessary information needed to draft the appropriate disclosures in the company’s SEC filings. Research technical accounting matters and assist in documenting the Company’s accounting conclusions through technical accounting memos. Provide operational accounting support to business units, as needed. Maintain and enhance the Company’s accounting policy manual, including updates resulting from new pronouncements and/or operational changes. Coordinate with the SOX team to ensure the manual remains aligned with the control environment, and communicate relevant changes across the organization. Support the earnings release process, including review and tie-out of press releases and earnings presentations. Support the consolidations process, including the review of balance sheet rollforwards used within the Company’s SEC filings. Assist with tie out of the annual proxy statement. Review XBRL tagging within Workiva for the Company’s financial statements and footnote disclosures. Participate in various business process improvement initiatives such as expediting/streamlining a current business process by utilizing automation tools (e.g. – Wdata within Workiva). Review FASB and SEC pronouncements to assess their applicability to the Company and assist with implementation of new requirements Other special projects as they arise. Qualifications: Required Minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance. Experience in lieu of a formal degree will be considered. CPA or actively pursuing CPA certification Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with Workiva/Wdesk and Wdata preferred. Preferred 2+ years of Big Four experience on a public company client strongly preferred Strong attention to planning and organization with a demonstrated ability to consistently meet deadlines Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with cross-functional team members at all levels of management Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together. KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Sr. Specialist, IT Procurement (Software & Technology)
jd_text: Title: Sr. Specialist, IT Procurement (Software & Technology) The Sr. Specialist, IT Procurement is responsible for leading the strategic sourcing, procurement, negotiation, and supplier management of enterprise software, SaaS applications, cloud services, technology platforms, cybersecurity solutions, and other IT-related products and services. This position serves as a trusted advisor to Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Finance, Legal, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Transformation, and business stakeholders to ensure technology investments deliver maximum commercial value while minimizing financial, contractual, operational, and compliance risks. The role requires deep expertise in software licensing models, SaaS agreements, cloud consumption contracts, maintenance and support renewals, subscription-based services, and technology supplier negotiations. The individual will manage complex sourcing initiatives from initial business requirements through contract execution and ongoing supplier relationship management. Working with limited supervision, the Sr. Specialist applies advanced procurement knowledge, commercial acumen, analytical expertise, and negotiation skills to optimize spend, improve supplier performance, support technology transformation initiatives, and ensure alignment with corporate procurement and governance requirements. The position also provides mentorship, guidance, and quality oversight to procurement specialists and junior sourcing professionals while supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the procurement organization. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Sourcing & Category Management Lead strategic sourcing and category management initiatives for enterprise software, SaaS, cloud services, cybersecurity, hardware, telecommunications, technology consulting, and related IT categories. Develop sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives and technology roadmaps; conduct market intelligence, benchmarking, supplier evaluations, and competitive RFI/RFQ/RFP processes. Evaluate supplier offerings, commercial models, and licensing structures to identify best-value solutions and cost optimization opportunities. Software & Cloud Licensing Management Negotiate software licensing, SaaS subscriptions, cloud consumption, maintenance and support renewals, and technology services agreements. Manage commercial relationships with major technology providers, including Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, AWS, Google Cloud, Salesforce, Broadcom, Adobe, ServiceNow, Workday, and engineering software providers such as Ansys, Autodesk, Bentley, Aveva, and AspenTech. Evaluate licensing structures, usage rights, subscription models, user metrics, consumption-based pricing, and contractual commitments. Partner with Software Asset Management, IT, and Finance to optimize license utilization, reduce redundant spend, consolidate suppliers, and support license compliance. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead complex negotiations covering pricing, discounts, volume incentives, service levels, renewal protections, benchmarking, price increases, audit rights, intellectual property, data ownership, liability, termination, and other commercial terms. Collaborate with Legal, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Risk, Finance, and business stakeholders to assess contractual risk and ensure agreements meet business, regulatory, security, and operational requirements. Supplier Relationship Management Manage strategic technology supplier relationships and serve as the primary procurement contact for assigned suppliers. Conduct supplier performance and business reviews; resolve disputes, service issues, invoicing discrepancies, licensing concerns, and delivery failures. Negotiate corrective actions, service credits, refunds, remediation plans, and performance improvements while driving continuous supplier improvement. Stakeholder Engagement & Business Partnership Partner with IT leadership, project managers, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, Finance, and business stakeholders throughout the technology acquisition lifecycle. Lead requirements gathering, market analysis, sourcing strategy, supplier selection, negotiations, and contract execution. Translate business requirements into effective sourcing and contracting strategies and support technology budgeting, forecasting, and investment planning. Procurement Governance & Compliance Ensure compliance with procurement policies, delegated authority, financial controls, cybersecurity standards, regulatory requirements, and contractual obligations. Maintain accurate procurement and contract documentation and support internal and external audits. Ensure suppliers meet security, insurance, contractual, and policy requirements while promoting procurement best practices and process standardization. Analytics & Continuous Improvement Analyze technology spending and identify cost reduction, efficiency, and process improvement opportunities. Support procurement technology, workflow automation, sourcing tools, and digital transformation initiatives. Recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, controls, stakeholder experience, and business value. Leadership & Mentorship Mentor procurement specialists and less experienced sourcing professionals and provide quality oversight of sourcing activities, commercial analyses, contract documentation, and negotiations. Share best practices, support professional development, and serve as a subject matter expert in IT procurement and software licensing. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Experience in lieu of a degree will also be considered. Minimum 5-8 years of progressive experience in IT procurement, strategic sourcing, contract negotiation, software licensing, or supplier management. Demonstrated experience negotiating enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity, engineering software, and technology services agreements. Experience managing strategic supplier relationships and complex commercial negotiations. Strong understanding of software licensing models, subscription-based services, cloud consumption agreements, and technology procurement practices. Experience supporting cross-functional teams and enterprise technology initiatives. Preferred Qualifications 8+ years of technology sourcing and procurement experience. Experience supporting large global organizations and multi-business-unit environments. Experience with software asset management (SAM), cloud financial management (FinOps), or IT vendor management programs. Knowledge of enterprise procurement and ERP platforms such as Deltek, SAP, Oracle, Ariba, Coupa, ServiceNow, or similar systems. Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPSD, CPM, CSCP, ITAM, SAM, FinOps Certified Practitioner, or equivalent. Experience negotiating agreements with major technology suppliers such as Microsoft, Oracle, AWS, Google Cloud, Salesforce, Broadcom, Adobe, ServiceNow, Workday, IBM, and engineering software providers including Ansys, Autodesk, Bentley, Aveva, and AspenTech. Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together. KBR is an equal opportunity employer. title: Logistics Specialist - Site (ICE Transport)
jd_text: Title: Logistics Specialist Location: El Paso, TX Schedule: This position is mission critical and essential to the ongoing operations and requires a flexible schedule to support a 24/7/365-day operation. About MVM, Inc. Service, Support, Success are the pillars upon which MVM’s founders built the company, and they continue to serve as MVM’s core values. Along with our uncompromising insistence on integrity and ethical business practices, these values make us the service provider of choice for our customers and the employer of choice for our dedicated team members. Working at MVM, Inc. takes a certain kind of person; we want someone who identifies with our values and is willing to challenge themselves both personally and professionally. We seek employees who are passionate about serving and making a difference in the lives of others. If you can envision joining a team where you will have the opportunity to provide mission driven results; then we are looking for you! Job Summary: The Logistics Specialist (LS) supports 24/7 operations and performs operational, logistical support, and administrative tasks required to support ground and air transportation. The Logistics Specialist works in conjunction with field staff and site leadership, Command Center, corporate logistics department, and stakeholders to coordinate the safe transport of minors and/or families and staff. He/she manages daily operations for inventory, supplies, distribution, facilities, and transportation for the site assigned. The Logistics Specialist conducts vehicle safety, including regular preventative and corrective vehicle maintenance, and ensures drivers are authorized to operate vehicles. Essential Functions and Responsibilities: Follows company and contract policies, procedures, and guidance. Prepares, reviews, and coordinates the documentation, personal property and special accommodations required for transportation of all minors and ensures all paperwork is provided for proper transport for reunification or transfer to shelter. Assists with transfer of custody and property for small and/or large groups. Keeps in constant communication with transport teams assuming custody of minors and/or family units, to include checking status of vehicles in route. Informs Command Center and Site leadership of any transport cancellations. Inventories, orders, and delivers meals, supplies, electronics, and/or clothing; prepares backpacks with essentials including tablet and mobile phone for trips. Drives passengers to and from client sites and/or airports. Installs/removes child car and booster seats based on age and height/weight, as required. Observes and assists with UC and/or family unit orientation, answers questions, and describes the transport process. Assists in charter flights/buses preparations, to include reviewing documentation, inspecting bathrooms for cleanliness to ensure high standard of quality, and driving to flightline. Cleans vehicles, sanitizes interiors, and ensures they are fueled and ready for ground trips. Checks vehicles for contraband and ensure coolers and emergency kits are in vehicles. Updates information in the company’s database systems (e.g., Canvas, Verizon Connect, Pantry, fleet system, etc.) and prepares transportation, equipment, inventory, and meal reports as well as Ad Hoc reports as required. Assists in tracking, and monitoring logistics specific training (e.g., DOT, inventory, fleet, facilities, etc.) and assists with logistics projects as needed. Assists management staff with cost benefit estimates as directed by supervisor. Monitors and reports DOT compliance, camera surveillance and GPS tracking, driver IDs (e.g., key fobs), and Hours of Service information for compliance purposes and elevates concerns to supervisor and Site Manager. Follows company quality control and inspection plans and executes the company’s Fleet Management program, including Preventive Maintenance (PM), mileage tracking, registration, tolls, inspections, logs, etc., as required. Tracks inventory and supplies; monitors availability of stock; coordinates with Logistics Supervisor and Site Manager on shortages. Executes the facility management program, and reports any site repairs and building wear and tear to Logistics Supervisor and Site Manager Participates in logistics synchronization meetings as requested. Performs other duties as assigned. Minimum Qualifications & Skills: Possess an associate degree in an appropriate discipline from an accredited college (a high school diploma with two or more years of relevant experience may be substituted for an associate degree) and, Have at least two years of documented experience in a field related to security, law, social work, detention, corrections, or similar occupational area; certification, licensure, and credentials applicable to the professional accreditation of the position (a minimum of four years of experience is required when a high school diploma with two or more years of relevant experience is substituted for an associate degree). Two or more years’ experience in business, logistics, transportation, supply chain or a related field. Demonstrate basic knowledge of vehicle maintenance (e.g., PM, inspections, safety checks, etc.,) as well as warehouse and inventory procedures (e.g., FIFO concept). Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with employees and with clients. Bilingual in English and Spanish required. Ability to take technical direction and feedback from various sources. Committed to providing outstanding customer service and representation of MVM in a professional manner. Requires the ability to prioritize work, meet stringent deadlines, balance multiple tasks and work in a team environment. Strong attention to detail. Ability to pass a Government Security Background Investigation, including a favorable credit check, no criminal record, and no prior drug use. Work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and graveyard shifts. Demonstrated computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite (Word and Excel). Inventory and surveillance software experience preferred. Possess a valid and current driver’s license with safe driving record. Experience using tablets and smart phone technology. Ability to deliver the highest quality of work under extreme pressure. Analytical and problem-solving skills Work Schedule: This position is mission critical and essential to the ongoing operations and requires a flexible schedule to support a 24/7/365-day operation. Clearance: Applicants selected will be subject to a government background investigation and may be required to meet the following conditions of employment. Security Requirements: Ability to obtain/maintain Security Clearance. Favorable credit check for all cleared positions. Successfully pass a background investigation, drug screen. May be required to pass or present specific requirements depending on the program (e.g., DOT exam, vaccinations, CPR, flu shot). Valid US passport book required or proof of being in the process of obtaining one, depending on the program. US Citizenship Physical Requirements/Working Conditions: Standing/Walking/Mobility : Must have the mobility to attend meetings with other managers and employees. Climbing/Stooping/Kneeling: 0% - 10% of the time Lifting/Pulling/Pushing: 0% - 10% of the time, must be able to lift up to 40 lbs. Fine Motor Skills/Dexterity: Must be able to write, type and use a telephone system 100% of the time. Sitting: Sitting for prolonged and extended periods of time This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may revise duties as necessary without updating this job description. Due to the high volume of applications received, the Talent Acquisition Department will contact you directly, should you be selected to advance in our recruitment process. For more information about the company please visit our website at www.mvminc.com MVM is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. MVM complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to hrsupport@mvminc.com .

title: Product Manager
jd_text: Company: INEOS Oxide Interested in joining a winning team? A team whose employees share in the ownership of the business and are empowered to make a difference? Business Context INEOS is a global manufacturer of petrochemicals and specialty chemicals, producing the raw materials that are essential in the manufacturing of a wide range of goods. The chemicals manufactured by INEOS enhance almost every aspect of modern life. INEOS is the 3rd largest petrochemical company in the world with 194 manufacturing sites across 29 countries and employing more than 26,000 people globally. INEOS Oxide is one of the most diverse, dynamic and successful businesses within INEOS, operating 4 manufacturing sites in Europe and North America. These are located at Antwerp, Belgium; Koln, Germany; Lavera, France; Plaquemine, US. INEOS Oxide is one of the world’s leading producers of Ethylene Oxide (EO) and Ethylene Oxide Derivatives (EODs), producing a broad range of 200+ products spread across 4 key value chains – Ethylene Oxide; Propylene Oxide; Oxo-alcohols & Esters; ENB. The total EO production capacity is currently > 1 million mt and the total production capacity for the overall business is ~ 3.4 million mt. Ethylene oxide (EO) is an important building block for the preparation of a wide variety of EO derivatives (EODs), including various surfactants, as well as many other chemical intermediates including Ethylene Glycols, Glycol Ethers, Polyethylene Glycols and Ethanolamine's. In 2024 INEOS Oxide acquired a new site in Bayport (TX) and the respective business in the US, which increased the total production capacity of the business to ~ 4.4 million mt and through this acquisition INEOS Oxide has achieved a true global footprint, in particular for the Ethylene Oxide value chain. Role Description The Product Manager Ethanolamine's is a key member of the INEOS Oxide US Business Team. The post holder is responsible for providing support to the Business Manager for EOAs across the full extent of the tasks involved with managing the business. Focus will be on: executing and optimizing in-month business performance to maximize EBITDA and cash delivery defining and delivering the rolling three-month business-operating plan with the Business Manager providing/maintaining databases for the annual Operating Plan maintaining a planning and modelling tool for the business that includes all input-variables to enable optimization for the business as the output Ensuring reliable product-movements to ensure optimal plant-operations/run-rates This is achieved by the Product Manager driving and coordinating a large cross-functional business team including procurement, manufacturing, supply chain, customer service and sales managers, and requires the post holder to have a deep and detailed understanding of production asset capabilities and economics, market dynamics, and customers’ service requirements and associated cost-to-serve. The Product Manager performs a key role in monitoring and responding to changing market demand for each individual product group and managing challenges arising from feedstock supply and production reliability issues. INEOS Oxide – Internal Interfaces & Factors The Product Manager will interface with, and positively influence, a large cross functional team across the INEOS Oxide business, as follows: Business Managers & Product Managers – EO swap, EOA sales in Europe, EOA arbitrage, optimizing margins on a global basis together with Lavera EOA volumes. Raw Material Procurement Team – agreeing and executing raw material procurement objectives. Plaquemine Site Operations – monitoring manufacturing performance; managing product supply. Logistics & Supply Chain Teams – agreeing and executing drumming, storage, and transportation requirements. Sales & Customer Service Teams – agreeing and executing the sales and contracting strategies for the business. INEOS Oxide Back-Office Support Functions – dealing with cross business and commercial process issues. Manage day-to-day and mid-term production, sales and margin planning and optimize sales/production variations. Maintain Dashboard and cost/price/margin data to aid in development of long-term plans and presentations. External Interfaces & Factors Executing this role effectively will require a wide-ranging engagement with parties in the external market: Suppliers – supporting the Procurement Team in key raw material supply negotiations. Customers – supporting the Sales Team in key contract preparations and potentially negotiations. Manage Customer relationship and business with 1 critically important customer and possibly up to 3 customers that can have significant impact on the EOA-plant operations Co-producers – supporting the business managers to pursue swap, toll and strategic partnership opportunities. Publications – discussions with publications, supporting Business Manager, to discuss market news and to inform them of INEOS specific information, as appropriate. INEOS O&P US – dealing with Ethylene market information. Legal – work on resolving contract and other challenges that require input from counsel. Technical Service – coordinate Product Data/Specification/Safety Information handling and changes. Accountabilities Accountability 1 - Business Operating Plan Execution Develop and maintain the rolling 3 month operational and financial forecast in line with supply/demand balances and product pricing policy and agree them with the Business Manager prior to his submission of the plan to the company’s formal financial forecasting process. Together with the planner, define and optimize production plan based on demand, inventory and raw material availability, to maximize business EBITDA and cash generation. Monitor and manage supply-demand balances to ensure availability of product for sale, and to ensure EBITDA, cash and working capital targets are met. Implement agreed inventory management strategy to achieve defined stock targets. Under guidance from the Business Manager, assist in defining the monthly and quarterly pricing policy in accordance with market dynamics and the business’ commercial strategy. Implement and manage supply chain solutions in co-operation with Supply Chain/Logistics Function and in accordance with defined business strategy to ensure appropriate levels of delivery service to domestic and export customers for both bulk and packed products. Assist and in alignment with Business Manager manage co-producer commercial interactions in alignment with agreed co-producer strategies and in full compliance with competition law requirements. Organize and facilitate the monthly Business Team Meeting in cooperation with the Business Manager EOAs. Co-ordinate response to customer complaints related to product quality. Ensure that asset maintenance plans are set in coordination with business commercial strategy, ensuring EBITDA, cash and working capital outcomes are optimized. Accountability 2 - Sales Portfolio Management Monitor customer contract compliance; track contract renewal dates to ensure timely renegotiation of contract agreements. Manage EOA-bottoms Key-account relationship and business to assure continuous product-flow and margin. Identify, in collaboration with Sales Team, potential new customers based on the developed contract strategy. Support the Business Manager in preparing for tender and annual contract renegotiations. Identify and appraise new market opportunities for sales / swaps / purchases. Accountability 3 - Market Intelligence and Data Develop strong awareness of market dynamics and trends. Gather market intelligence to ensure visibility of competitor / customer business strategy developments to identify emerging issues and opportunities. Proactively and systematically report key market information to the sales and wider business team, including customer and competitor landscape, notable trends, changes, and risks. Accountability 4 - Business Strategy Development Support the Business Manager in defining annual production, procurement, sales and EBITDA plans. Support the Business Manager in monthly EBITDA forecasting. Support the Business Manager in defining long term commercial and asset growth strategies. Identify and appraise production and supply chain cost reduction opportunities. Identify and appraise production and supply chain infrastructure investment opportunities to enhance capability. Accountability 5 - Safety, Health, and Environmental This position requires that the incumbent commit to learning, following, and practicing INEOS 20 Principles of Process & Behavioral Safety as applicable to the position. These Principles are posted throughout each Oxide facility, and each employee must commit to following the INEOS Life-Saving rules on a daily basis. Key Performance Indicators SHE Performance – Zero incidents. Monthly volume, revenue, contribution and EBITDA performance. Overall INEOS Oxide US Business Team goals - operational, financial, working capital and fixed cost targets. Success in delivering market share growth rates and market development targets for the sales region. Meet all departmental annual training and progression goals 100% compliance in Training and Behavior: EPA ISO GMP DOT OSHA Level of education & experience in general Bachelor in either Chemical or Mechanical engineering preferred; or business/commercial or chemistry degree, provided the person can demonstrate a propensity for and has comfort with technical issues MBA beneficial Minimum 5-10 years of chemical industry commercial experience Profound knowledge of Business, Commercial, Financial, and Technical/Operations Management Technical skills Profound understanding of Business, Finance, Commerce, Contract Law and Production Technology Commercial acumen, demonstrated ability to identify and leverage sources of business value Solid understanding of marketing, sales, and supply chain principles and practices Comprehension of chemical manufacturing processes and practices Effective and efficient computer skills including, but not limited to SAP, Microsoft Office Behavioral skills Decisive and tenacious in pursuit of objectives, demonstrating a proactive mentality and bias for action Ambition and curiosity to push the boundaries of the business Ability to think innovatively and strategically Highly numerate with an analytical mind-set, and attentive to detail Calm under pressure, able to make quick, clear and reasoned decisions in a dynamic business environment Leader of people, effective at engaging others in working together towards a common goal Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, natural relationship builder Coach and developer of people, desire to share learning and help colleagues to achieve results ADA Physical Requirements; Environmental conditions While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and perform tasks requiring repetitive use of hands. The employee must occasionally walk, stand and travel by car, airplane or other means Exert up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects Employee must have the ability to see written documents, computer screens, and to adjust focus Hearing: Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication and to make discriminations in sound Work Environment: This job is performed mainly in a temperature-controlled office environment Our culture is one of honesty and integrity with an emphasis on safety, health and environmental performance. On our team, people are acknowledged for embracing new practices that help create real value for customers.

title: Senior Project Manager
jd_text: Company: INEOS Olefins & Polymers USA Interested in joining a winning team? A team whose employees are empowered to make a difference? Job Title: Senior Project Manager Grade: 35/36 Offer Range: $125,050 - $170,000 (commensurate with experience) Location: Hybrid/ Houston Area Operating Sites (Chocolate Bayou, La Porte) INEOS Olefins and Polymers (O&P) USA is a significant entity as part of the INEOS group of companies. INEOS Group Limited is one of the world’s largest chemicals company with ~$30 billion of sales per annum, 16,000 employees and 68+ sites worldwide. The O&P USA business includes the product lines Ethylene, Propylene, Butadiene, Polypropylene and Polyethylene. Manufacturing sites include Chocolate Bayou Works (Alvin, TX), Battleground Manufacturing Complex (LA Porte, TX), and Carson, (Carson, CA), with a division office in League City, TX. How the job fits in: The Project Manager will have accountability for delivery of multiple capital project elements and achieving best-in-class results in safety and capital productivity for those assigned projects. The Project Manager will execute projects consistent with published objectives, guidelines, company principles, and the interests of the project stakeholders. The Project Manager will report to the Manager, Site Capital Projects. The Project Manager will also interact with contract Project Managers, Engineers, Designers, Procurement, Safety Department, Technical Authorities and Construction personnel on day-to-day work assignments. This role will required occasional travel to Houston area operating sites depending on project needs. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Responsible for promoting safety leadership through implementation of the INEOS 20 Principles Responsible for promoting process safety management in the design and execution of all capital projects Accountable for ensuring that the management of change (MOC) process is completed before the start of construction Responsible for developing project execution plans to meet the published objectives of each project in the project manager’s portfolio of projects Accountable for ensuring compliance with the Capital Project stage-gate execution process and right size project execution strategy based on project size and complexity Responsible for communicating status and ensuring alignment with site leadership and stakeholders on project execution as projects progress Responsible for developing and managing cross functional project teams consisting of plant personnel, contract engineering and construction to execute the portfolio of projects in accordance with the approved scope of work Work with INEOS and contract procurement to develop the procurement strategy and facilitate the vendor selection process as required to meet project execution requirements Work with INEOS and contract quality control personnel to develop applicable quality control plans for shop/field fabrication, factory acceptance tests, and field installation as applicable Accountable for the development of equipment specifications, bids, bid tabs, and secure approval from the respective technical authority as applicable Serve as the primary contact for project decisions and approvals Accountable for the creation, vetting, and justification for full sanction estimates and ensure the estimates are aligned with project objectives and scope Accountable for ensuring the technical integrity of projects, including compliance with the project scope, job specifications, and promoting recognized and generally accepted good engineering practices (RAGAGEP) Minimize changes, coordinate the preparation of Scope Change Orders as required, and facilitate approval/implementation of scope changes as applicable Accountable for controlling project cost by ensuring that engineering design and purchased materials and equipment are aligned with the project scope, specifications, and estimated cost Consults with the Manager, Site Capital Projects on items affecting the project budget, schedule, project risks, and priority Reviews manpower requirements and forecasts for engineering and construction with the Manager, Site Capital Projects and recommend course correction as required Responsible for the development of the project execution plan which includes such sections as the engineering execution plan, the SHE plan, the procurement strategy, funding strategy, document control plan, project controls plan, construction execution plan, QA/QC plan, and commissioning plan Responsible for review and approval of contract invoices and plant personnel charges to capital projects Coordinate with Project Controls for timely and accurate cost data Accountable for ensuring PSSR is completed Accountable for facilitating project custody transfer/turnover of new installations to operations and support commissioning activities as required Coordinate work with Construction and TAR (Turnaround) planners Capture, communicate, and apply lessons learned and best practices on projects Facilitate proper financial and document control close out Skills & Knowledge Required Level of Education & Experience in general BS Degree in Chemical, Civil, Electrical, Mechanical Engineering preferred or 15+ years of relevant experience in the petrochemical or refining industry, and 8+ years of direct experience working in a stage-gate Capital execution process for small/mid-sized projects with a record of accomplishment in successful execution Working knowledge of industry standards for engineering, design and construction (i.e. NFPA, IEEE, ANSI, ISA, PIP, ASME) PE and/or PMP Certification a plus Technical and Behavioral Skills A demonstrated familiarity with a stage-gate Capital execution process and underlying project methodologies for portfolio planning, development, and execution Ability to work with minimal supervision and effectively handle multiple projects and/or changing priorities Ability to communicate clearly and concisely both orally and in writing with internal and external clients Our culture is one of honesty and integrity with an emphasis on safety, health and environmental performance. On our team, people are acknowledged for embracing new practices that help create real value for customers.

title: Senior Product Manager - HRScale
jd_text: Insperity provides the most comprehensive suite of scalable HR solutions available in the marketplace with an optimal blend of premium HR service and technology. With more than 90 locations throughout the U.S., Insperity is currently making a difference for thousands of businesses and communities nationwide. Behind our success is the unshakeable belief in the value of our people. We value diversity, inclusivity and a sense of belonging. We celebrate work and life events, and we partner with our clients and communities to make great things happen. We’ve earned recognition time and again as a top place to work—named among the best by respected organizations like Glassdoor and U.S. News & World Report. We’re also proud to be recognized for one of the country’s Top 50 Midsize Early Talent Programs through RippleMatch’s Campus Forward Awards. There’s never been a better time to be part of Insperity, and our best work is still ahead. Learn more at Insperity.com. Why Insperity? Flexibility: Over 80% of Insperity’s jobs have flexibility. We want your time to have balance, whether it’s spent with coworkers, clients, family or your community. Career Growth: Insperity provides many ways to grow with the company. We offer continuous learning programs, mentorship opportunities and ongoing training. Well-Being: Our total rewards package includes generous paid time off, top-tier medical, dental and vision benefits, health & wellness support, paid volunteer hours and much more. We take care of our people so that you can do your best work. We are seeking a talented Senior Product Manager - HRScale to join our team. Insperity is advancing HRScale, a co-developed solution with Workday that brings enterprise-class human capital management capabilities to the middle market in an entirely new way. HRScale pairs Workday’s HCM technology with Insperity’s industry-leading PEO co-employment model, and high-touch service delivery to help larger, more complex clients manage their workforce with greater confidence, agility, and scale. As Senior Product Manager, HRScale, you will help shape the next stage of growth for one of Insperity’s most strategic product offerings. You will contribute to the vision, strategy, roadmap, adoption, and commercial success of HRScale across Insperity’s up-market portfolio. Working at the intersection of client needs, product strategy, the Workday partnership, technology, and service delivery, you will collaborate with others to identify the highest-value opportunities to improve the client experience, help us make disciplined investment and prioritization decisions, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing growth. This is a high-impact opportunity to define and optimize a strategic solution inside an established company with deep HR expertise, strong client relationships, and a differentiated service model. You will not simply manage a roadmap or coordinate partner activity. You will help answer the harder product questions: where should HRScale go next, what client and business problems must it solve better, how should Insperity deliver the solution well at scale, and how will we know it is creating real value for the business and the clients we serve? RESPONSIBILITIES: Product Strategy & Market Development Evolves the vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap for HRScale, Insperity’s flagship up-market HCM solution, aligned with enterprise strategy, solution priorities, business objectives and market needs. Coordinates with Enterprise Analytics and partners across the organization to conduct market research, client interviews, and competitive analysis to identify customer needs, market trends, and business opportunities. Builds business cases and facilitates internal alignment and investment decisions required to advance product strategies. Identifies must‑have requirements and key differentiators to be reflected in product capabilities, marketing strategy, and service delivery standards. End-to-End Product Ownership Serves as an accountable owner for HRScale across the full lifecycle, from concept through launch, scale and ongoing evolution. Uses an understanding of the strategy for Insperity’s up-market solutions to inform actionable roadmaps, phased investments, pilot initiatives, and scalable operating models. Makes or recommends, as appropriate, disciplined trade‑off decisions across scope, sequencing, and investment, balancing client value, scalability, and commercial outcomes. Acts to reduce ambiguity and clarify ownership by providing clear direction and decision rights to continually improve product performance. Commercial Success & Product Performance Management Drives the overall commercial success of HRScale, including growth, sustainability, and scalability. Partners with Finance and Enterprise Analytics to understand revenue drivers, cost‑to‑serve dynamics, and product economics. Defines and updates ongoing product success metrics and reviews performance to inform decisions and continuous improvement. Identifies opportunities to improve pricing, packaging, margin profile, and operational leverage, elevating recommendations as appropriate. Decision Authority & Governance Acts as a decision authority for product‑level decisions within defined scope. Makes decisions regarding prioritization of enhancements and changes to the product, in the context of available resources and higher-level priorities. Elevates decisions requiring Product Management leadership, Solution Management, and/or Management Team approval (e.g., pricing, major new investments, sunsetting) with clear recommendations, supporting analysis, and trade‑off considerations. Ensures products within defined scope are represented consistently and effectively in portfolio management and governance forums. Cross Functional Leadership & Execution Collaborates with cross‑functional teams including Technology, Service Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Gross Profit Operations to define requirements for capabilities – both technology and service delivery – that will meet client needs and work for Insperity. Coordinates with others in Product Management and Solution Management roles to ensure alignment between solution‑level strategy, product-level strategy and underlying capabilities and product roadmaps. Recognizes the need for change and leads through influence and intentional communication to drive alignment and execution of plans. Serves as the internal champion for assigned products by clearly articulating strategy and direction based on market insights and client feedback. Market, Client & Sales Enablement Represents the voice of the client and market for HRScale and the client needs the solution addresses. Gathers and incorporates feedback from clients, Sales, Service Operations, and internal stakeholders to address existing and emerging needs and validate ideal customer profile. Partners with Sales and Marketing to support clear selling motions, product narratives, enablement materials, and strategic opportunities. Partner Management Manages product level relationships with strategic external partners that enable or support assigned solutions. Coordinates with Corporate Development and other stakeholders to identify opportunities to evolve, expand, or supplement partnerships based on strategic direction and market needs. Ensures partner dependencies, risks, and roadmap considerations are understood and reflected in product and solution planning. QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s Degree in a related field, or related work experience is required. 5+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, or service design/delivery/management. Proven experience leading cross-functional initiatives. Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in matrixed organizations. Master’s Degree (MBA or equivalent) is preferred. Experience with HR solutions, enterprise software, or tech‑enabled services. Experience working with external partners supporting complex solutions. Strong analytical skills with experience developing business cases and evaluating trade‑offs. Background in both technology and service-based product offerings. Strong understanding of customer needs and ability to translate them into product direction. Aptitude to accept complex assignments, analyze problems, and generate effective solutions. Ability to apply a systematic method to problem solving, analyze data, and recommend strategies that support positive business results. Strong analytical abilities, results oriented nature, the ability to manage multiple projects, work independently or as part of a team, and plan, organize and complete assignments timely. Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, verbally and in writing, effectively present complex, financial information; work effectively and accurately under narrow time limitations; work effectively with others; work independently from general instructions; and maintain effective work relations with those encountered in the course of employment. Ability to manage multiple projects at one time. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across teams. Ability to operate independently and make informed decisions within defined scope. Strong collaboration skills in a cross-functional, matrixed environment. Bias for action, continuous improvement, and delivering meaningful outcomes. This job specification should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbent will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required by the supervisor. At Insperity, we celebrate the diversity of our employees and our leadership. Insperity is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Partner Development Business Analyst
jd_text: The Partner Development Business Analyst supports the Partner Development team through business analysis, operational oversight, and process improvement initiatives. This role helps ensure the systems, reporting, and workflows that support partner management and revenue growth are accurate, efficient, and scalable. Working cross-functionally across Salesforce, reporting, contracts, customer support, finance, and project management workflows, the Business Analyst will leverage data-driven insights and sound judgment to prioritize initiatives, resolve operational challenges, and recommend strategic improvements. This position also manages a small portfolio of high school and junior college partners, providing valuable exposure to sales, account management, and partner development, with a pathway toward future Partner Development Manager opportunities. Essential Duties & Responsibilities: Manage post-sale contract and operational workflows, ensuring completed deals are accurately transitioned across internal systems and teams. Analyze partner performance, revenue trends, sales pipeline health, renewals, and operational metrics to identify risks, opportunities, and actionable recommendations for leadership. Lead the design, implementation, documentation, and continuous improvement of business processes across Salesforce, contract management systems, Jira, Taskland, and related platforms. Establish and maintain Salesforce governance standards, monitor data integrity, and implement corrective actions to improve CRM accuracy and effectiveness. Coordinate Partner Development initiatives across Finance, Operations, Product, Design, Support, SIDEARM Extended, and other internal teams. Evaluate and assist with prioritizing Tier 2 customer support issues, coordinating appropriate follow-up and escalation when necessary. Identify operational risks, process gaps, reporting issues, workflow bottlenecks, and inefficiencies, and implement solutions that improve performance, scalability, and business outcomes. Develop dashboards, reports, and analyses that support informed decision-making and operational visibility. Manage a small portfolio of high school and junior college partners, including renewals, proposals, account management activities, and revenue growth opportunities. Support accounts receivable follow-up and collections coordination, helping resolve outstanding issues in partnership with Finance and Partner Development stakeholders. Perform additional analytical, operational, and commercial responsibilities as needed to support departmental objectives and broader company initiatives. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree required. 2+ years of experience in business analysis, sales operations, revenue operations, commercial operations, project management, or a related field. Strong Salesforce experience with a demonstrated understanding of CRM governance, sales pipeline management, reporting, and data integrity. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with business reporting and analytical tools. Experience analyzing business performance and providing reports, dashboards, insights, and recommendations to management. Proven ability to evaluate business processes, identify risks and inefficiencies, and recommend practical, results-oriented solutions. Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and cross-functional initiatives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders. Ability to exercise sound judgment, establish priorities, and drive results without direct authority. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Jira, Taskland, or similar project and workflow management tools. Experience working in SaaS, technology, sports technology, education technology, or a related business environment. Commercial mindset with a strong interest in developing expertise in sales, relationship management, and partner development. title: Project Manager, Implementation
jd_text: As a Project Manager on SIDEARM's Implementation team, you will play a key role in how our client work gets planned, coordinated, and delivered. You will be part of the operational engine that brings SIDEARM's digital products to life for our athletic department partners — from website redesigns and mobile app launches to the migration of clients onto our next-generation content management system (CMS). jd_text: Company: INEOS Olefins & Polymers USA Interested in joining a winning team? A team whose employees are empowered to make a difference? Success is measured by sustained improvement in asset economics and decision quality, even when the team is not directly engaged in the day‑to‑day.
