Leadership & Team Management Lead, coach, and develop the technical team. Establish performance expectations and accountability. Promote disciplined execution and technical rigor. Strategy, Optimization & Value Creation Identify and prioritize optimization and debottlenecking opportunities. Own and govern opportunity registers. Drive sustained economic improvement. Technology & Intellectual Asset Stewardship Develop and maintain multi-year technology roadmaps. Steward analytical models and technical studies. Capital Investment & Project Support Own CAPEX investment plans for optimization initiatives. Support FEL development and capital justifications. Cross-Functional Integration & Influence Interface with manufacturing, asset, and project teams. Translate technical analysis into decision-ready insight. Key Success Indicators Sustained improvement in asset economics. High-quality strategic and optimization studies. Durable institutionalized gains. Skills & Knowledge Required Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or related discipline; advanced degree preferred. Typically 10 to 15 years relevant experience in chemical, petrochemical, or large-scale industrial manufacturing environments. Prior experience leading or mentoring technical professionals strongly preferred. Technical skills Advanced understanding of process technology, unit operations, and asset constraints. Strong capability in process modeling, heat and material balances, and scenario analysis to support optimization and strategic decision‑making. Demonstrated expertise in optimization, debottlenecking, and yield/energy efficiency analysis with quantified economic impact. Proficiency in technical‑economic evaluation, including ROI analysis, cost‑curve positioning, and value‑capture prioritization. Experience developing and governing multi‑year technology roadmaps aligned with business and asset strategy. Ability to identify and assess technology gaps, capability limits, and upgrade pathways through benchmarking and long‑range studies. Working knowledge of capital project development processes (FEL 0/1), including technology scoping, business justification, and option evaluation. Strong understanding of asset economics, unit cost drivers, and profitability analysis. Experience stewarding process models, technical studies, and intellectual assets with disciplined governance. Solid grounding in process safety, reliability principles, and operational risk considerations related to optimization and technology change. Ability to translate complex technical analyses into clear, decision‑ready recommendations for leadership. Leadership & Behavioral skills Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop technical professionals, creating an environment where individuals are empowered to perform at their best. Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work persuasively and credibly across disciplines and at all organizational levels. Proven capability to lead diverse teams and align stakeholders around shared objectives and strategic priorities. Effective at prioritizing work to ensure focus on the most critical, highest‑value activities. Ability to delegate work appropriately, with clear expectations, accountability, and follow‑through. Comfortable and effective engaging with senior leadership, translating complex technical topics into clear, decision‑ready insight. Demonstrates sound judgment, problem‑solving capability, and a sense of urgency appropriate to business‑critical decisions. Models a strong work ethic and ownership mindset, while reinforcing sustainable performance through the team rather than personal effort alone. Line Management Responsibility The PP/Utilities Technical Team Lead has 2 to 3 direct reports. Our culture is one of honesty and integrity with an emphasis on safety, health and environmental performance. On our team, people are acknowledged for embracing new practices that help create real value for customers.

title: Senior Manager, Oracle EPM Platforms
jd_text: Position Summary We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager to serve as the architect and platform owner for our Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Cloud landscape, spanning EPBCS (Planning & Budgeting), FCCS (Financial Consolidation), ARCS (Account Reconciliation) and EDMCS (Enterprise Data Management). This role owns the end-to-end architecture, integration design, and roadmap across all four platforms, and acts as the primary escalation point our internal teams & vendors. The role is expected to lead concurrent EPM implementation and enhancement projects. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable writing calculation manager scripts and Groovy business rules as they are setting strategy with finance and IT leadership — someone who can design, build, and troubleshoot personally, while directing and holding both a managed service team and parallel implementation teams accountable to timelines, quality, and roadmap commitments. Key Responsibilities Architecture & Platform Ownership • Own the end-to-end solution architecture across EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, and EDMCS, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, and aligned to enterprise data and finance standards. • Design and build EPM Cloud configurations (Essbase/hybrid, business rules, calculation manager scripts, Groovy business rules, task lists, forms, and dashboards) directly, without relying solely on the managed service team for build work. • Architect and maintain integrations between EDMCS and downstream applications (EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS) to ensure consistent dimensionality, mappings, and hierarchy governance across the metadata model. • Design and support data integration pipelines (EPM Automate, REST APIs, Data Management/FDMEE, Data Integration) between EPM applications, the GL/ERP source systems, and downstream reporting tools. • Configure and optimize reconciliation rules, matching logic, and workflows for account reconciliations in ARCS, aligned with close calendar and controls requirements. Key Responsibilities • Define and maintain the multi-year technology roadmap for the EPM platform footprint, incorporating Oracle's quarterly cloud release features, new capabilities, and deprecations. • Direct and coordinate EPM support team, acting as the primary point of contact for day-to-day operations, incident escalation, enhancement requests, and release coordination. • Review and validate MSP deliverables (SLAs, response/resolution times, ticket quality, code/config standards) against contractual and internal expectations, and drive corrective action when performance slips. • Author technical specifications and architecture guardrails for tasks assigned to the managed service team, including detailed requirements, test plans, and acceptance criteria, to ensure work is built correctly the first time. • Serve as the technical liaison between the MSP and internal stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical scope the service team can execute against. • Manage the shared backlog of enhancements, defects, and change requests across all four platforms, prioritizing based on business impact, risk, and platform roadmap. Stakeholder & Team Leadership • Partner directly with FP&A, Accounting/Controllership, and Financial Reporting leadership to translate evolving business requirements into platform enhancements. • Present regularly on architecture decisions, platform health, roadmap progress, and risk to finance and IT executive leadership. • Maintain deep functional knowledge of the underlying business processes (planning, consolidation, reconciliation, and master data management) to design fit-for-purpose solutions rather than one-off fixes. • Mentor or oversee a small internal team of EPM analysts/administrators where applicable, in addition to managing the external managed service relationship. Platform Scope Direct architectural and functional ownership across the following Oracle EPM Cloud modules: • EPBCS (Enterprise Planning & Budgeting Cloud Service): Multi-dimensional planning, budgeting, and forecasting models; Smart View/Web forms; business rules; workforce, capital, and project planning modules as applicable. • FCCS (Financial Consolidation & Close Cloud Service): Financial consolidation, intercompany eliminations, currency translation, ownership management, and close process automation. • ARCS (Account Reconciliation Cloud Service): Reconciliation compliance, transaction matching, integration with source sub-ledgers, and close task automation. • EDMCS (Enterprise Data Management Cloud Service): Enterprise dimension and hierarchy governance, metadata synchronization, and mapping across all connected EPM and ERP applications. Required Qualifications • 8+ years of progressive experience in Finance Systems, IT, or Enterprise Applications, with at least 4+ years in a hands-on Oracle EPM architect or lead role. • Demonstrated hands-on experience building configuring, and supporting at least three of the four platforms: EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, EDMCS. • Prior experience managing a managed service provider (MSP) or managing outsourced/offshore application support teams against SLAs. • Proven track record running multiple concurrent EPM implementation projects (e.g., new module rollouts, upgrades, migrations) alongside steady-state managed services, including coordinating systems integrators or contract resources across overlapping timelines. • Strong working knowledge with EPM Automate, REST/SOAP APIs, Groovy (business rule scripting), Data Management/FDMEE, and Smart View. • Solid understanding of Essbase concepts (block storage/aggregate storage), dimension design, and calculation logic. • Working knowledge of core FP&A, consolidation, and account reconciliation business processes and controls (e.g., SOX). • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to finance executives. • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Preferred Qualifications • Oracle EPM Cloud certification(s) (e.g., Oracle EPM Cloud implementation certifications for Planning, FCCS, ARCS, or EDMCS). • Prior experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency organization supporting a large or global enterprise environment. • Experience integrating EPM Cloud (e.g., through Data Integration/FDMEE) to major ERP platforms (Oracle Fusion, SAP, Workday, NetSuite, etc.). • SQL or scripting experience (PowerShell, Python, VBScript, or similar) for automation of EPM operational tasks. • Familiarity of Oracle's quarterly readiness process and change management practices for cloud EPM environments. Key Competencies • Hands-on technical depth. Able to write scripts, calc rules, and integrations personally, not only review others' work. • Systems thinking. Sees the platform landscape as one connected ecosystem rather than four siloed tools. • Vendor/service management. Comfortable directing a third-party team's day-to-day work while owning ultimate accountability for outcomes. • Judgment under pressure. Able to balance urgent break-fix needs with long-term roadmap and architecture integrity. • Ownership. Drives issues to resolution and proactively identifies risks before they affect the close or planning cycle. • Parallel workstream management. Can run several implementation workstreams and the managed service queue at once without losing track of dependencies or priorities. title: Principal Product Manager, Consumer Digital Experience
jd_text: Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future. As a Consumer Domain Principal Product Manager, you'll own how we engage and personalize for consumers globally across all digital touchpoints. That means both we build the channels themselves around the consumer. This is your first mandate inside the broader Consumer Domain, and as you improve impact here, scope can expand into adjacent parts of the consumer journey. You'll start by building a clear, evidence-based view of where our current engagement channels and personalization capabilities are helping or holding us back — and make the call on what comes next. This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't manage a team, own a budget, or run sprint execution. However, you will lead the outcomes of this domain end-to-end, from assessment to roadmap to what ships. You'll partner with multiple teams across our global footprint, including engineering, data science, design, marketing/CRM, legal/privacy, and regional/market teams. You'll work with them to turn your recommendations into requirements. Additionally, you'll collaborate with Directors and VPs to understand how this domain connects to the broader consumer experience. The goal of this domain: consumers everywhere feel like we know them — the right message, on the right channel, at the right moment, no matter where they are in the world. Success is engagement and personalization performance that measurably improves over time. This roadmap supports this performance because it grounds itself in evidence rather than opinion, and the business puts its trust in it. Additionally, it involves engagement infrastructure that gets smarter — not just bigger — as we scale into new markets and channels. About the Job Assess & Set the Consumer Engagement & Personalization Agenda Assess how well our current communications digital channels serve consumers across our global markets. Build a fact-based point of view on what's working, what isn't, and where the highest-use opportunities are. Diagnose how personalized our consumer engagement is today, from basic segmentation to real-time, individualized decisioning. Define the roadmap to close the gap between where we are and where we need to be. Lead the multi-year vision and prioritized roadmap for consumer engagement and personalization, translating your assessment into a clear set of recommendations and work tracks. Manage the trade-offs across recommendations: what we invest in first, what we deprioritize, and why. Platform & Personalization Infrastructure Decisions Make build-vs-buy-vs-partner recommendations for the foundational capabilities behind personalization and engagement. These capabilities include whether we need a customer data platform (CDP), a recommendation or decisioning engine, stronger pipelines into our communications platform, or new orchestration tooling. Defend these recommendations. Define the data and signals — purchase history, browse behavior, preferences, lifecycle stage — that should improve personalization, and oversee the requirements that make those signals usable in real-time across channels. Write the PRDs, briefs, and requirements that turn your recommendations into build-ready work for engineering, data science, and product teams. Stay close to delivery, not just requirements — unblock trade-offs in-flight and remain accountable for what ships, not just what's written down. Global & Market-Specific Strategy Determine where a single global approach to engagement and personalization makes sense. Identify where strategies specific to the market are needed. Run tests to compare tactics across regions, and other markets we operate in, rather than assuming a one-size-fits-all strategy. Identify which personalization signals and logic generalize globally and which need local tuning — product, size, or content relevance often differs by region, on top of channel and regulatory differences. Partner with regional and market teams to understand local channel norms, consumer behavior, and regulatory requirements, and factor them into your roadmap. Build the frameworks, strategies, and shared tooling that let regional teams move fast without fragmenting the underlying platform. Measurement & Continuous Optimization Define the engagement and personalization metrics that matter globally and by market and oversee the test-and-learn agenda that improves them. Run a disciplined, cross-market experimentation pace, working in the data (SQL, dashboards, experiment results) to determine what generalizes globally versus what you need to localize. Cross-Functional & Executive Alignment Collaborate and influence the engineering, data science, design, and partner teams, keeping them aligned to one prioritized set of investments rather than competing asks. Represent the consumer engagement and personalization domain in cross-functional planning and annual operating plan (AOP) cycles and make the case for investment — including new platforms or infrastructure — to Directors and VPs. Mentor Senior PMs and PMs across markets on personalization and lifecycle craft, and raise the department's bar for how data and AI show up in consumer engagement globally. About You Bachelor's degree required. Have 8+ years of experience in product management. This experience includes direct ownership of a consumer-facing product, such as personalization or consumer engagement platforms (email, push, SMS). This experience would have a global or multi-market scope. Experience with personalization techniques — segmentation, rules-based targeting, and ML-driven recommendations/decisioning — and judgment for when each is the right tool for the job. Experience diagnosing personalization maturity. Build the business case for what closes the gap, e.g., CDPs, data pipelines across tools, decisioning/orchestration layers, including build-vs-buy-vs-partner calls. Experience shipping a roadmap of connected plans — not just setting strategy. You can point to specific recommendations, features, or campaigns you specified and shipped, and the results they drove. Experience adapting product, engagement, or personalization strategy across regions or markets (e.g., the U.S., Europe, APAC, or similar), including navigating region-specific regulatory and channel norms. Experience partnering with data science/ML teams on personalization or decisioning models. Have expert-level fluency in AI system design. This includes orchestration, human-in-the-loop patterns, and their trade-offs, such as latency, cost, accuracy, and responsible use. Comfortable working directly in the data — SQL, dashboards, and experiment design — including comparing results across markets to make and defend prioritization calls. Experience collaborating and influencing teams, including engineering, data science, design, CRM/lifecycle, legal/privacy, and regional/market. Partner with these teams across different regions without formal authority. Additionally, I am comfortable operating across time zones with globally distributed partners. This is an individual contributor role. It does not include people management, budget/vendor ownership, or sprint execution. However, you will be the clear, accountable owner of the consumer engagement and personalization roadmap and its requirements. Experience in retail, apparel, or e-commerce personalization at scale, across multiple international markets. Experience with identity resolution, data clean rooms, or cross-device matching for personalization. Experience applying generative AI to content or creative personalization, including localized or multi-language content. This role is remote work eligible within the U.S. or can work on a hybrid basis out of our San Francisco, CA headquarters. The expected starting salary range for this role is $147,000 - 240,000 per year. We may pay more or less than the posted range based on the location of the role. We will base the amount an employee will earn within the salary range on factors such as relevant education, qualifications, performance and our needs. Levi Strauss & Co. (LS&Co.) offers a total rewards package that includes base pay, incentive plans, 401(k) matching, paid leave, health insurance, product discounts, and more designed to help you and your family stay healthy, meet your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. Available benefits and incentive compensation vary depending upon the specifics of the role; details relating to a specific role will be made available upon request. Read more about our benefits here . LS&Co. is an affirmative action and equal employment opportunity employer. We welcome and value people from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences to make LS&Co. a collective success. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require current or future employment visa sponsorship. The company does not participate in the H-1B cap lottery or sponsor initial employment visas. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong><span style="font-size: 14pt;">About Us</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!</span></p></div><h3><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h3> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">DriveWealth LLC is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Security &amp; Threat Operations Manager to build and mature the function protecting our brokerage platform and corporate environment. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will grow and lead the team, establish its operating model and roadmap, and deliver measurable improvements in threat detection, investigation, incident response, and exposure management.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><br>In this hands-on leadership role, you will own detection content and the exposure management lifecycle, security monitoring and incident response, operation and tuning of security controls, and turn threat intelligence into defensive improvements. You will act as Incident Commander during significant security incidents and coordinate response across technical and business teams. Partnering with Security Engineering, DevOps &amp; Platform, and Product &amp; Engineering, you will ensure defenses evolve along with our AWS platform, Kubernetes services, low-latency trading infrastructure, and corporate technology within an innovative and entrepreneurial culture.<br><br></span></p> <h3><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></h3> <p><strong>Program Maturity &amp; Team Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Program Development: Mature Security &amp; Threat Operations through a measurable roadmap, defined operating model, appropriate monitoring coverage, escalation procedures, and service provider oversight.</li> <li>Team Development: Grow and lead the team through hiring, coaching, training, career development, and performance management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Threat Detection, Investigation &amp; Intelligence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Detection Engineering: Own the detection program incorporating threat intelligence, content development, proactive hunting, and validation through attack simulations and purple-team exercises. Treat detection content development as an engineering discipline.</li> <li>Monitoring &amp; Investigation: Own security monitoring and investigation across product and corporate environments, including phishing, malware, credential compromise, API abuse, DDoS, and insider threats.</li> <li>Digital Risk Monitoring: Own digital risk monitoring covering external attack surfaces, leaked credentials, exposed data, impersonation, phishing domains, and takedown coordination.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Incident Response</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automated Response: Partner with Security Engineering to build pre-defined automated security response actions. Coordinate with business leaders on required response actions which cannot be automated or which require compensating actions to prevent unnecessary business disruption.</li> <li>Incident Management: Own the incident response lifecycle as Incident Commander, including preparedness, forensic evidence handling, containment, recovery validation, regulatory coordination, and post-incident improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Exposure Management &amp; Control Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure Management: Own the exposure management lifecycle from discovery through verified closure, coordinating remediation with accountable system and product owners.</li> <li>Control Operations: Own the operation and tuning of operational security controls, such as DLP, WAF, email filtering, and identity compromise prevention in partnership with Security Engineering, DevOps &amp; Platform, and Product &amp; Engineering to meet evolving product and corporate technology requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance &amp; Assurance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Regulatory Controls: Partner with Legal, Compliance, Security Engineering and GRC to implement SEC and FINRA requirements, including SEC Rule 17a-3 and 17a-4 controls supporting record capture, preservation, integrity, access, and retrieval.</li> <li>Control Assurance: Partner with Security Engineering to automate control validation and evidence collection. Support audits and regulatory examinations, and drive remediation of technical findings.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>You Bring</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in security operations, detection engineering, incident response, or related disciplines, including 3+ years managing technical teams and experience building or maturing an operations function.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience serving as Incident Commander during significant security incidents, making decisions under pressure, coordinating multiple teams, and communicating clearly with executives and business stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong hands-on expertise in threat intelligence, detection content development, SIEM and endpoint analytics, investigation, threat hunting, and defensive validation.</li> <li>Practical scripting or query skills in Python, SQL, or comparable languages.</li> <li>Working knowledge of AWS, Kubernetes, API security, identity, and Windows/macOS endpoint telemetry. Experience supporting production environments with demanding availability and latency requirements is preferred.</li> <li>Experience creating, operating, and tuning preventive controls such as DLP, WAF, and email filtering while managing false positives and business impact.</li> <li>Experience investigating insider threats and digital risks such as exposed credentials, impersonation, and phishing domains, with appropriate handling of sensitive information and coordination with HR and Legal.</li> <li>Strong people leadership, process design, and prioritization skills, with the ability to influence Engineering and IT, manage competing operational demands, and support on-call escalation and incident response outside normal business hours.</li> <li>Familiarity with NIST CSF, incident response practices, and MITRE ATT&amp;CK. Experience in regulated financial services, including SEC/FINRA environments and applicable incident, data protection, and recordkeeping obligations, is preferred.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, or GCFA are a plus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Location</strong></h3> <p>This role is open to candidates in the following locations: <strong>New York City, Chicago, Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco Bay Area, or Seattle</strong>.&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If based in New York or Chicago: This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.</li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If based in Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco, or Seattle: This is a fully remote role, though you may need to visit our onsite offices from time to time.</li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Pay Range</strong>: $200,000 – $250,000 USD</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Working at DriveWealth</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.</span></p> <p data-path-to-node="5"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Work Authorization</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>How We Think About AI</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Compensation</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.&nbsp; If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Agency Disclaimer</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.</span></p></div>

jd_text: SOM - Supplier Operations Manager Description - Job Summary The Supplier Operations Manager (SOM) is responsible for driving the execution of labor operations through strong operational rigor, governance, and supplier engagement. This role works closely with external vendors to ensure workforce capacity, performance, productivity, and compliance align with business objectives. The SOM owns key operational metrics, monitors supplier performance, drives corrective actions, and supports business-critical escalations to ensure service delivery and customer commitments are met. Serving as the primary operational interface between the business and suppliers, the SOM leads execution, resolves operational challenges, and drives continuous improvement to deliver business outcomes and financial targets. Responsibilities Serve as the primary operational interface between the business and external suppliers, fostering strong partnerships and driving accountability for operational outcomes. Drive the execution of labor operations by ensuring supplier staffing, workforce planning, capacity management, and delivery activities align with business requirements and service commitments. Own and monitor key operational metrics, analyzing performance trends, identifying risks, and driving corrective actions to achieve service, productivity, quality, and financial objectives. The Mission Technology Solutions business partners with governments and defense, intelligence, space, aviation, and critical infrastructure customers to deliver high-end engineering, science, technology, and mission support solutions. Key Responsibilities Support the administration and tracking of software assets throughout their lifecycle, including requests, deployments, renewals, reclamation, and retirement. Maintain accurate records of software licenses, subscriptions, contracts, entitlements, and installations. title: Lead Quality Control Technician
jd_text: Classification: Hourly Shift: Second Shift - 8 (United States of America) Job Description: Are you looking for a new challenge? Passionate about innovation? Want to work for a global company that values integrity, teamwork, and loyalty? At LATICRETE International, we aim to be the leading construction brand trusted globally for high-performance tile and stone installation systems and building finishing solutions. We’ve been in business for over 65 years, family-owned for three generations, and can be found in over 100 countries. The Hartford Business Journal even named us one of Connecticut’s top family-owned companies in 2017! We don't just make innovative, industry-leading products. Our purpose is to improve the built world and the lives of those who build it. We strive to connect with, engage with and improve the lives of our employees, our customers, our partners, and the global communities in which we operate. We are seeking passionate and ambitious employees who want to make a difference not just within our organization, but within their communities, our industry, and the world. If that sounds like you, then what are you waiting for? Join the family and expand your horizons! Just some of our benefits: Medical Dental Vision 401k Tuition reimbursement 13 paid holidays, that includes 1 week of paid plant shutdown between the Christmas and New Year's Day holidays Paid vacation and sick time Flexible spending Life Insurance, AD&D and Supplemental Insurance POSITION SUMMARY This position is responsible for providing technical oversight for a local team of in a designated Quality Control lab and ensures that the team meets all the LATICRETE quality criteria. This individual works with the designated Sr. QC Manager and/or Regional Supervisor to oversee the implementation of process improvement initiatives that result in improved processes for Production and implements and supports programs to ensure the Manufacturing Quality Control Team executes efficient, reliable and repeatable Quality Assurance/Control processes and activities. The Quality Control Lead ensures all products manufactured meet or exceed quality standards as well as all safety, environmental and ISO requirements. The Quality Control Lead will provide technical guidance to the local QC team designated by the Sr. QC Manager and/or Regional Supervisor. The QC Lead will ensure that lab’s QC team are accomplishing continuous improvement initiatives in the manufacturing and QC environment. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary. 1. QC Lab and Process Management (60%): Ensure that (G)ood (L)aboratory (P)ractices are being followed across plants along with 5S methods for laboratory organization and ensures that QC personnel across plants are trained. Lead QC team develop and perform process improvement at local QC lab to meet standard capacity for testing and safety requirements. Be the technical leader with the work process to update and improves QC Lab work instructions, procedures, and calibration of QC instrumentation referenced in the LATICRETE Quality Control Manual. Perform QC tests at the local QC lab. Lead communications between local QC and operations to determine priorities and specific needs to preserve Quality of the product at all the time including the control of non-conforming product. 2. Data Analysis/Technical Management (35%): Work with the Sr. QC Manager or Regional QC Supervisor to ensure that manufacturing and raw material specifications exist and are current and enforced. Perform internal QC lab audits to ensure all QC data is accurate and reliable. Work with Sr. QC Manager/Regional QC Manager, Process Chemist, and Process Engineering team to troubleshoot problems associated with finished product production in assigned facilities. Ensure the local QC team is maintaining a reliable QC database. Report on Quality Metrics Performance for the local manufacturing plant and any potential causes that impact the Quality of the product based on the data provided by the local QC team. 3. Department and People Management (5%): Perform duties of a working QC Lead at homebased QC lab. Develop a rapport with multiple Plant Leadership Teams, QA Team, and R&D personnel. Lead the technical portion of training department employees in QC procedures. Foster a success-oriented, accountable environment, recognizing and rewarding performance that drives desired results. Provide technical leadership to QC team in local lab. Be prepared to travel to other labs as needed. REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Education and Experience: 7+ years experience working in a lab environment required. Bachelor’s degree (Chemistry or Technical focus desired) or equivalent relevant QC and/or laboratory certifications and experience is a plus. Specialized Skills and Experience : Strong technical knowledge of chemistry in the following area(s): cementitious chemistry, epoxy liquids, latex, and/or any LATICRETE product lines highly preferred. Previous experience with color matching and knowledge or experience utilizing a colorimeter highly desired. Ability to give, receive and analyze information, formulate work plans and prepare written materials and articulate goals and action plans. Ability to do simple math calculations, input data into a computer and analyze data is required. Advanced computer/technical skills including demonstrated experience using Access, ACT, Excel, Word and Strong ERP software knowledge. Able to participate in Quality Control and Environmental Safety Organizations. Able to work independently with minimal oversight. Excellent record keeping, documentation and organizational skills. Able to management multiple assignments and projects simultaneously with shifting priorities, deadlines and focus. Must be adaptable and flexible. Travel Requirement: May be required to travel up 15%. This role will cover designated QC labs. Physical Requirements: Must pass pre-employment physical. Lift: Must be able to lift and/or carry a minimum of 50 pounds repetitively. Occasional lifting of 60+ pounds required. Push/Pull: Must be able to push/pull 50 pounds repetitively. Occasional push/pull of 60+ pounds required. Stand: Must be able to stand 50-75% of the day. Sitting: Must be able to sit 25-50% of the day. Twisting/Bending: Must be able to twist/bend 50-75% of the day. Squatting, Climbing and/or Crawling: Must be able to squat/climb/crawl 20% of the day.

title: Director, Lifecycle Technology & Operations
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About Crunchyroll</h2> <p>Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.</p> <p>Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As the Director, Lifecycle Technology &amp; Operations, you will lead the global operating model and technical foundation that enables Lifecycle Marketing to deliver personalized, data-driven customer experiences at scale.</p> <p>You will oversee global Lifecycle Operations while serving as the primary Lifecycle business owner for our customer engagement and orchestration platform and the broader technology and data ecosystem that powers customer engagement. Today, Braze sits at the center of that ecosystem. You will define platform strategy and stewardship; journey and campaign operations; customer data and audience capabilities; personalization and decisioning; governance; automation; capacity; and partner delivery. This will build capabilities that can scale globally while supporting the needs of individual regions and markets.</p> <p>Sitting at the intersection of Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Technology, Data, Product, and Operations, this role combines ownership of the technical foundation that powers Lifecycle with leadership of the operating model that brings it to life. You will partner closely with Marketing, Martech, Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, Analytics, and regional teams, serving as the connective tissue among customer strategy, platform capabilities, data, and execution.</p> <p>You will bring strong operational leadership with meaningful technical depth and experience operating at a global scale. You will help build the next stage of Lifecycle Marketing by building a high-performing global operation, shaping the Lifecycle technology roadmap, evolving our customer engagement and orchestration capabilities, diagnosing data and platform issues, and creating processes that enable global strategies to be efficiently localized across markets, languages, channels, and regulatory environments.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Core Areas of Responsibility</strong></h3> <h3><strong>Lifecycle Technology &amp; Platform Leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary Lifecycle business owner and technical subject-matter expert for Braze and the broader Lifecycle technology ecosystem, with deep working knowledge of Braze Canvas and campaign architecture, Liquid, Catalogs, Connected Content and API integrations, segmentation, personalization, experimentation, channel configuration, and AI-enabled decisioning and orchestration capabilities; own platform strategy, governance, configuration standards, roadmap priorities, tooling, consumption, and ongoing platform health.</li> <li>Partner directly with Martech, Product, Engineering, and Data Engineering to define and operationalize the events, attributes, APIs, data contracts, and integrations required to build trigger-based Lifecycle journeys in Braze, including API-based ingestion and utilization of content and metadata to power real-time, contextually relevant intervention messaging across global and regional teams.</li> <li>Serve as Lifecycle’s dedicated partner to the Braze Technical Account team, leading enhancement discovery, technical recommendations, platform adoption, and roadmap planning; translate emerging Braze and AI capabilities into prioritized use cases and regularly share roadmap implications, recommendations, and enablement guidance with cross-functional Lifecycle Directors and Leadership.</li> <li>Establish best practices for journey architecture, event-driven messaging, segmentation, channel orchestration, experimentation, personalization, and reusable platform capabilities.</li> <li>Maintain a strong understanding of how our customer engagement and orchestration platform connects to Product, customer data platforms, content systems, analytics, reporting, and downstream destinations, and identify opportunities to improve or simplify the ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Global Lifecycle Operations</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the global operating model supporting Lifecycle teams and programs across regions and markets, including subscription journeys and automations, regional marketing, ecommerce, games, manga, theatrical, events, and the broader Crunchyroll fan ecosystem.</li> <li>Own the end-to-end operational process from intake and prioritization through audience development, campaign and journey build, QA, deployment, monitoring, and optimization.</li> <li>Build scalable campaign and journey operations that allow global strategies and capabilities to be efficiently adapted and localized across markets, languages, channels, and regulatory requirements while maintaining speed, quality, and consistency.</li> <li>Build and continuously improve a flexible delivery model across internal teams, regional resources, agency partners, offshore resources, specialized technical expertise, and automation.</li> <li>Establish clear standards for prioritization, capacity management, development, QA, launch readiness, documentation, incident management, and operational performance—continually improving speed, quality, reliability, and efficiency.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Lifecycle Data, Audiences &amp; Personalization</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own Lifecycle Marketing requirements for the events, attributes, audiences, preferences, behavioral signals, content data, and other customer inputs needed to power personalized experiences across markets.</li> <li>Partner with CDI, Data Engineering, Martech, Product, and Analytics to identify data gaps, improve signal quality and observability, and prioritize instrumentation and integration needs.</li> <li>Enable increasingly sophisticated audience creation, behavioral triggers, content affinity, personalization, decisioning, and next-best-action capabilities that can be applied globally while allowing for regional and market-level relevance.</li> <li>Translate customer and marketing strategies into clear data and technical requirements and help ensure Lifecycle-critical data is reliable, measurable, and fit for purpose.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Governance, Automation &amp; Scale</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Reimagine and maintain global governance for customer communications, including messaging hierarchy, prioritization, frequency management, consent and preferences, suppression logic, and cross-channel coordination.</li> <li>Define scalable global standards for campaign quality, approvals, deliverability, accessibility, localization readiness, documentation, and operational controls, while accommodating market-specific requirements where needed.</li> <li>Identify and implement practical applications of automation and AI across audience creation, journey development, QA, personalization, content production, workflow management, reporting, and knowledge management.</li> <li>Continuously evaluate new platform capabilities and emerging technologies, helping move high-value opportunities from pilots into repeatable, scalable solutions across markets.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Team &amp; Cross-Functional Leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build, develop, and lead a high-performing Lifecycle Technology &amp; Operations team with strong capabilities across platform enablement, journey development, campaign operations, data quality, and operational governance.</li> <li>Manage agency and external partner performance across quality, throughput, cost, technical capability, service levels, and continuous improvement, building partners toward greater autonomy and accountability.</li> <li>Serve as a key connector between global Lifecycle Marketing, regional teams, and technical partners, translating marketing ambition into technical requirements while helping marketers understand platform capabilities, constraints, and opportunities.</li> <li>Influence cross-functional technology and data roadmaps by clearly articulating Lifecycle use cases, customer impact, regional requirements, dependencies, operational needs, and measurable business value.</li> </ul> <p>In the role of Director, Lifecycle Technology &amp; Operations, you will report to the VP, Lifecycle Marketing.</p> <p>We are considering applicants for the locations of Los Angeles or Dallas.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About You</strong></h2> <p>We get excited about candidates, like you, because...</p> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience across Lifecycle Marketing Operations, CRM Operations, Marketing Technology, Marketing Operations, customer engagement platforms, or related disciplines within a scaled consumer business.</li> <li>5+ years of experience leading teams, complex marketing operations, or technical marketing programs, including management of internal and external resources.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience leading Lifecycle, CRM, Martech, or marketing operations across multiple regions and markets, including building global capabilities that support localization, regional requirements, and market-specific execution.</li> <li>Deep experience with Braze ESP, including journey orchestration, segmentation, behavioral triggers, personalization, experimentation, and multi-channel execution.</li> <li>Technical understanding of JavaScript and HTML, with the ability to use both to configure and support lifecycle marketing-platform experiences and integrations.</li> <li>Hands-on experience setting up, managing, and troubleshooting data connections in Databricks to support reliable data pipelines, integrations, audience activation, and downstream marketing-platform use cases.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency across customer data architecture, events, attributes, audiences, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, identity, and data-quality monitoring.</li> <li>Experience serving as a platform owner, senior business stakeholder, or highly technical operator responsible for how a customer engagement or marketing automation platform is configured, governed, used, and evolved.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate customer and marketing needs into technical requirements, platform capabilities, roadmaps, and scalable solutions.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with MarTech, Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, and regional teams to deliver new customer-facing and operational capabilities.</li> <li>Experience supporting global localization across markets.</li> <li>Proven experience designing and improving global operating models, including intake, prioritization, resource and capacity management, QA, governance, deployment, and incident management.</li> <li>Experience managing agencies, offshore teams, vendors, budgets, and technology or platform investments.</li> <li>Strong understanding of customer-contact governance, deliverability, suppression logic, consent and preference management, privacy, and operational risk across complex markets.</li> <li>Demonstrated success advancing personalization, automation, experimentation, decisioning, or real-time customer engagement capabilities.</li> <li>Ability to move comfortably between marketing, operational, data, and technical conversations and translate complex concepts for different audiences.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional leadership, influencing, program management, and problem-solving skills within complex, matrixed, global organizations.</li> <li>Experience within streaming, subscription, entertainment, gaming, ecommerce, media, or another high-volume digital consumer business is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Experience applying AI or emerging marketing technologies to improve scale, efficiency, or customer experience is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Passion for anime, entertainment, or fandom-driven businesses is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>Lifecycle Marketing is part of Crunchyroll’s broader Growth organization and is responsible for building deeper, more relevant relationships with fans throughout their journey with Crunchyroll.</p> <p>Our team works globally across membership engagement and retention, regional title marketing, ecommerce, games, manga, theatrical, events, and other parts of the Crunchyroll fan experience. We partner closely with Product, Martech, Data, Analytics, Content, and regional teams to connect those experiences through increasingly personalized, data-driven customer communications.</p> <p>Lifecycle Technology &amp; Operations provides the operational and technical foundation that makes that work scalable, reliable, locally relevant, and increasingly sophisticated across global markets.</p> <h2><strong>Why you will love working at Crunchyroll</strong></h2> <p>In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:</p> <ul> <li>Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.</li> <li>Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.</li> <li>Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance</li> <li>Health Saving Account HSA program</li> <li>Health care and dependent care FSA</li> <li>401(k) plan, with employer match</li> <li>Employer paid commuter benefit</li> <li>Support program for new parents</li> <li>Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!</li> </ul> <p>#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About our Values</h3> <p>We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value</p> <ul> <li> <p>Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.</p> </li> <li> <p>Curiosity. jd_text: Distinguished Technologist - Principal Architect, Platform Security and Firmware Systems Description - HP is seeking a senior technical leader to serve as a lead architect for hardware rooted Platform Root of Trust for HP's commercial PC platform. In this role, you will be responsible for envisioning, defining, and driving the architecture of hardware, firmware, software, and cloud-integrated security capabilities that protect HP commercial PCs from current and emerging threats. You will also work across the hardware and security architecture teams, collaborate with HP's Security Research Labs, Firmware (BIOS) team, our security business that creates and deploys industry leading enterprise security and manageability solutions, product management, manufacturing, supply chain, customer enablement, and field organizations to create cohesive system solutions that deliver unique customer value. This position requires deep expertise in embedded systems, platform firmware, hardware, security, device manageability, and PC system architecture. The role also requires the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into customer-relevant value propositions and to influence internal and external stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority. Responsibilities Serve as principal architect for HP Endpoint Security Controller roadmap, associated hardware and firmware based capabilities, cryptographic identity, attestation, secure communication, event logging, and future controller generations. Define and evolve HP Sure Start architecture and related firmware resilience capabilities, including hardware-enforced firmware authenticity, recovery, update, and protection mechanisms. Drive secure BIOS and firmware configuration management strategies, including HP Sure Admin ecosystem capabilities, key management, zero-touch provisioning, customer deployment models, and integration with enterprise management tools. Lead cross-functional architecture definition across hardware, BIOS, embedded controller firmware, diagnostics, cloud services, client software, manageability tools, product management, and customer-facing teams. Anticipate emerging threats and technology shifts, including quantum-safe cryptography, platform attestation, supply-chain security, physical tamper resistance, peripheral authentication, and new non-volatile memory architectures. Partner with silicon vendors, operating-system providers, standards organizations, internal and external security research teams, and internal product teams to influence and align platform security direction. Support customer briefings, field escalations, competitive positioning, technical marketing, training events, and executive communications related to HP commercial PC platform security. Create specifications, proof-of-concepts, validation tools, scripts, demonstrations, and reference implementations that accelerate adoption of new security capabilities. Mentor engineers and technical leaders by sharing architectural context, reviewing designs, developing talent, and helping teams make practical tradeoffs among security, cost, schedule, customer experience, and portfolio impact. Education & Experience Recommended Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. Extensive experience in PC, embedded, firmware, hardware, or platform system architecture, preferably in commercial client systems or security-sensitive devices. Demonstrated ability to architect solutions that span hardware, firmware, software, cloud services, manufacturing, and customer deployment environments. Deep technical understanding of BIOS/UEFI, embedded controllers, secure boot, firmware update and recovery flows, cryptographic signing, PKI based device identity, attestation, and secure configuration management. Experience defining product requirements, writing technical specifications, driving proof-of-concepts, and influencing roadmap decisions across multiple engineering teams. Ability to communicate complex technical ideas clearly to executive, engineering, customer, sales, and field audiences. Proven ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization and to resolve ambiguity across competing business, technical, and customer priorities. Preferred Qualifications Experience with hardware based roots of trust, platform certificates, DICE/SPDM concepts, supply-chain assurance, quantum-safe cryptography, secure element or embedded security controller identity, and compliance or certification frameworks. Experience with enterprise endpoint manageability platforms such as Intune, SCCM, device-management consoles, or cloud-based key management services. Hands-on capability with scripting or development tools such as PowerShell, C#, Python, Java, GitHub, Visual Studio Code, or similar environments. Experience with customer-facing technical briefings, sales enablement, competitive analysis, standards participation, patent development, or external security ecosystem collaboration. Familiarity with commercial PC platform architecture, silicon vendor security technologies, Windows platform security, docking, peripheral security, battery authentication, telemetry, and right-to-repair considerations. Critical Technical Domains HP Endpoint Security Controller architecture, roadmap definition, cryptographic identity, attestation evidence, enhanced logging, and next-generation hardware requirements. HP Sure Start and firmware resilience, including hardware-enforced firmware authenticity, recovery, update protection, and quantum-safe firmware protection. HP Sure Admin and secure BIOS settings management, including key management, zero-touch provisioning, smart card or YubiKey authentication concepts, fine-grained authorization, and enterprise deployment workflows. Platform security roadmap planning across BIOS, embedded controller firmware, manufacturing diagnostics, endpoint management tools, and customer-facing security capabilities. Future-looking architecture areas such as target-attached flash, SPI-NAND, secure NV storage, peripheral authentication, SPDM requester/responder models, DICE-style identity, and post-quantum cryptography retrofits. Leadership Expectations Operate as a senior individual contributor who sets technical direction, creates architectural clarity, and helps HP prioritize the highest-value security investments. Build trust with cross-functional engineering teams by understanding implementation detail while keeping focus on the larger system architecture and customer outcome. Help convert exploratory concepts into practical product plans, proof-of-concepts, specifications, and production-ready capabilities. Represent HP platform security credibly in customer, partner, industry, and internal executive discussions. Develop and mentor technical talent so the organization can scale architectural knowledge and continue delivering differentiated security innovation. Measures of Success Clear, actionable architecture and roadmap for next-generation HP platform security capabilities. Successful delivery of security-controller, firmware-resilience, secure-management, and attestation capabilities into commercial PC products. Increased adoption of HP security capabilities by enterprise customers and improved ability for field teams to explain HP’s differentiated platform security value. Reduced ambiguity and improved prioritization across security-related product planning, engineering execution, and customer enablement efforts. Growth of technical bench strength through mentoring, documentation, design reviews, and knowledge transfer. jd_text: Principal Enterprise Architect Description - Position Overview The Principal Enterprise Architect plays a strategic architecture role within the Office of the CIO. The role helps establish and mature an enterprise architecture capability that connects business priorities with technology strategy and execution across the HP Enterprise. The Principal Enterprise Architect translates business strategy into target architectures, transition roadmaps, standards, and investment guidance across business, application, data, integration, cloud, technology, and AI domains. The role promotes reuse and simplification and helps teams deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and business-aligned solutions. Key Responsibilities Help define and operationalize the enterprise architecture operating model, principles, methods, standards, decision rights, and measures of value. Lead architecture for major enterprise initiatives from strategy and discovery through target-state definition, transition planning, and delivery guidance. Develop current-state assessments, target architectures, reference architectures, and multiyear roadmaps for critical enterprise capabilities and platforms. Connect business strategy, operating models, and capability needs to technology priorities, portfolio choices, and investment decisions. Guide simplification, reuse, interoperability, application rationalization, lifecycle management, and technical debt reduction across a complex global technology landscape. Assess complex technology choices and recommend patterns, platforms, and strategic direction based on business value, total cost, scalability, resilience, interoperability, and long-term fit. Define and maintain reusable architecture assets, including principles, standards, reference architectures, patterns, and decision records. Serve on the Architecture Review Board, providing pragmatic review, constructive challenge, and clear guidance without creating unnecessary delivery friction. Influence portfolio planning and investment decisions by clarifying dependencies, tradeoffs, transition costs, architectural risk, and the business consequences of technology choices. Communicate complex architecture topics clearly to executives, business leaders, architects, engineers, and delivery teams. Guide platform teams in designing enterprise AI platforms that support generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, MLOps, enterprise data access, model lifecycle management, and observability at scale. Define reusable guardrails and patterns for AI security, privacy, responsible use, data protection, identity and access, model governance, resilience, interoperability, and cost-effective scaling. Promote consistent AI platform capabilities and integration approaches that limit fragmentation, duplicated investment, unmanaged risk, and isolated solutions. Partner with product specialists and functional architects during discovery to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions — and provide technical leadership across the organization's most complex cross-functional initiatives. Coach and develop engineers at every level through active involvement in their technical growth, manage capacity across concurrent initiatives, and build a team culture defined by ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career About This Role: The Principal Architect is a senior individual‑contributor who defines, leads, and governs the software architecture vision across our device and digital ecosystem. This includes our on-device firmware, cloud services, analytics platforms, data pipelines, clinician and patient‑facing applications, AI/ML enablement platforms, and operational software systems. This leader drives architectural excellence, technology strategy, and systems coherence across R&D, product, clinical, data science, and the intersection of our products with IT. The role ensures that the on-device and off device software ecosystem is secure, scalable, resilient, compliant, and aligned with product strategy and long-term business goals. Operating at an enterprise level, this role influences senior stakeholders across engineering, product, quality, regulatory, and security while maintaining deep technical credibility. Key Responsibilities Technology & Architecture Strategy Define the multiyear architecture strategy for all product software systems, spanning cloud, application, data, integration, and ML/AI infrastructure. Establish architectural principles, reference architectures, and guardrails that support reliability, performance, interoperability, maintainability, and regulatory compliance. Ensure holistic systems thinking across software platforms, clinical workflows, device interactions, and data flows. Evaluate emerging technologies and provide strategic recommendations for adoption, modernization, and platform evolution. ​Architectural Leadership & Governance Lead cross-functional architecture forums and governance processes, ensuring consistent patterns, shared services, and disciplined decision-making across teams. Drive architectural clarity early in product development by guiding systems decomposition, API strategies, data models, and cloud architectures. Review key technical proposals, high-impact design decisions, and fundamental platform changes across R&D teams. Champion engineering quality standards for architecture, coding, testing, observability, and documentation. Cross Functional Influence & Collaboration Partner with product management to translate business needs into scalable technical strategies and architectural roadmaps. Collaborate with security, privacy, regulatory, quality, and clinical teams to ensure designs meet medical device standards and software compliance requirements. Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior leadership, articulating architectural options, trade-offs, risks, and business impacts. Bridge off device and on device systems to ensure seamless end to end workflows, data flows, and system integrity. Execution Support & Technical Leadership Provide architectural oversight throughout the SDLC, guiding teams during concepting, detailed design, implementation, and release. Drive standardization, reducing duplication and accelerating development velocity through clear architectural patterns. Mentor engineering leads and architects across the organization through thought leadership, coaching, and technical review. Lead technical investigation and resolution of complex systemic issues, spanning data, scalability, reliability, or workflow interactions. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred. 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering or architecture, with deep expertise in large scale distributed systems, cloud architectures, and modern application platforms. Proven experience architecting regulated or high reliability systems (preferably within medical, health tech, or similar domains). Mastery of architectural domains such as microservices, event driven systems, data pipelines, observability, DevOps/SRE practices, and cloud native technologies. Ability to operate as a senior level individual contributor influencing executive teams without direct authority. Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts in clear, concise, and business relevant terms. Demonstrated success partnering with cross functional leaders across product, security, quality, regulatory, data science, and infrastructure. Preferred Experience with FDA, EU MDR, IEC 62304, HIPAA, and related regulatory frameworks for software as part of medical systems. Background supporting AI/ML platform architecture, model deployment, and clinical decision support software. Experience designing architectures that integrate with medical devices, clinical systems, EHRs, or healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7). Prior leadership in organizations scaling complex multi product software ecosystems. Location: Remote - US Actual compensation may vary depending on job-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location.
