title: Platform Architect
jd_text: Are you passionate about making a difference in people's lives? Do you enjoy working in a service-oriented industry? If so, this opportunity may be the right fit for you! Modivcare is looking for an experienced Platform Architect to join our team. As a Cloud Platform Architect, you will serve as a senior, hands-on technical leader within our Architecture practice, bringing deep cloud-native expertise, delivery involvement, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) discipline. You will define cloud architecture, build and validate infrastructure using Pulumi or AWS CDK, and work alongside engineering teams throughout delivery to ensure what is built matches what was designed. Your work will directly impact the scalability, security, cost efficiency, and reliability of the technology platforms that support Modivcare’ s business and the services we provide. This role offers the opportunity to shape our cloud capabilities while enabling engineering teams to deliver solutions that make a meaningful difference for the people and communities we serve. We’re looking for purpose-driven applicants who are motivated by using technology to solve meaningful business challenges, improve how teams deliver critical services, and build sustainable solutions that support Modivcare’ s mission. The ideal candidate combines strategic architecture expertise with a willingness to remain hands-on throughout delivery and takes ownership of turning well-designed architecture into measurable business impact. This role… Architecture & Design Defines cloud-native architecture patterns for the enterprise, covering compute, networking, storage, security, identity, and AI/ML workload infrastructure on AWS. Establishes and evolves cloud architecture standards, guardrails, and reference architectures that enable engineering teams to build secure, scalable, and consistent solutions. Evaluates new AWS services, IaC patterns, and platform capabilities, making build vs. buy vs. configure decisions with clear rationale and consideration for business value. Designs multi-account AWS organization structures, landing zones, and network topologies appropriate to healthcare compliance requirements, including HIPAA and SOC 2. Architects cost-efficient, right-sized infrastructure with FinOps principles embedded into the design from the start. Hands-On Delivery Builds and maintains infrastructure-as-code using Pulumi (TypeScript/Python) as the primary tool, with AWS CDK considered where Pulumi is not the right fit. Prototypes cloud infrastructure for new initiatives end-to-end, proving the architecture works before handing it off to engineering teams to scale and operate. Contributes directly to IaC repositories, writing production-quality Pulumi stacks that engineering teams can maintain, extend, and operate without rearchitecting. Works embedded with engineering teams during delivery phases, reviewing PRs, unblocking infrastructure decisions, and ensuring architectural fidelity through deployment. Produces complete handoff packages, including architecture diagrams, IaC repositories, runbooks, security and compliance documentation, and acceptance criteria. Maintains a clear boundary between architecture and operations, focusing on design quality and delivery excellence rather than incident response, on-call rotation, or day-to-day platform operations. Practice Leadership Provides technical direction to the offshore Cloud & Infrastructure Solutions Delivery Architect, reviewing architectures, setting standards, and mentoring on cloud-native delivery. Partners with the Director of Architecture on cloud strategy, roadmap, and investment decisions. Engages with business unit stakeholders to understand workload requirements and translates them into cloud architecture recommendations that support business objectives. Contributes to the broader Architecture practice by sharing patterns, leading cloud-focused guilds or working groups, and building the team’s collective cloud capability. Maintains awareness of the evolving AWS service landscape and healthcare compliance requirements, proactively surfacing relevant changes to the Architecture practice and engineering leadership. We are interested in speaking with individuals with the following… Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. Seven (7) or more years of progressively responsible experience in cloud architecture or cloud engineering, with the majority of recent experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale AWS solutions. Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise AWS cloud platforms, including multi-account strategies, cloud governance, and Infrastructure as Code. Experience developing cloud platforms within regulated industries, such as healthcare or other highly regulated environments, preferred. Experience working in embedded architecture or product delivery teams preferred. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional certifications preferred. Experience with AWS CDK, AI/ML infrastructure, healthcare data platforms, and FinOps tools preferred. Expert knowledge of AWS cloud technologies, including compute (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda), networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect), storage (S3, EFS, RDS, DynamoDB), and security services (IAM, KMS, Service Control Policies, GuardDuty, Security Hub). Advanced knowledge of cloud-native architecture principles, enterprise platform design, and multi-account AWS environments using AWS Organizations and Control Tower. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Pulumi (TypeScript or Python), AWS CDK, Git-based development workflows, modular architecture, state management, policy-as-code (e.g., Checkov, OPA), and drift detection. Demonstrated ability to design, prototype, and implement scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure solutions that align with business and technical requirements. Strong understanding of cloud governance, security, compliance, and architecture best practices, including experience supporting regulated environments such as HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar compliance frameworks. Knowledge of cloud migration strategies, cloud platform modernization, and enterprise architecture standards. Ability to evaluate emerging cloud technologies, tools, and services and recommend innovative, cost-effective solutions. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and technical decision-making skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to develop architecture documentation, technical standards, and implementation guidance for engineering, security, and business stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor architects and engineers, and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently with a high degree of autonomy while managing multiple priorities and complex technical initiatives. Preferred knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure on AWS (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, OpenSearch), FinOps practices and cost optimization tools, healthcare interoperability standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, Epic), and embedded architecture delivery models. Salary: 116,700.00 – 180,000 This role is bonus eligible based on individual and company performance. title: Manager, CS Operations Reporting & Analytics
jd_text: Join the Team Modernizing Medicine At ModMed , we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: we hired doctors and taught them how to code. This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care. A Culture of Excellence When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes: Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work 2025 Globee Business Awards: Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year” 2025 Black Book Awards: Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties Florida Venture Forum: Venture-Backed Company of the Year We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started. Ready to modernize medicine with us? Job Description Summary: The Manager, CS Reporting and Analytics leads a team responsible for delivering reporting, dashboards, and analytics that provide visibility into Customer Success performance . This role oversees the development and maintenance of operational metrics, reporting frameworks, and analytical insights that support decision-making across the Customer Success organization . The Manager partners with CS leadership to ensure reporting solutions align with business needs and support operational efficiency and performance improvement . Role & Responsibilities Oversee analysts who design, develop, and deliver operational reporting, dashboards, and analytics that support Customer Success leadership. Ensure operational metrics and reporting frameworks provide visibility into CS performance . Oversee development of dashboards and reports using systems such as Salesforce, BI tools, and operational data platforms . Ensure timely delivery of recurring KPI reporting and analytical insights . Validate reporting accuracy and data integrity . Manage and develop a team of Business Operations Analysts responsible for CS reporting and analytics . Provide guidance and prioritization for analytics projects and reporting initiatives . Coach analysts on analytical techniques, reporting best practices, and stakeholder engagement . Support professional development and performance management of analysts . Ensure team workload is aligned to organizational priorities . Partner with Customer Success leadership and operational teams to translate business needs into reporting and analytics solutions . Work with CS Operations, Professional Services, Account Management, and Support leadership to define reporting needs . Translate operational questions into analytical requirements . Ensure reporting solutions support operational decision-making and performance management . Improve reporting processes, operational metrics, and analytics capabilities . Identify opportunities to improve reporting automation and reporting workflows . Standardize KPI definitions and reporting methodologies . Ensure reporting processes support operational scaling . Communicate reporting results and operational insights to leadership . Present reporting outputs and trends to CS leadership . Provide insights and recommendations based on operational data . Ensure leaders understand the meaning and implications of performance metrics . Skills & Requirements Bachelor's degree (Management Information Systems, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Statistics) . A Master's is a plus, but not required . 2+ years of experience leading an R&A team supporting implementation, CS, or similar teams required. 5+ years of experience in analytics, reporting, or operations analysis. Advanced skills in Salesforce, Microsoft Excel, or Google Sheets (Logical formulas, Lookups, Pivot Tables) . Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Domo, and Databricks. Experience working in SaaS or technology organizations . Experience supporting Customer Success or services organizations . ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits: United States Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution, 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep. Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs, Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs, Company-sponsored Business Resource & Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed, Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning , Global presence and in-person collaboration opportunities; dog-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office-based roles and remote availability for some roles, Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters. PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website .

Demonstrated ability to interpret scientific or technical information and translate it into clear, audience-appropriate communication. Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with scientific, technical, commercial, regulatory, quality, or marketing stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines. Ability to collaborate effectively with teams located across multiple regions and time zones. Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree in Microbiology, Food Science, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline. Seven or more years of experience in technical marketing, applications, technical services, scientific affairs, product management support, or a related field. Experience within food safety, food microbiology, diagnostics, laboratory testing, or a related industry. Knowledge of food safety testing workflows, microbiological testing, laboratory instrumentation, and customer applications. Experience supporting global product portfolios or working with international teams. Experience supporting new product launches, commercialization initiatives, or product lifecycle management. Establish, implement, and maintain project management standards, processes, tools, and best practices to improve project delivery and efficiency. Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, vendors, subcontractors, and project partners, while managing expectations and ensuring satisfaction. jd_text: At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team. Job Summary The Workforce Analytics team provides reporting tools, analysis, and insights that empower leaders to make key people decisions and drive business value. Partnering with HR, finance and business leaders, the Senior Workforce Analyst builds scalable reporting tools, analyzes workforce trends, and applies statistical and visualization methods to deliver insights that drive strategic decision-making across the organization. The Senior Analyst, Workforce Analytics is a hands-on role - deeply consultative, but always in the data - solving complex workforce and business challenge. This individual will partner closely with HR, Finance, Technology, and business leaders to understand the problem behind a request, ask the right questions, analyze data, and determine the appropriate solution rather than simply completing assigned reports or building dashboards. The role requires someone who is comfortable working in ambiguity and gray areas, can independently take an undefined problem and work it through to resolution, and knows when to collaborate with others to move an issue forward. The ideal candidate combines strong people analytics, dashboarding, and technical skills with curiosity, resourcefulness, critical thinking, and strong interpersonal skills, and can translate complex data into a clear story that helps leaders understand what is happening, why it matters, and what actions they should consider. Experience in workforce / people analytics strongly preferred; familiarity with HR/HCM data structures required 2+ years with hands-on experience with HCM report and dashboard design and development; Oracle HCM experience strongly preferred. Experience in Strong ability to apply statistical models, forecasting techniques, and workforce analytics methodologies. Advanced proficiency in Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools (PowerBI, Tableau) Excellent communication and storytelling stills, with proven ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations for senior leaders. Strong analytical mindset with expertise in project management, stakeholder management, critical thinking and problem solving Principal Accountabilities Partner with HR, Finance, Technology, and business leaders to understand workforce challenges and translate them into data and reporting needs. Lead complex workforce analyses using statistical models and advanced analytics to assess key HR metrics, forecast trends, and support strategic decision making. jd_text: Privacy Notice for California Applicants and Employees Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. Meow Wolf opens portals of possibility. Come as you are! We are individuals who inspire creativity in people's lives through art and exploration, so that our combined imaginations can transform the world we live in. We create immersive and interactive experiences that transport audiences into fantastic realms of story and exploration. Our Vision is to be the world’s leading creative company, reimagining the paradigm of art and storytelling, to make a positive difference in the world. We share a strong commitment to Belonging through our values of: Collaborative Creativity : We believe the act of creating together amplifies possibilities. Provocative Playfulness: We celebrate the unexpected because it is the doorway to discovery. Outsiders Welcome: We are all outsiders at heart, and we create space for everyone to feel like they belong. Authentic Compassion: We are “kind punks” - supportive to each other and standing up for what we believe in. Audacious Courage: We have the courage to radically reinvent ourselves to push the boundaries of art. If this all sounds like YOU, read on…. Job Description: Job Disclosures: Location: (On-Site) Grapevine, TX Job Summary: The Lead Exhibition Technical Engineer is a technologist that works in a unique and exceptional immersive arts exhibition covering areas of lighting, sound, video, projections, networking, show power, control & automation, interactive game mechanics, computer art installations, and animatronics. This role is responsible for repairs and preventive maintenance of exhibit technology, along with design and development of enhancements related to the functionality and overall experience of the exhibition. The ideal candidate should be proficient in redesigning or the rebuilding of problematic systems or installation of new systems. The Exhibition Technology team is tasked with operating and maintaining the exhibition daily, supporting special events, media events and contributing to new exhibit installations. Job Responsibilities: Maintenance & Operations: Conduct systematic daily inspections, routine cleaning, and comprehensive preventive maintenance across all exhibit technology, electronics, and interactive show components. Efficiently diagnose and resolve complex technical hardware and software issues, while accurately logging bug reports, repair histories, and maintenance schedules using the corporate CMMS database. Team Collaboration & Leadership: Partner closely with local exhibition staff, facility maintenance teams, and cross-site sister exhibition engineering groups to foster cross-functional knowledge transfer and collaborative problem-solving. Serve as a technical subject matter expert, authoring clear standard operating procedures (SOPs), guiding best practices, and training staff on operation of new show control systems and diagnostic tools. Technical Support & Integration: Guarantee high system availability for daily exhibit operations, special guest events, and media productions. Execute low-voltage wiring, device configuration, component replacement, and deployment of software, firmware, and media content updates across show control networks, theatrical/architectural lighting, Q-SYS audio, video, and micro-controllers. Project Development & Enhancements: Continuously observe visitor interactions to conceptualize and design technical enhancements that elevate the overall guest experience. Participate in the mechanical integration, physical fabrication, coding, and prototyping of custom interactive artwork, while thoroughly documenting as-built schematics, system topologies, and software version histories. Required Qualifications: Experience & Education: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on professional experience in emerging media technology, creative tech installations, software development, electrical engineering, or professional AV systems integration. Associate degree, technical institute certification, or equivalent practical industry experience required. title: Sr. Technical Dealer Support Specialist
jd_text: Senior Technical Dealer Support Specialist Why Mobility Global? At Mobility Global, our mission is to provide the trusted information that helps billions of people build, sell, and own vehicles with confidence. As we shape the next generation of automotive intelligence through innovation, AI, and industry-leading data, we're creating new opportunities for our customers, our business, and our people. Founded in 2012, automotiveMastermind, a part of Mobility Global, is the automotive industry's trusted data and technology provider. The company drives greater salesperson efficiency through its use of Actionable Intelligence and personalized experience. Through a combination of behavioral predictive analytics, targeted marketing outreach, and expert consulting, automotiveMastermind empowers dealers and OEMs to seamlessly blend data and intelligence with personalized insights. Our Company was founded on the idea that there are patterns in people’s behavior that, with the right logic, can be used to predict future outcomes. We are a small but rapidly growing organization that works in partnership with our customers to create solutions that are simply not found anywhere else. We work in groups rather than in structured corporate hierarchies; our culture is creative and entrepreneurial where everyone contributes to company goals in very real way. We are a hardworking group, but we have a lot of fun with what we do and are looking for new people with a similar mindset to join the organization. Our proprietary software-as-a-service helps automotive dealerships and sales teams better understand and predict exactly which customers are ready to buy, the reasons why, and the key offers and incentives most likely to close the sale. Its micro-marketing engine then delivers the right message at the right time to those customers, ensuring higher conversion rates and a stronger ROI . What You'll Do • Serve as a subject matter expert on automotiveMastermind products, systems, processes, and initiatives while providing exceptional support to internal and external customers. • Resolve complex technical issues escalated from Level 1 by troubleshooting, investigating root causes, prioritizing incidents, and coordinating escalations to other support teams as needed. • Manage inbound inquiries from Business Partners and Field Teams, documenting troubleshooting efforts, setting stakeholder expectations, and providing updates through Slack, email, text, and video conferencing. • Create and maintain knowledge resources, including Knowledge Base articles, FAQs, best practices, system documentation, and training materials to improve team effectiveness and customer self-service. • Coach, mentor, and train Level 1 team members on troubleshooting best practices, product releases, new initiatives, and overall support readiness. • Administer and optimize the Zendesk environment, including user management, reporting and dashboards, workflow automations, macros, web forms, process improvements, and participation in recruiting and interviewing new team members. What We're Looking For • Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of experience in technical support, customer support operations, SaaS support, consulting, or a related field. • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to build relationships and effectively communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences. • Advanced troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex issues and identify root causes. • Demonstrated experience managing customer relationships and delivering exceptional customer service in a fast-paced environment. • Advanced experience with relational databases, including SQL queries, joins, views, and stored procedures. • Advanced proficiency with Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis. • Experience working with ticketing and customer support platforms such as Zendesk, including documentation, workflow management, and escalation processes. • Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, knowledge base articles, training materials, and process documentation. o Ability to independently manage competing priorities, multiple projects, and time-sensitive deadlines. • Understanding software development methodologies and the Agile development lifecycle. • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to make sound, timely decisions. • Experience coaching, mentoring, onboarding, or training team members preferred. • Experience administering customer support systems, reporting platforms, dashboards, automations, or workflow tools preferred. • Previous automotive industry experience preferred. • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and representing the company professionally. The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $64,320.00 - $133,799.00. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity considerations. jd_text: Job Summary: FIELD OPERATIONS MANAGER Location: Austin, TX Division: Ticketmaster NA - Festivals & GA (Front Gate Tickets) Line Manager: Senior Field Operations Manager Contract Terms: Full-Time, 40 hours per week THE TEAM Front Gate Tickets is North America’s leading software and operations provider for the festival market. We provide technical solutions for e-commerce ticketing, access control, data management, and fan engagement. We partner and run on-site operations for over 200 festivals each year and are on a massive growth trajectory matched by no one in the industry. We do it for the fans! Front Gate is owned by Live Nation Entertainment and acts as Ticketmaster’s festival arm. We have two offices located in Austin, TX. The position will be working out of those offices. THE JOB The Field Operations Manager is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the execution of onsite client events and festivals operations in collaboration with multiple departments and clients. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING Successfully deploy FGT equipment and services at locations around the world in collaboration with multiple stakeholders. Establish time-lines and equipment needs for installations and other on-site deliverables in collaboration with Client Operations Managers and clients. Execute in field, onsite festival and box office technologies and deployment in conjunction with Client Operations Managers and clients. Create, fulfill and ship packing lists for all venues, events and festivals. Maintain existing processes and develop new processes as needed to maintain maximum efficiency. Maintain inventory of festival assets, including ensuring dirty, dusty and grimy gear returned from festivals is kept in top shape, organized and cared for. Assess loss after each festival and coordinate with Operations and Client Account Managers for coverage of damage from client. Provide support and training on FGTs products and services at events and festivals. Execute other duties, projects and events as assigned. WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS) 5+ years' of operations experience. Strong Microsoft Office skills, specifically Excel. Background in ticketing and/or entertainment industry a strong plus. Ability to travel and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends for extended periods of time. title: Manager, Product Operations & UX
jd_text: Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery. Merge is one of the most widely deployed medical imaging platforms in the world. Radiologists and cardiologists rely on us to store, move, and read imaging studies across enterprise health systems, teleradiology reading centers, and community hospitals. We are modernizing the portfolio for the cloud and building empowered product teams that own outcomes — and this role builds the operating model and design foundation those teams run on. The opportunity This is an enabling-function leadership role with three connected parts. Product Operations is how product gets built and run — the product development lifecycle, program management, the operating cadence, and the tooling and data that keep everyone working from one source of truth. AI enablement is how we make that lifecycle faster and sharper — using AI to accelerate funnel development, build and pressure-test business cases, and prioritize where the org spends its capacity. UX is product design, user research, and the design system that make the reading experience consistent, usable, and clinically sound. Together they are the backbone that lets empowered teams move fast without losing quality. You will report directly to the VP, Product, and lead across all three — serving every product team rather than owning a single product. What you’ll own Operating model and cadence. Own how product is built and run: the product development lifecycle, the operating rhythm of planning, reviews, and metrics, and portfolio operations across teams. Program management. Own program and release management — keeping cross-team initiatives on track and dependencies, risks, and progress visible to leadership. Tooling and data. Own the product toolchain and the portfolio data and metrics, so teams and leaders share one trustworthy view of how we are doing. AI enablement and AI-accelerated PDLC. Own how AI is applied to the lifecycle itself — compressing the path from opportunity to validated, scoped work; standing up business cases with AI-assisted sizing and evidence; and sharpening portfolio prioritization. Design and research (UX). Lead product design, user research, and the design system — partnering with product and engineering from discovery through launch. What you’ll do Standardize the product development lifecycle and operating cadence so teams discover, build, and ship consistently — with AI embedded in how the org works. Use AI to accelerate funnel development — shortening the path from raw opportunity to validated, scoped, ready-to-build work. jd_text: Job Description For over 130 years, we have pioneered groundbreaking science. Today, we are driven by continuous innovation to develop breakthrough medicines, vaccines and technology. POSITION SUMMARY AND SCOPE The Level O1 Machine Operator is the foundation of the production line. This position operates a laser, laser/ink-jet, or E.I.D. marking station to mark, label, and package Livestock Identification tags in strict accordance with SOPs, work instructions, and customer requirements. Success in this position is measured by safe behavior, right-first-time quality, accurate real-time documentation, and consistent attainment of the required daily output for the assigned machine. The O1 Operator is expected to know the standard, run to the standard, and stop and escalate immediately when anything deviates from it. This role is the entry point into a defined operator progression (O1 → O2 → O3 Production Line Lead), and demonstrated mastery of O1 duties is the prerequisite for advancement. RESPONSIBILITIES Production Execution Operates a laser, laser/ink-jet, or EID (Electronic Identification Device) marking station to mark Livestock Identification tags per SOP, and performs labeling and packaging of finished product to specification. Maintains the required and acceptable daily output as determined by the assigned job and machine, and communicates immediately to the Line Lead when the target is at risk. Verifies materials, work orders, and packaging components against the production order before running, and confirms all packaging is available and correct. When the workstation is shut down, takes prompt action to secure help in correcting the malfunction and returning the workstation to production in the shortest time possible. Performs basic troubleshooting, setup verification, and cleaning activities within current training and qualifications; never operates outside of qualified tasks. Quality and Traceability Conducts required quality checks at the defined frequency and stops production immediately when nonconforming product is identified. Verifies print and marking quality, EID programming, label accuracy, and customer requirements on every order. Watches for wrong materials, incorrect EID programming, traceability discrepancies, product mix-ups, equipment abnormalities, missing documentation, and safety concerns — and stops production and notifies the Line Lead, Supervisor, Technician, or Quality Technician the moment these conditions are observed. Maintains traceability records and ensures suspect product is never allowed to continue down the line while an issue is unresolved. Documentation Completes all production documentation accurately and in real time, including startup sheets, downtime logs, production records, scrap documentation, and quality records. Records downtime accurately with the correct reason so losses can be analyzed and eliminated. Teamwork, Safety, and Housekeeping Performs all assigned tasks in accordance with safety procedures and work instructions; wears all required PPE, including safety glasses, steel-toe safety footwear, gloves, and other PPE required for the assigned area. Maintains safe work practices and immediately reports unsafe behaviors and conditions; stops the job for any unsafe condition, without exception. Assists with onboarding and cross-training of employees using approved training methods and SOPs when qualified to do so. Maintains housekeeping in the assigned area and participates in 5S, Lean Manufacturing, and continuous improvement initiatives. Follows established conduct, procedures, and safety rules for the area. Performs other duties as assigned. EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS High School Diploma or equivalent required. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Experience operating a computer, including operating a mouse, retrieving a file, and the demonstrated ability to learn new basic computer skills. Ability to accurately enter and retrieve production information using manufacturing systems, production databases, and electronic documentation systems; ability to learn and utilize SAP, MES, Galaxy, or other production-related software systems as required. Proficiency in basic math skills — counting, handling numbers, addition, and subtraction — sufficient to perform production calculations, quantity verification, traceability reconciliation, and inventory counts. Good manual dexterity; ability to safely handle production materials, packaging components, livestock identification tags, trays, pallets, and related equipment. Ability to read, comprehend, and follow SOPs, Work Instructions, Job Sheets, Production Orders, Quality and Traceability Records, and Customer Requirements. Ability to identify, communicate, and escalate safety, quality, equipment, and traceability issues in a timely manner. SKILLS Attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset. Strong safety awareness. Basic troubleshooting skills. Effective communication skills. Ability to maintain accurate, real-time production documentation. Reliability, punctuality, and ownership of the assigned workstation. Willingness to learn, cross-train, and support continuous improvement initiatives. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND SAFETY Ability to perform physical tasks, including lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling materials weighing up to 30 pounds throughout the shift. Ability to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive tasks with sustained attention to detail. Responsible for wearing and maintaining required PPE, including safety glasses and steel-toe safety footwear, and complying with all site safety requirements while performing assigned duties. #MSJR The salary range for this role is: $39,200 - $61,800 This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. title: IB Temporary - Medical Information Specialist
jd_text: Company Overview ImmunityBio is a vertically integrated commercial stage biotechnology company developing next-generation therapies that bolster the natural immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases. The Company’s range of immunotherapy and cell therapy platforms, alone and together, act to drive and sustain an immune response with the goal of creating durable and safe protection against disease. Designated an FDA Breakthrough Therapy, ANKTIVA is the first FDA-approved immunotherapy for non-muscle invasive bladder cancer CIS that activates NK cells, T cells, and memory T cells for a long-duration response. The Company is applying its science and platforms to treating cancers, including the development of potential cancer vaccines, as well as developing immunotherapies and cell therapies that we believe sharply reduce or eliminate the need for standard high-dose chemotherapy. These platforms and their associated product candidates are designed to be more effective, accessible, and easily administered than current standards of care in oncology and infectious diseases. Why ImmunityBio? • ImmunityBio is developing cutting-edge technology with the goal to transform the lives of patients with cancer and develop next-generation therapies and vaccines that complement, harness and amplify the immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases. • Opportunity to join a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company with headquarters in Southern California. • Work with a collaborative team with the ability to work across different areas of the company. • Ability to join a growing company with professional development opportunities. Position Summary The IB Temporary - Medical Information Specialist will be accountable for aligning, implementing, and integrating systems, tools, technologies, and processes for Medical Information and Medical Communications from an operations perspective, as it relates to inquiries from a global contact center processing Medical Affairs Information requests for ANKTIVA (nogapendekin alfa inbakicept-pmln) with Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) for the treatment of adult patients with BCG unresponsive nonmuscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) with carcinoma in situ (CIS) with or without papillary tumors, global Investigator site inquiries, and patient/caregiver Inquiries about eligibility into our Clinical Trial programs. Provides labeled and unlabeled efficacy, safety, and related scientific information responses in accordance with regulatory requirements, industry standards and client. Identifies, documents and reports adverse events, special situation events and product complaints in an accurate, clear, and concise manner to Pharmacovigilance. Reviews and confirms eligibility for current clinical trial programs, and if applicable, connects patient/caregiver with appropriate clinical trial contact. Performs other activities as assigned. Prior experience in Oncology (Prostate, Bladder Cancer, Lung Cancer, Glioblastoma, Colo-Rectal Cancer) is a plus. Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and show good judgement, compassion, honesty, integrity, and trust building behaviors in all dealings is essential and required. Knowledge of HIPPA and other federal guidelinesExcellent verbal and written communication skills, as the position will interface with key opinion leaders, patients, caregivers and senior leadership team members within ImmunityBio. An ability to effectively communicate, collaborate and deliver an excellent work product in a fast-paced, and rapidly changing and dynamic environment. Working knowledge of medical terminology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, regulations and industry standards. Excellent customer-service orientation to talk with patients and caregivers interested in clinical trials managed by ImmunityBio. Self-motivated, with initiative and the ability to take ownership of and follow through on tasks. Ability to multi-task and shift priorities quickly while working under tight deadlines. Proficient in Microsoft Office computer applications. jd_text: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. This team is part of Motorola Solutions’ Software Enterprise division, which offers secure, reliable and efficient team communications, workflow and operational intelligence solutions for mission critical public safety and enterprise markets throughout the world. Development and operation of common platform services—centered on RedHat OpenShift and Kubernetes —that are leveraged by our software solutions. Physical and Virtual Infrastructure: Managing the full stack, including Networking, Storage, and Compute , to ensure the reliability and security of environments where our services run. Reliability & Performance: Define and meet strict scalability, availability, and security goals for local environments. Collaboration: Rapidly build and evolve major platform features in collaboration with Product Management and other engineering stakeholders. Governance: Assist in reviews and audits conducted at various points in the software life cycle to ensure compliance and security. Qualifications: Hands-on Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of Linux Administration and container orchestration (Kubernetes/OpenShift) is mandatory. Experience: Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of experience in Network Engineering , Platform Engineering , or Systems Architecture . Networking/Storage: Proven experience with Layer 3/4 Networking design, firewall management, and on-premise storage protocols. Automation Skills: Solid coding and scripting skills (Python, Shell) to automate data center operations. Agility: Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving, and agile environment with a strong level of curiosity. Strong level of curiosity and interest to learn Excellent communications skills and the ability to present complex topics to nontechnical audiences Self motivated and able to maintain focus in a pressured environment Primary Skills (Must-Have Hands-On Knowledge) These are the core competencies the Manager will use daily to lead the team and troubleshoot the environment. Container Orchestration: Expertise in RedHat OpenShift (OCP) and upstream Kubernetes cluster design, deployment, and management in a non-cloud environment. Linux Mastery: Advanced Linux Administration (RHEL preferred), including performance tuning, kernel parameters, and system security. On-Prem Networking: Deep understanding of Layer 3/4 Networking , including BGP, Load Balancing (NGINX, HAProxy, or F5), and Firewall management. Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting to automate manual data center tasks and infrastructure provisioning. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with Ansible or Terraform (specifically for on-premise providers like VMware or Bare Metal). Version Control & CI/CD: Git/GitOps workflows and managing on-premise CI/CD instances (e.g., GitLab or Jenkins). Storage Engineering: Experience with Software Defined Storage (SDS) such as Ceph , Rook , or traditional SAN/NAS (NetApp/Dell EMC). Virtualization: Deep experience with VMware vSphere or KVM hypervisors. Identity Management: Integration with Active Directory , LDAP, and SSSD for centralized authentication. Observability: Implementing on-premise monitoring stacks using Prometheus, Grafana , and ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana). Product Delivery · Translate business needs into clear features, user stories, data rules, source-to-target needs, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans that engineering and analytics teams can execute. · Manage and prioritize the backlog based on business value, urgency, data availability, technical complexity, risk, platform cost, support impact, and team capacity. · Partner with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, architects, privacy, security, platform, and data governance teams to balance speed, quality, controls, cost, and long-term maintainability. · Work with engineering and architecture teams on practical product design choices, including batch or streaming patterns, Databricks medallion layers, reusable components, data contracts, semantic models, and downstream consumption patterns. · Identify dependencies, risks, data gaps, scope changes, access needs, platform constraints, and key decisions early so delivery stays on track and stakeholders understand tradeoffs. · Help users choose between an existing data product, self-service data, an AI-assisted answer, a managed report, or new development before adding new work to the backlog. 3. Adoption and Results · Track product performance, usage, reliability, data quality, refresh success, support demand, user feedback, and business outcomes. · Use KPIs, adoption trends, support tickets, data-quality results, and stakeholder feedback to decide what to improve, expand, simplify, automate, or retire. · Create clear documentation, definitions, lineage notes, training materials, release notes, and known-issue guidance so users can find, understand, and use available data products. · Drive adoption by explaining product value in plain language and helping business teams apply the data to real decisions and processes. · Partner with engineering and platform teams to make product health visible through monitoring, alerts, runbooks, service expectations, and permanent fixes for recurring issues. · Communicate status, risks, decisions, adoption, value, and delivery tradeoffs to leaders, business partners, and delivery teams. 4. Data Governance, Quality, and Controls · Make sure data products follow company standards for data quality, security, privacy, access, encryption, retention, stewardship, metadata, lineage, and responsible use. · Partner with governance, privacy, security, architecture, platform, and legal teams to manage data definitions, data lineage, access needs, classification, sensitive data controls, and compliance expectations. · Define quality checks, issue handling, ownership, service expectations, and escalation paths so users can trust the data and know how to get help. · Ensure data products include the controls needed for reliable production use, including testing, monitoring, documentation, release readiness, access approval, and support plans. · Support privacy and regulatory requirements, including appropriate controls for sensitive data, consumer data, and data used by AI-enabled tools or self-service analytics. 5. Workforce Planning and Forecasting · Forecast staffing and skill needs based on planned work, support demand, and team capacity. · Provide staffing and cost estimates for annual planning, project funding, and new work. · Recommend when to hire, use contractors, train employees, automate work, or move work between teams. · Track vacancies and expected staffing changes and explain how they affect delivery and funding. 6. AI Use and Team Expectations · Use approved AI tools in day-to-day work to prepare plans, analyze information, draft documentation, summarize issues, test ideas, and speed up routine tasks. · Set the expectation that employees use approved AI tools where those tools can reduce manual work, improve documentation, support data discovery, or shorten delivery time. · Help the team use tools such as Windsurf, Devin, and Databricks Genie for coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, requirements analysis, and data exploration when appropriate. · Guide the shift from custom report creation to governed self-service, reusable data products, and AI-assisted answers that business teams can use safely. · Require employees to review, validate, and test AI-generated work before it is used in production or shared as a final answer. · Make sure the team follows company rules for security, privacy, data handling, intellectual property, and responsible AI use. · Track where AI is helping the team and where training, controls, or process changes are needed. 7. People Management · Manage employees and set clear goals, priorities, and expectations. · Assign work, balance workloads, and make sure the team has the skills and support needed to deliver. · Give regular feedback, complete performance reviews, and address performance concerns. · Mentor and coach employees, build development plans, and prepare employees for larger roles. · Support hiring, onboarding, succession planning, and retention. QUALIFICATIONS Required · Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience. · 8+ years of relevant experience, including experience managing data products, analytics products, data decisions. · Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with Databricks, Spark, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data modeling, semantic models, data quality, BI tools, and modern cloud data platforms. · Experience with Agile or Scrum ways of working, including backlog management, sprint planning, prioritization, stakeholder demos, release planning, and dependency management. · Experience applying We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support yours by expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career. Northrop Grumman’s Corporate Sector's Chief Information & Digital Office (CIDO) is seeking a Global ERP Solutions Manager 2 - Supply Chain to support the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) organization's Global Supply Chain team. The selected candidate will lead a team of highly skilled Level 3 Enterprise Applications Analysts and Technical Experts, while being responsible for architecting new solutions and projects in support of our global SAP S/4HANA platform and related digital solutions. This leader will: Own end‑to‑end solution strategy and technical design for key SAP S/4 and Supply Chain capabilities. Manage Level 3 operations for critical ERP services, ensuring reliable, high‑quality production support. Serve as the primary point of contact between Enterprise Services and Sectors/Divisions/Business Units to translate business strategy and program requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable technology solutions. Drive continuous improvement, analytics, and integration capabilities as part of Northrop Grumman’s Supply Chain and ERP digital transformation. A virtual work arrangement may be available; however, the selected candidate will be expected to be within driving distance to a Northrop Grumman office. Periodic travel (up to ~10%) may be required for key program, customer, and team engagements . Key Responsibilities: Solution Ownership & Architecture Lead the solution technical architecture and roadmap for SAP S/4 capabilities with a focus on Global Supply Chain and end‑to‑end business processes. Integrate the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) with SAP business processes to enable workflow, extensions, and analytics. Define and manage Supplier Collaboration scenarios (e.g., purchasing document and attachment exchange) between SAP S/4 and external suppliers/partners. Oversee integration patterns and API configurations involving SAP S/4, Ariba, and other enterprise platforms. Level 3 Technical Operations & Service Delivery Manage a global Level 3 ERP support team responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex issues across multiple SAP service lines. Ensure the overall technical quality, performance, stability, and security of solutions in production, meeting or exceeding business SLAs and customer expectations. Provide oversight to recurring and non‑recurring ERP support activities, including incident management, problem management, and defect remediation across multiple programs, Divisions, and Sectors. Establish and maintain sound technical processes, standards, and methods in accordance with company procedures, quality standards, and project protocols. AI / ML & Intelligent Automation Evaluate and recommend AI/ML tools, platforms, and frameworks appropriate for integration into the ERP — including predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and process optimization use cases. Support the design of data pipelines and infrastructure (data lakes, model serving layers) that enable AI/ML workloads within compliant government IT boundaries. Collaborate with organizational stakeholders to translate AI capability needs into actionable ERP/Supply Chain infrastructure requirements. Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary liaison between CIDO and Sector/Division/Business Unit leadership for ERP and Supply Chain solutions. Collaborate with program leadership, homeroom managers, functional leaders, and end‑user groups to identify, prioritize, and deliver ERP capabilities that support program strategic and tactical objectives. Translate business strategy and domain roadmaps into executable technology plans, balancing near‑term needs with long‑term platform health and scalability. Partner with Supplier Management, Procurement, and Operations teams to continuously improve supplier collaboration, visibility, and performance through SAP capabilities. Delivery Leadership & Continuous Improvement Support the design, development, integration/test, and deployment of new ERP and digital capabilities, including coordination across internal teams and external partners. Manage project and support budgets/schedules for assigned programs and initiatives; monitor performance and proactively address risks and issues. Implement and champion Continuous Improvement practices to optimize ERP capabilities, streamline processes, and improve user experience, aligned to Northrop Grumman’s digital transformation objectives. Where applicable, leverage SAP ACTIVATE Methodology to manage and de-risk implementations. People Leadership Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically dispersed team of Level 3 Enterprise Applications Analysts. Set clear priorities and manage capacity, and staffing across the global ERP support team. Foster a culture of customer focus, technical excellence, accountability, and innovation. Promote knowledge sharing, cross‑training, and succession planning within the team. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Manufacturing, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline and 8 years relevant experience; OR Master’s degree with 6 years of relevant experience. Significant hands‑on experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA applications supporting core business processes (preferably in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations). 5+ years of experience in at least one of the following: Solution architecture or enterprise architecture for SAP S/4 and related platforms OR, Technical leadership of Level 3 ERP support teams in a complex, multi‑business‑unit environment. Demonstrated experience with: SAP configuration in Supply Chain / Procurement or related functional areas. At least one full lifecycle SAP implementation (design through go‑live and stabilization). Designing or supporting integrations between SAP and external systems (APIs, middleware, BTP, or Ariba). Proven project/program management experience, including planning, scheduling, budget/cost awareness, risk management, and status reporting. Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from technical teams to non‑technical business users and Executive Leadership; strong presentation skills. Experience successfully deploying business process capabilities into a Production environment and sustaining them through structured support processes. Customer‑focused, results‑oriented leader with demonstrated ability to drive cross‑functional teams to action in a matrixed organization. Self‑starter who thrives in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment and can quickly learn program and process contexts. Preferred Qualifications: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Systems Engineering, Supply Chain/Manufacturing Management, Computer Science, or related STEM discipline. Deep experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Materials Management. Hands‑on experience with: SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for extensions and integrations. SAP Analytics Cloud configuration and solution delivery. Supplier Collaboration integrations between SAP S/4 and external vendors/portals. Ariba configuration, especially Sourcing and Supplier Lifecycle & Performance modules. Prior Enterprise Services or shared‑services environment experience; familiarity with global ERP operating models. Defense industry and/or aerospace & defense experience, with understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements. Demonstrated application of Continuous Improvement concepts, methods, and tools (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) to IT/ERP processes. Experience leading Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban) with a strong understanding of Agile ceremonies and metrics. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to challenge the status quo and propose innovative, practical solutions to complex requirements. We offer flexible work arrangements, phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. Our diverse portfolio of programs means there are endless paths to cultivate your career. We also offer exceptional benefits/healthcare, a 9/80 work schedule, and a great 401k matching program. Come join us! title: Manager Advisory Services - Supply Chain Optimization
jd_text: Manager Advisory Services - Supply Chain Optimization   What will you be doing: The Manager works collaboratively within a team of highly qualified Advisory consultants to deliver performance improvement to healthcare systems. This position will be primarily responsible for performing billable work for clients. The role of the Manager is to actively lead and manage a significant workstream or project. Responsibilities include determining client needs in terms of the engagement statement of work; lead, guide, complete and provide quality assurance over data analyses; interpret data analyses and form initial recommendations; develop final recommendations and solutions for client consideration; develop deliverables and presentations materials for various audiences; assist in the implementation of recommended improvements; assist and manage risk and issues with project leadership; manage project or workstream economics and project administrative activities and logistics. The Manager participates and oversees all aspects of the workstream, or project assigned. They are responsible for the day-to-day management of all activities and staff assigned to their workstream or project. The Manager works in a team environment to provide input, guidance, and quality assurance to team deliverables and presentations during each phase of a project. The Manager will provide mentorship and guidance to all staff working with them on projects. The Manager is responsible for building strong, referenceable client relationships. The Manager is required to also participate in Premier internal activities including practice development, required, and approved educational opportunities throughout the year and learning the various technologies Premier offers to its clients. Additionally, the Manager should: • Maintain utilization targets for client billable projects • Create value through meaningful client relationship management, solution development and implementation delivery • Create a positive team environment by enriching staff skills and knowledge and creating a productive and collaborative environment • Create value for the Advisory practice through meaningful participation in practice related activities aimed at growing and enriching the Practice as a whole or individual Service Lines within the Practice Key Responsibilities Responsibility #1– 60% • Execute/direct/oversee data analyses, initiate interpretations, and conclusions, and prepare verbal and graphic presentations, using methods that are professionally sound and efficient relative to project objectives and conform to standards. Perform quality assurance on project deliverables. • Assist in determining client needs by effectively leading client interviews and utilizing various tools and analytical methods. Summarize analytical findings in a coherent manner and draws insight from observations, interviews, and data analyses. Develops accurate conclusions from findings. Draft’s recommendations and potential solutions for team leadership review. Develops final recommendations and solutions for client review. • Effectively execute on project plans in accordance with engagement statements of work and to client satisfaction. • Develop presentations and deliverables for client audiences that communicate strategy and outcomes. • Generate billings revenue by conducting assigned analyses, write and prepare reports, and assist clients in implementing desired changes. • Guide and lead project management related activities for assigned projects. • Manage the budget and expenses for their assigned projects and manage project profitability. • Manage staff assigned to their projects including providing mentoring and education for staff. • Participate in risk and issue identification and mitigation along with the project leadership team. Responsibility #2 – 15% • Participate in practice development activities for the Advisory Services Practice overall or for the Service Lines within the Practice. Responsibility #3 – 10% Learn Premier based technologies and services. Responsibility #4 – 10% • Actively listen for market opportunities on current engagements and collaborative networks and communicates potential leads to managers. • Contribute to the development of sales presentation deliverables using prescribed formats and technology; proactively seeks out opportunities to participate. • Identifies opportunities to improve profitability Responsibility #5 – 5% Complete all required training requirements on an annual basis. ​Required Qualifications Work Experience: Years of Applicable Experience - 5 or more years Education: Bachelors (Required) Preferred Qualifications Skills: • Coordinate and deliver effective presentations (verbal and written) to client audiences to communicate project outcomes, recommendations, and strategy • Ability to conduct analyses, oversee, and mentor others in the delivery and production of client deliverables • Ability to relate to clients and team members in an effective and collaborative manner • Ability to lead work groups to successful outcomes Experience: • Experience in Health Systems Finance, Operations (clinical, support or operations), Operational or Strategic Consulting, Strategic Planning or Decision Support Analytics • Experience leading cross-functional teams Education: Master’s Degree; RN license or other professional license in clinical area of expertise; PMP/Lean Certification Additional Job Requirements: Remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods of time Be adaptive and change priorities quickly; meet deadlines Attention to detail Operate computer programs and software Ability to communicate effectively with audiences in person and in electronic formats . Day-to-day contact with others (co-workers and/or the public) Making independent decisions Ability to work in a collaborative business environment in close quarters with peers and varying interruptions Working Conditions: Remote Travel Requirements: Travel 61-80% within the US Physical Demands: Sedentary: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves remaining stationary most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if movement is required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met. Premier’s compensation philosophy is to ensure that compensation is reasonable, equitable, and competitive in order to attract and retain talented and highly skilled employees. Premier’s internal salary range for this role is $113,000 - $188,000. Final salary is dependent upon several market factors including, but not limited to, departmental budgets, internal equity, education, unique skills/experience, and geographic location. Premier utilizes a wide-range salary structure to allow base salary flexibility within our ranges. Qualified full-time and part-time employees also receive access to the following benefits: Health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance 401k retirement program Paid time off Participation in Premier’s employee incentive plans Tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities Premier at a glance: Granted World's Most Ethical Companies, Ethisphere, 2008-2026 Named U.S. News & World Report, Best Companies to Work For (2023, 2024, 2025) Accredited by Forbes: America’s Best Management Consulting Firms 2024-2025 Given Modern Healthcare Best in Business Awards: Consultants- Healthcare Management Awarded Cigna Workforce Designation Gold Level Recipient (2016,2017,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2025) For a listing of all of our awards, please visit the Awards and Recognition section on our company website. Employees receive: Perks and discounts Access to on-site and online exercise classes Premier is looking for smart, agile individuals like you to help us transform the healthcare industry. Teammates committed to improving the health of a nation. See why incredible challenges require incredible people. Premier is an equal opportunity employer. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. title: Epic Clinical Sr. Reporting Business Analyst
jd_text: Job Category: Administrative & Clerical Work Shift/Schedule: 8 Hr Evening - Morning Northeast Georgia Health System is rooted in a foundation of improving the health of our communities. About the Role: Job Summary The Reporting Business Analyst Sr. is a senior member of the Data and Analytics Team and is responsible for assessing customer analytic needs and providing guidance on best possible course of action to address. The Report Business Analyst Sr. will be familiar with end-users workflows and well-versed in the complete catalog of NGHS' Analytics tools in order to be able to align the customers business requirement with the analytic solutions most appropriate for meaningful, actionable intelligence. This role will have primary responsibilities for real-time or near real-time applications reports that are generated from the Epic production database using Reporting Workbench, develop custom metrics & RW SQL reports as well as operational dashboards using Radar. This role will have extensive interaction with operational team members and leadership, and will be tasked with analysis of business data and analytics requirements, and the transformation of those requirements into analytics solutions. The Reporting Business Analysts will also partner with the NGHS Technical Training team to develop and Implement training and documentation solutions that enable business stakeholders to get the most out of self-service analytics tools, such as Slicer Dicer and Qlik Sense. Reporting Business Analyst Sr. will also be instrumental in establishing and enforcing best practices, mentoring junior analyst team members in both the technical and functional areas. This Reporting Business Analyst Sr. will also work closely with the manager in prioritizing the intake of requests, enhancements and projects. This person should also be able to keep up with Epic updates and plan for retiring legacy assets and converting them to new tools & technologies. Strong project management skills; ability to formulate action plans and timelines and to execute those plans; ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Strong analytical skills to interpret, adapt, known methods, system procedures or operating concepts to new situations. Relies on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
